1.79.s:
vajra uvāca ... ..
kastvasau bālaveṣeṇa kalpānteṣu punaḥpunaḥ ..
dṛṣṭo'pi na tvayā jñātastatra kautūhalaṃ mahat ..1..
1.79.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥॥।
कस्त्वसौ बालवेषेण कल्पान्तेषु पुनःपुनः ॥
दृष्टोऽपि न त्वया ज्ञातस्तत्र कौतूहलं महत् ॥1॥
1.79.m: Vajra said: / Who was that one in the guise of a child who, though seen again and again / at the ends of aeons, was not recognized by you? Great is my curiosity about this.

1.79.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
bhūyobhūyastvasau dṛṣṭo mayā devo jagatpatiḥ ..
kalpakṣaye na vijñātastanmāyāmohitena vai ..2..
1.79.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
भूयोभूयस्त्वसौ दृष्टो मया देवो जगत्पतिः ॥
कल्पक्षये न विज्ञातस्तन्मायामोहितेन वै ॥2॥
1.79.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / That God, the Lord of the world, was seen by me again and again; / but at the end of the aeon he was not recognized, deluded as I was by his wondrous power.

1.79.s:
kalpakṣaye vyatīte tu taṃ tu devaṃ pitāmahāt ..
aniruddhaṃ vijānāmi pitaraṃ te jagatpatim .. 3 ..
1.79.d:
कल्पक्षये व्यतीते तु तं तु देवं पितामहात् ॥
अनिरुद्धं विजानामि पितरं ते जगत्पतिम् ॥ 3 ॥
1.79.m: When the end of the aeon had passed, from the Grandfather I came to know that God, / Aniruddha, the Lord of the world, who is your father.

1.79.s:
vajra uvāca ..
jñātavānasi taṃ devaṃ kathaṃ devātpitāmahāt ..
durvijñeyaṃ jagadyoniṃ sarvabhūtabhavodbhavam .. 4 ..
1.79.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
ज्ञातवानसि तं देवं कथं देवात्पितामहात् ॥
दुर्विज्ञेयं जगद्योनिं सर्वभूतभवोद्भवम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.79.m: Vajra said: / How did you come to know that God from the divine Grandfather— / him who is difficult to discern, the source of the world, the origin of the existence of all beings?

1.79.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
māyayā mohitastasya bālasyāmitatejasaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvodare jagatkṛtsnaṃ vismayāviṣṭacetanaḥ .. 9 ..
1.79.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
मायया मोहितस्तस्य बालस्यामिततेजसः ॥
दृष्ट्वोदरे जगत्कृत्स्नं विस्मयाविष्टचेतनः ॥ 9 ॥
1.79.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Deluded by the wondrous power of that child of boundless splendor, / having seen the entire world in his belly, with my mind overcome with astonishment,

1.79.s:
gatvāhaṃ brahmasadanaṃ pṛṣṭavām̐staṃ pitāmaham ..
ekārṇave mayā loke devadeve jagatpatau .. 6 ...
1.79.d:
गत्वाहं ब्रह्मसदनं पृष्टवाम्̐स्तं पितामहम् ॥
एकार्णवे मया लोके देवदेवे जगत्पतौ ॥ 6 ॥।
1.79.m:
I went to the abode of Brahmā and asked the Grandfather:
“When the world was one ocean, [I saw] the God of gods, the Lord of the world,

1.79.s:
dṛṣṭo bālo mahātejāstasyāhamavaśastataḥ ..
praviṣṭo jaṭhare tasya deva sarvaṃ carācaram .. 7 ..
1.79.d:
दृष्टो बालो महातेजास्तस्याहमवशस्ततः ॥
प्रविष्टो जठरे तस्य देव सर्वं चराचरम् ॥ 7 ॥
1.79.m:
a child of great radiance was seen [by me]; then, helpless, I
entered into his belly, O god, and all the moving and unmoving [creation]

1.79.s:
mayā dṛṣṭaṃ jagatsarvaṃ na ca jānāmi bālakam ..
dhruvaṃ taṃ bhagavānvetti sarvajñatvājjagadguruḥ .. 8..
1.79.d:
मया दृष्टं जगत्सर्वं न च जानामि बालकम् ॥
ध्रुवं तं भगवान्वेत्ति सर्वज्ञत्वाज्जगद्गुरुः ॥ 8॥
1.79.m:
the entire world was seen by me, and yet I do not know that child.
Surely the Lord knows him, being omniscient, the guru of the world.”

1.79.s:
evaṃ pṛṣṭo mayā brahmā māmuvāca jagadguruḥ ..
mārkaṇḍeya vijānāmi hyaniruddhaṃ jagadgurum .. 9..
1.79.d:
एवं पृष्टो मया ब्रह्मा मामुवाच जगद्गुरुः ॥
मार्कण्डेय विजानामि ह्यनिरुद्धं जगद्गुरुम् ॥ 9॥
1.79.m:
Thus questioned by me, Brahmā, the guru of the world, said to me:
“Mārkaṇḍeya, I indeed know him as Aniruddha, the guru of the world.

1.79.s:
tvaṃ ca taṃ vettha tattvena na ca kalpakṣaye mune ..
tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ yathā tasya jaṭhare bhuvanaṃ mune .. 1.79.10 ..
1.79.d:
त्वं च तं वेत्थ तत्त्वेन न च कल्पक्षये मुने ॥
त्वया दृष्टं यथा तस्य जठरे भुवनं मुने ॥ 1.79.10 ॥
1.79.m:
And you do not know him in truth at the end of the aeon, O sage.
Just as the world was seen by you in his belly, O sage,

1.79.s:
tathā dṛṣṭaṃ mayā tasya jagadyonermahātmanaḥ ..
madīyasya dinasyānte kadācidbhṛgunandana .. 11 ..
1.79.d:
तथा दृष्टं मया तस्य जगद्योनेर्महात्मनः ॥
मदीयस्य दिनस्यान्ते कदाचिद्भृगुनन्दन ॥ 11 ॥
1.79.m:
so was it seen by me [within] that great-souled source of the world,
at the end of my day, once upon a time, O descendant of Bhṛgu.

1.79.s:
ekārṇave tadā loke naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame ..
nāgaparyaṅkaśayane paśyāmi puruṣaṃ tadā .. 12 ..
1.79.d:
एकार्णवे तदा लोके नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे ॥
नागपर्यङ्कशयने पश्यामि पुरुषं तदा ॥ 12 ॥
1.79.m:
When the world then became one ocean and all moving and unmoving things were lost,
I beheld at that time the Cosmic Person lying upon the bed of the serpent.

1.79.s:
tasminkāle na jānāmi tamahaṃ tena mohitaḥ ..
tataḥ pṛcchāmi taṃ devaṃ ko bhavāniti vismitaḥ .. 13 ...
1.79.d:
तस्मिन्काले न जानामि तमहं तेन मोहितः ॥
ततः पृच्छामि तं देवं को भवानिति विस्मितः ॥ 13 ॥।
1.79.m:
At that time I did not know him, being deluded by him;
then, astonished, I asked that god, ‘Who are you?’

1.79.s:
sa māmuvāca prahasanmamedaṃ sakalaṃ jagat ..
na tu māṃ vetsi tattvena jagatāmīśvareśvaram .. 14 ...
1.79.d:
स मामुवाच प्रहसन्ममेदं सकलं जगत् ॥
न तु मां वेत्सि तत्त्वेन जगतामीश्वरेश्वरम् ॥ 14 ॥।
1.79.m:
Laughing, he said to me: ‘All this world is mine,
but you do not know me in truth, the Lord of lords of the worlds.’

1.79.s:
mayāpyuktaḥ sa deveśo mamedaṃ sakalaṃ jagat .. .
vṛthā pralayamadhye te matsamīpe viśeṣataḥ .. 15 ....
1.79.d:
मयाप्युक्तः स देवेशो ममेदं सकलं जगत् ॥ ।
वृथा प्रलयमध्ये ते मत्समीपे विशेषतः ॥ 15 ॥॥
1.79.m:
And I also said to the Lord of gods: ‘All this world is mine;
your [claim] in the midst of dissolution, especially in my presence, is in vain.

1.79.s:
vipratyayaśca yadi te praviśya jaṭharaṃ mama ..
trailokyamakhilaṃ paśya saṃhṛtaṃ yanmayā svayam .. 16 ..
1.79.d:
विप्रत्ययश्च यदि ते प्रविश्य जठरं मम ॥
त्रैलोक्यमखिलं पश्य संहृतं यन्मया स्वयम् ॥ 16 ॥
1.79.m:
And if you have disbelief, enter my belly
and behold the entire three worlds, which have been withdrawn by me myself.’

1.79.s:
evamuktassa tu mayā tadā kenāpi hetunā ..
praviśya jaṭharaṃ me sa kṣaṇamātrādvinirgataḥ .. 17 ..
1.79.d:
एवमुक्तस्स तु मया तदा केनापि हेतुना ॥
प्रविश्य जठरं मे स क्षणमात्राद्विनिर्गतः ॥ 17 ॥
1.79.m:
Having been spoken to thus by me, he, for some reason,
entered my belly and emerged after only a moment.

1.79.s:
nirgamya māmabravīcca dṛṣṭaṃ tribhuvanaṃ mayā..
tavodare jagannātha tvaṃ ca paśya mamodare..18..
1.79.d:
निर्गम्य मामब्रवीच्च दृष्टं त्रिभुवनं मया॥
तवोदरे जगन्नाथ त्वं च पश्य ममोदरे॥18॥
1.79.m:
Having emerged, he said to me: ‘The three worlds were seen by me
in your belly, O Lord of the world; you too look in my belly.’

1.79.s:
evamuktvā sa suṣvāpa bhogibhogāsane tadā..
ahamapyavaśastasya praviṣṭo jaṭharaṃ tadā ..19..
1.79.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स सुष्वाप भोगिभोगासने तदा॥
अहमप्यवशस्तस्य प्रविष्टो जठरं तदा ॥19॥
1.79.m:
Having spoken thus, he then slept on the serpent’s coils;
and I too, helpless, entered his belly at that time.

1.79.s:
paśyāmi jagatīṃ brahmansaśailavanakānanām..
sasamudrasariddvīpalokapātālabhūṣitām..1.79.20..
1.79.d:
पश्यामि जगतीं ब्रह्मन्सशैलवनकाननाम्॥
ससमुद्रसरिद्द्वीपलोकपातालभूषिताम्॥1.79.20॥
1.79.m:
I beheld the earth, O brahmin, endowed with mountains, woods, and forests,
adorned with oceans, rivers, continents, worlds, and the nether regions.

1.79.s:
dṛṣṭvāhaṃ pṛthivīṃ tasya tathā jaṭharasaṃsthitām ..
nirgamiṣyanna paśyāmi śarīraṃ tasya bhārgava ..21 ...
1.79.d:
दृष्ट्वाहं पृथिवीं तस्य तथा जठरसंस्थिताम् ॥
निर्गमिष्यन्न पश्यामि शरीरं तस्य भार्गव ॥21 ॥।
1.79.m:
Having seen the earth thus situated within his belly,
as I wished to emerge, I could not see his body, O Bhārgava.

1.79.s:
antarikṣaṃ prapaśyāmi nirālambaṃ paribhraman ..
paribhramaṇakhinno'smi tameva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ .. 22 ..
1.79.d:
अन्तरिक्षं प्रपश्यामि निरालम्बं परिभ्रमन् ॥
परिभ्रमणखिन्नोऽस्मि तमेव शरणं गतः ॥ 22 ॥
1.79.m:
Wandering about, I beheld only the sky without support;
wearied from wandering, I took refuge in him alone.

1.79.s:
tatastu tasya paśyāmi randhrahīnaṃ tu vigraham ...
tasya dehādvinirgantuṃ śaktināsīttathā ca me ..23..
1.79.d:
ततस्तु तस्य पश्यामि रन्ध्रहीनं तु विग्रहम् ॥।
तस्य देहाद्विनिर्गन्तुं शक्तिनासीत्तथा च मे ॥23॥
1.79.m:
Then, however, I beheld his body devoid of any aperture,
and thus there was no power for me to emerge from his body.

1.79.s:
randhrahīnānmahābhāga tameva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ..
tato'haṃ gatavānbrahmanraṃndhraṃ prāptaṃ mayānagha .. 24..
1.79.d:
रन्ध्रहीनान्महाभाग तमेव शरणं गतः ॥
ततोऽहं गतवान्ब्रह्मन्रंन्ध्रं प्राप्तं मयानघ ॥ 24॥
1.79.m:
[Finding it] devoid of apertures, O fortunate one, I took refuge in him alone;
then I moved, O brahmin, and an aperture was found by me, O sinless one:

1.79.s:
bālāgrādapi sūkṣmaṃ tattato'haṃ tena nirgataḥ ..
padmanālena niṣkrāntaṃ paśyāmyātmānamātmanā .. 29 ..
1.79.d:
बालाग्रादपि सूक्ष्मं तत्ततोऽहं तेन निर्गतः ॥
पद्मनालेन निष्क्रान्तं पश्याम्यात्मानमात्मना ॥ 29 ॥
1.79.m:
finer than the tip of a hair; then I emerged through it.
I beheld myself emerged by myself along the lotus stalk.

1.79.s:
nābhisarasi tatpadmaṃ jātaṃ devasya śārṅgiṇaḥ ..
śeṣaratnārkaśaivāli vikāsitadalaṃ mahat .. 26 ..
1.79.d:
नाभिसरसि तत्पद्मं जातं देवस्य शार्ङ्गिणः ॥
शेषरत्नार्कशैवालि विकासितदलं महत् ॥ 26 ॥
1.79.m:
That lotus was born in the lake of the navel of the god who bears the bow Śārṅga,
with Śeṣa’s jewels as its solar moss, great, with blossomed petals.

1.79.s:
tato'haṃ padmajanmeti loke khyātimupāgataḥ ..||
nābhijātaṃ ca yatpadmaṃ tasya devasya bhārgava .. 27..
1.79.d:
ततोऽहं पद्मजन्मेति लोके ख्यातिमुपागतः ॥॥
नाभिजातं च यत्पद्मं तस्य देवस्य भार्गव ॥ 27॥
1.79.m:
Then I attained fame in the world as the Lotus-Born.
And the lotus that was born from the navel of that god, O Bhārgava—

1.79.s:
tanmahāmaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ merustasya ca karṇikā ..
tatrāhaṃ tasya saṃbhūto devadevasya cakriṇaḥ..28..
1.79.d:
तन्महामण्डलं कृत्स्नं मेरुस्तस्य च कर्णिका ॥
तत्राहं तस्य संभूतो देवदेवस्य चक्रिणः॥28॥
1.79.m:
that is the entire great circle of the earth, and Mount Meru is its pericarp.
There I was born from that god of gods, the wielder of the discus.

1.79.s:
devassa viṣṇurjagatāmadhīśaḥ sarveśvaraḥ sarvajagatpradhānaḥ ..
yò bālarūpī bhavatāntakāle dṛṣṭo'sya sarvasya carācarasya .. 29..
1.79.d:
देवस्स विष्णुर्जगतामधीशः सर्वेश्वरः सर्वजगत्प्रधानः ॥
य्ò बालरूपी भवतान्तकाले दृष्टोऽस्य सर्वस्य चराचरस्य ॥ 29॥
1.79.m:
That god is Viṣṇu, the sovereign of the worlds, the Lord of all, the chief of the whole universe,
who was seen by you in the form of a child at the time of the dissolution of all this moving and unmoving [creation].

1.79.s:
evaṃ hi tasyodarasaṃsthitena mayoṣitaṃ jātakutūhalena ..
tasyaiva māyāparimohitena kalpāntakāleṣu sadā narendra .. 1.79.30 ..
1.79.d:
एवं हि तस्योदरसंस्थितेन मयोषितं जातकुतूहलेन ॥
तस्यैव मायापरिमोहितेन कल्पान्तकालेषु सदा नरेन्द्र ॥ 1.79.30 ॥
1.79.m:
Thus, dwelling within his belly, I lived filled with wonder,
deluded by his power of illusion at all times of the end of the aeon, O lord of men.”

1.80.s:
vajra uvāca ..
brahmaṇo'sya samutpattimārabhya sumahādyute ..
kālasya gatimicchāmi śrotuṃ bhṛgukulodvaha..1..
1.80.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
ब्रह्मणोऽस्य समुत्पत्तिमारभ्य सुमहाद्युते ॥
कालस्य गतिमिच्छामि श्रोतुं भृगुकुलोद्वह॥1॥
1.80.m:
Vajra said:
“Beginning from this origin of Brahmā, O one of very great splendor,
I wish to hear the course of time, O uplifter of the Bhṛgu race.”

1.80.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca..
svenāhorātramānena brahmaṇo'sya jagatpateḥ..
samāṣṭakaṃ gataṃ rājanpañcamāsāstathaiva ca.. .. 2..
1.80.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच॥
स्वेनाहोरात्रमानेन ब्रह्मणोऽस्य जगत्पतेः॥
समाष्टकं गतं राजन्पञ्चमासास्तथैव च॥ ॥ 2॥
1.80.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
“By his own measure of day and night, of this Brahmā, the Lord of the world,
eight years have passed, O king, and likewise five months,

1.80.s:
ahorātracatuṣkaṃ ca vartamānadinādgatam ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu .. 3 ..
1.80.d:
अहोरात्रचतुष्कं च वर्तमानदिनाद्गतम् ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि तन्मे निगदतः शृणु ॥ 3 ॥
1.80.m:
and four days and nights have passed from the current day.
Hereafter I shall speak; listen to me as I proclaim it:

1.80.s:
manavaḥ ṣaḍ gatāssapta sandhayaśca tathā gatāḥ ..
saptaviṃśadvyatītāśca tathaiva ca caturyugāḥ .. 4 ..
1.80.d:
मनवः षड् गतास्सप्त सन्धयश्च तथा गताः ॥
सप्तविंशद्व्यतीताश्च तथैव च चतुर्युगाः ॥ 4 ॥
1.80.m:
six Manus have passed, and seven twilight intervals have likewise passed,
and twenty-seven four-age cycles have similarly elapsed;

1.80.s:
yugatrayaṃ tathātītaṃ vartamānacaturyugāt ..
saṃvatsarāṇāṃ daśakaṃ tathā kaliyugādgatam .. 5 ..
1.80.d:
युगत्रयं तथातीतं वर्तमानचतुर्युगात् ॥
संवत्सराणां दशकं तथा कलियुगाद्गतम् ॥ 5 ॥
1.80.m:
likewise three ages have passed from the current four-age cycle,
and ten years have passed from the Kali age.

1.80.s:
vātāśvameghakāle'sminsaha yakṣeṇa yādava ..
bhaviṣyāṇāmatītānāṃ brahmaṇāṃ bhūridakṣiṇa .. 6 ..
1.80.d:
वाताश्वमेघकालेऽस्मिन्सह यक्षेण यादव ॥
भविष्याणामतीतानां ब्रह्मणां भूरिदक्षिण ॥ 6 ॥
1.80.m:
In this time of the wind, horse, and clouds, together with the yakṣa, O Yādava,
of the past and future Brahmās, O giver of lavish sacrificial gifts,

1.80.s:
anādimattvātkālasya saṃkhyāṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate ..
gaṅgāyāḥ sikatā dhārā yathā varṣati vāsavaḥ .. 7 ..
1.80.d:
अनादिमत्त्वात्कालस्य संख्यां वक्तुं न शक्यते ॥
गङ्गायाः सिकता धारा यथा वर्षति वासवः ॥ 7 ॥
1.80.m:
on account of the beginninglessness of time, it is not possible to state the number.
Just as the sands of the Gaṅgā, or the streams [of rain] when Indra showers,

1.80.s:
śakyā gaṇayituṃ rājanna vyatītā pitāmahāḥ
antavattāṃ budho buddhvā sarvasya jagatīpate .. 8..
1.80.d:
शक्या गणयितुं राजन्न व्यतीता पितामहाः
अन्तवत्तां बुधो बुद्ध्वा सर्वस्य जगतीपते ॥ 8॥
1.80.m:
can be counted, O king, but not the past Grandfathers.
Having understood the finite nature of everything, O lord of the earth,

1.80.s:
tanmārgaṃ parimārgante yadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam ..
vajra uvāca .. kiyatkālaparīmāṇaṃ mayā śāsyā vasundharā..9..
1.80.d:
तन्मार्गं परिमार्गन्ते यद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् ॥
वज्र उवाच ॥ कियत्कालपरीमाणं मया शास्या वसुन्धरा॥9॥
1.80.m:
the wise seek that path which is the supreme abode of Viṣṇu.”
Vajra said:
“For what length of time is the earth to be ruled by me

1.80.s:
parikṣitā ca dharmajña tanme brūhi bhṛgūttama..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca..
adyaprabhṛti rājendra samā pañcāśakaṃ gate..1.80.10..
1.80.d:
परिक्षिता च धर्मज्ञ तन्मे ब्रूहि भृगूत्तम॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच॥
अद्यप्रभृति राजेन्द्र समा पञ्चाशकं गते॥1.80.10॥
1.80.m:
and by Parīkṣit, O knower of dharma? Tell me that, O foremost of the Bhṛgus.”
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
“From this day onward, O chief of kings, when fifty years have elapsed,

1.80.s:
parīkṣiti mahārāje divaṃ prāpte kurūddhahe ..
parīkṣiddhīne lokesminprāṇituṃ tvaṃ tu śakyase .. 13 ..
1.80.d:
परीक्षिति महाराजे दिवं प्राप्ते कुरूद्धहे ॥
परीक्षिद्धीने लोकेस्मिन्प्राणितुं त्वं तु शक्यसे ॥ 13 ॥
1.80.m:
when the great king Parīkṣit, the uplifter of the Kurus, has attained heaven,
will you be able to live in this world devoid of Parīkṣit?

1.80.s:
mahāprasthānamāviśya nāgalokaṃ gamiṣyasi ..
svargate tvayi rājendra parīkṣiti tathā nṛpe .. 12..
1.80.d:
महाप्रस्थानमाविश्य नागलोकं गमिष्यसि ॥
स्वर्गते त्वयि राजेन्द्र परीक्षिति तथा नृपे ॥ 12॥
1.80.m:
Embarking upon the Great Departure, you will go to the world of the serpents.
When you have gone to heaven, O chief of kings, and King Parīkṣit likewise,

1.80.s:
rājā nāgapure bhāvī pārīkṣijjanamejayaḥ ..
mathurāyāṃ tathā bhāvī tava putro'calo nṛpaḥ .. 13 ...
1.80.d:
राजा नागपुरे भावी पारीक्षिज्जनमेजयः ॥
मथुरायां तथा भावी तव पुत्रोऽचलो नृपः ॥ 13 ॥।
1.80.m:
the son of Parīkṣit, Janamejaya, will become king in the City of the Serpent [Hāstinapura];
and in Mathurā your son, King Acala, will reign.

1.80.s:
nagaraṃ khāṇḍavaprasthaṃ bhayādivinivarjitam ..
pālayiṣyati dharmātmā putraste bhīmavikramaḥ .. 14 ..
1.80.d:
नगरं खाण्डवप्रस्थं भयादिविनिवर्जितम् ॥
पालयिष्यति धर्मात्मा पुत्रस्ते भीमविक्रमः ॥ 14 ॥
1.80.m:
Your righteous son of terrible valor will protect
the city of Khāṇḍavaprastha, freed from fear and danger.

1.80.s:
dānavendro mayaḥ pūrvaṃ phālgunena prayāsyatā ..
mahāprasthānamityukto rājaṃstvatpriyakāmyayā .. 15..
1.80.d:
दानवेन्द्रो मयः पूर्वं फाल्गुनेन प्रयास्यता ॥
महाप्रस्थानमित्युक्तो राजंस्त्वत्प्रियकाम्यया ॥ 15॥
1.80.m:
Maya, the lord of the Dānavas, was formerly addressed by Arjuna when he was about to set out
upon the Great Departure, O king, out of a desire to do what was pleasing to you:

1.80.s:
yāvadvajro mahīṃ bhuṅkte khāṇḍavaprasthamāśritaḥ ..
tāvatsabheyaṃ saṃrakṣyā tvayā maduparodhataḥ..16..
1.80.d:
यावद्वज्रो महीं भुङ्क्ते खाण्डवप्रस्थमाश्रितः ॥
तावत्सभेयं संरक्ष्या त्वया मदुपरोधतः॥16॥
1.80.m:
‘As long as Vajra enjoys the earth, having resorted to Khāṇḍavaprastha,
so long must this assembly hall be protected by you at my insistence.’

1.80.s:
seyaṃ saṃrakṣyate tena pratijñāya dhanañjaye ..
tvayi nākamanuprāpte sabheyaṃ mayaśāsanāt .. 17 ..
1.80.d:
सेयं संरक्ष्यते तेन प्रतिज्ञाय धनञ्जये ॥
त्वयि नाकमनुप्राप्ते सभेयं मयशासनात् ॥ 17 ॥
1.80.m:
Having made that promise to Arjuna, it is protected by him;
when you have reached heaven, by the command of Maya,

1.80.s:
himācalaṃ tu neṣyanti yatra bindusaraṃ saraḥ ..
rākṣasāḥ kiṅkarā nāma yattasmānnirmitā purā .. 18 ..
1.80.d:
हिमाचलं तु नेष्यन्ति यत्र बिन्दुसरं सरः ॥
राक्षसाः किङ्करा नाम यत्तस्मान्निर्मिता पुरा ॥ 18 ॥
1.80.m:
the rākṣasas named Kiṅkaras will carry this assembly hall to the Himālaya,
where Lake Bindusaras is, because it was constructed from there long ago.”

1.80.s:
uktaṃ hi te kālagataṃ mayaitadāyuḥpramāṇaṃ ca tathā tavoktam ..
ataḥ paraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha vadasva kiṃ te kathayāmi rājan .. 19 ..
1.80.d:
उक्तं हि ते कालगतं मयैतदायुःप्रमाणं च तथा तवोक्तम् ॥
अतः परं धर्मभृतां वरिष्ठ वदस्व किं ते कथयामि राजन् ॥ 19 ॥
1.80.m: For this passage of time has been spoken to you by me, and the measure of life has likewise been told to you. / Beyond this, O best of the upholders of dharma, speak: what shall I tell you, O king?

1.81.s:
vajra uvāca ..
tvayoditānāṃ dharmajña samāsena pṛthakpṛthak ..
kālasyāvayavānāṃ ca śrotumicchāmi devatāḥ .. 1 ..
1.81.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
त्वयोदितानां धर्मज्ञ समासेन पृथक्पृथक् ॥
कालस्यावयवानां च श्रोतुमिच्छामि देवताः ॥ 1 ॥
1.81.m: Vajra said: / O knower of dharma, I wish to hear, one by one, [about] the deities / of the parts of time described by you in brief.

1.81.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
pauruṣaṃ yadahorātraṃ śrutavānasi yādava ..
kālātmā puruṣastasya sarvabhūtapatiḥ prabhuḥ .. 2 ..
1.81.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
पौरुषं यदहोरात्रं श्रुतवानसि यादव ॥
कालात्मा पुरुषस्तस्य सर्वभूतपतिः प्रभुः ॥ 2 ॥
1.81.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The day and night of the Cosmic Person that you have heard of, O descendant of Yadu— / its sovereign is the Cosmic Person whose self is time, the lord of all beings.

1.81.s:
kalpasya daivataṃ brahmā yasyedaṃ sakalaṃ jagat ..
kramānmanvantarāṇāṃ tu manavastu caturdaśa .. 3 ..
1.81.d:
कल्पस्य दैवतं ब्रह्मा यस्येदं सकलं जगत् ॥
क्रमान्मन्वन्तराणां तु मनवस्तु चतुर्दश ॥ 3 ॥
1.81.m: Brahmā, to whom this entire world belongs, is the deity of the aeon. / And of the manvantaras in due order, the deities are the fourteen Manus.

1.81.s:
svāyambhuvastu prathamo manuḥ svārociṣastathā ..
vaivasvato'tha sāvarṇirbrahmaputrastathaiva ca .. 4 ..
1.81.d:
स्वायम्भुवस्तु प्रथमो मनुः स्वारोचिषस्तथा ॥
वैवस्वतोऽथ सावर्णिर्ब्रह्मपुत्रस्तथैव च ॥ 4 ॥
1.81.m: Svāyambhuva is the first Manu, and likewise Svārociṣa, / then Vaivasvata, Sāvarṇi, and likewise Brahmaputra,

1.81.s:
dharmaputro rudraputro dakṣaputraśca yādava ..
raucyo bhautyaśca viśvātmā manavastu caturdaśa ..5..
1.81.d:
धर्मपुत्रो रुद्रपुत्रो दक्षपुत्रश्च यादव ॥
रौच्यो भौत्यश्च विश्वात्मा मनवस्तु चतुर्दश ॥5॥
1.81.m: Dharmaputra, Rudraputra, and Dakṣaputra, O descendant of Yadu, / Raucya, Bhautya, and Viśvātman—the fourteen Manus.

1.81.s:
vajra uvāca..
ya ete bhavatā proktā manavaśca caturdaśa ..
nityaṃ brāhme dine prāpte eta eva kramāddvija ..6..
1.81.d:
वज्र उवाच॥
य एते भवता प्रोक्ता मनवश्च चतुर्दश ॥
नित्यं ब्राह्मे दिने प्राप्ते एत एव क्रमाद्द्विज ॥6॥
1.81.m: Vajra said: / These fourteen Manus that have been mentioned by you— / when the day of Brahmā constantly arrives, do these very ones in order, O twice-born,

1.81.s:
bhavantyutānye dharmajña etanme cchindhi saṃśayam ..
athavā varttamāne'sminbhavatā mama kīrtitāḥ .. 7 ..
1.81.d:
भवन्त्युतान्ये धर्मज्ञ एतन्मे च्छिन्धि संशयम् ॥
अथवा वर्त्तमानेऽस्मिन्भवता मम कीर्तिताः ॥ 7 ॥
1.81.m: arise, or others, O knower of dharma? Cut away this doubt of mine! / Or were these recounted to me by you [only] in this present [aeon]?

1.81.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
eta eva mahārāja manavastu caturdaśa ..
kalpekalpe tvayā jñeyā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ..8..
1.81.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
एत एव महाराज मनवस्तु चतुर्दश ॥
कल्पेकल्पे त्वया ज्ञेया नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥8॥
1.81.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / These very fourteen Manus, O great king, / are to be known by you in aeon after aeon; no doubt should be made here.

1.81.s:
ekarūpāstrayaḥ kalpā jñātavyāssarva eva hi ..
kvacitkiṃcidvibhinnāśca māyayā parameṣṭhinaḥ ..9 ..
1.81.d:
एकरूपास्त्रयः कल्पा ज्ञातव्यास्सर्व एव हि ॥
क्वचित्किंचिद्विभिन्नाश्च मायया परमेष्ठिनः ॥9 ॥
1.81.m: All three kinds of aeons are to be known as identical in form, / yet slightly different in some respects through the illusory power of Parameṣṭhin.

1.81.s:
jñātavyamekarūpatvamabdānāṃ ca tathā tvayā ..
kalpekalpe mahārāja manūnāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .. 1.81.10 ..
1.81.d:
ज्ञातव्यमेकरूपत्वमब्दानां च तथा त्वया ॥
कल्पेकल्पे महाराज मनूनां च विशेषतः ॥ 1.81.10 ॥
1.81.m: Uniformity of the years is likewise to be understood by you, / O great king, especially of the Manus, in aeon after aeon.

1.81.s:
vajra uvāca ..
kalpānāṃ janasādṛśye yuktinaivopapadyate ..
kadācidapi dharmaja tatra paśyāmi kāraṇam .. 11 ..
1.81.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
कल्पानां जनसादृश्ये युक्तिनैवोपपद्यते ॥
कदाचिदपि धर्मज तत्र पश्यामि कारणम् ॥ 11 ॥
1.81.m: Vajra said: / In the case of the similarity of living beings across aeons, logic simply does not hold. / O knower of dharma, I never see a reason for that.

1.81.s:
ekasminnantare muktiṃ kalpekalpe gate dvija ..
prabhaviṣyajjagacchūnyaṃ kālasyāderabhāvataḥ .. 12 ..
1.81.d:
एकस्मिन्नन्तरे मुक्तिं कल्पेकल्पे गते द्विज ॥
प्रभविष्यज्जगच्छून्यं कालस्यादेरभावतः ॥ 12 ॥
1.81.m: If in every aeon [even] one [person] attained liberation in an interval, O twice-born, / the world would become empty, since time has no beginning.

1.81.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
jīvasyānyasya sargeṇa nare muktimupāgate ..
acintyaśaktirbhagavāñjaganpūrayate sadā .. 13 ..
1.81.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
जीवस्यान्यस्य सर्गेण नरे मुक्तिमुपागते ॥
अचिन्त्यशक्तिर्भगवाञ्जगन्पूरयते सदा ॥ 13 ॥
1.81.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When a man attains liberation, through the creation of another living being / the Lord of inconceivable power always fills up the world.

1.81.s:
brahmaṇā saha mucyante brahmalokamupāgatāḥ ..
sṛjyante ca mahākalpe tadvidhāścāpare janāḥ .. 14 ..
1.81.d:
ब्रह्मणा सह मुच्यन्ते ब्रह्मलोकमुपागताः ॥
सृज्यन्ते च महाकल्पे तद्विधाश्चापरे जनाः ॥ 14 ॥
1.81.m: Those who have reached the world of Brahmā are liberated along with Brahmā, / and in the great aeon other people of that sort are created.

1.81.s:
te prāptāḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ yeṣāṃ janma na vidyate ..
samajīvapramāṇāśca sarve kalpāstathā nṛpa ..
brahmaloke viṣṇuloke rudraloke ca ye gatāḥ .. 15 ..
1.81.d:
ते प्राप्ताः परमं स्थानं येषां जन्म न विद्यते ॥
समजीवप्रमाणाश्च सर्वे कल्पास्तथा नृप ॥
ब्रह्मलोके विष्णुलोके रुद्रलोके च ये गताः ॥ 15 ॥
1.81.m: Those who have attained the supreme abode have no rebirth. / And all aeons have an equal measure of living beings, O king, / as do those who have gone to the world of Brahmā, the world of Viṣṇu, and the world of Rudra.

1.81.s:
viṣṇulokāssubahavo rudralokāstathaiva ca ..
śvetadvīpagatā ye ca teṣāṃ janma na vidyate .. 16 ..
1.81.d:
विष्णुलोकास्सुबहवो रुद्रलोकास्तथैव च ॥
श्वेतद्वीपगता ये च तेषां जन्म न विद्यते ॥ 16 ॥
1.81.m: Very many are the worlds of Viṣṇu, and likewise the worlds of Rudra. / And those who have gone to Śvetadvīpa have no rebirth.

1.81.s:
na tu sarveṣu rājendra teṣu muktiḥ prakīrtitā ..
brahmalokopariṣṭācca ye lokā raudravaiṣṇavāḥ .. 17 ..
1.81.d:
न तु सर्वेषु राजेन्द्र तेषु मुक्तिः प्रकीर्तिता ॥
ब्रह्मलोकोपरिष्टाच्च ये लोका रौद्रवैष्णवाः ॥ 17 ॥
1.81.m: However, liberation is not declared in all of them, O king of kings. / The worlds of Rudra and Viṣṇu that are above the world of Brahmā,

1.81.s:
mayoditāstayorgatvā punarjanma na vidyate ..
mahākalpakṣaye jīvāḥ sarve taṃ parameśvaram .. 18 ..
1.81.d:
मयोदितास्तयोर्गत्वा पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते ॥
महाकल्पक्षये जीवाः सर्वे तं परमेश्वरम् ॥ 18 ॥
1.81.m: which were declared by me—having gone to those two, there is no rebirth. / At the destruction of the great aeon, all living beings, [merely] reaching that Supreme Lord,

1.81.s:
prāpyāpi vinivartante vinā jñānena yādava ..
bhūya eva tadā lokānsarge sṛjati tānprabhuḥ .. 19 ..
1.81.d:
प्राप्यापि विनिवर्तन्ते विना ज्ञानेन यादव ॥
भूय एव तदा लोकान्सर्गे सृजति तान्प्रभुः ॥ 19 ॥
1.81.m: nevertheless return without knowledge, O descendant of Yadu. / Then the Lord creates those worlds again in creation.

1.81.s:
kalpamadhyre tu kalpānte jñānojjhitakalevarāḥ ..
prāpnuvanti paraṃ paraṃ sthānaṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam .. 1.81.20 ..
1.81.d:
कल्पमध्य्रे तु कल्पान्ते ज्ञानोज्झितकलेवराः ॥
प्राप्नुवन्ति परं परं स्थानं तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् ॥ 1.81.20 ॥
1.81.m: In the middle of an aeon or at the end of an aeon, those whose bodies are cast off with knowledge / reach the supreme, supreme abode, that highest step of Viṣṇu.

1.81.s:
jīvabījānyasargeṇa tatsthānaṃ parameśvaraḥ ..
prapūrayati dharmajña rājankenāpi hetunā .. 21 ..
1.81.d:
जीवबीजान्यसर्गेण तत्स्थानं परमेश्वरः ॥
प्रपूरयति धर्मज्ञ राजन्केनापि हेतुना ॥ 21 ॥
1.81.m: Through the creation of other seeds of living beings, the Supreme Lord / fills up that place, O knower of dharma, for a certain reason, O king.

1.81.s:
vajra uvāca ..
kalpānāṃ sati sādṛśye yo bhedo bhṛgunandana ..
tamahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tatra me kautukaṃ mahat .. 22 ..
1.81.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
कल्पानां सति सादृश्ये यो भेदो भृगुनन्दन ॥
तमहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्र मे कौतुकं महत् ॥ 22 ॥
1.81.m: Vajra said: / Although there is similarity among the aeons, what difference there is, O son of Bhṛgu, / that I wish to hear; in that regard, my curiosity is great.

1.81.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
kalpānāṃ sati sādṛśye śṛṇu bhedaṃ narādhipa..
samatīte yathā kalpe ṣaṣṭhe manvantare gate .. 23 ..
1.81.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
कल्पानां सति सादृश्ये शृणु भेदं नराधिप॥
समतीते यथा कल्पे षष्ठे मन्वन्तरे गते ॥ 23 ॥
1.81.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Although there is similarity among the aeons, hear the difference, O ruler of men: / in the past aeon, when the sixth manvantara had passed,

1.81.s:
saptamasya caturviṃśe rājaṃstretāyuge tadā ..
yadā rāmeṇa samare sagaṇo rāvaṇo hataḥ ..24..
1.81.d:
सप्तमस्य चतुर्विंशे राजंस्त्रेतायुगे तदा ॥
यदा रामेण समरे सगणो रावणो हतः ॥24॥
1.81.m: then in the twenty-fourth Tretā age of the seventh, O king, / when Rāvaṇa along with his host was slain in battle by Rāma,

1.81.s:
rāmeṇaiva tadā rājankumbhakarṇo nipātitaḥ ..
vartamāne tu yadvṛttaṃ kalpe yadukulodvaha .. 29..
1.81.d:
रामेणैव तदा राजन्कुम्भकर्णो निपातितः ॥
वर्तमाने तु यद्वृत्तं कल्पे यदुकुलोद्वह ॥ 29॥
1.81.m: Kumbhakarṇa was struck down then by Rāma alone, O king. / But as to what took place in the present aeon, O scion of the Yadu race:

1.81.s:
rāmasya caritaṃ baddhaṃ tadā vālmīkinā śubham ..
atītakalpe yadvṛttaṃ mayā tatkāmyake vane .. 26 ..
1.81.d:
रामस्य चरितं बद्धं तदा वाल्मीकिना शुभम् ॥
अतीतकल्पे यद्वृत्तं मया तत्काम्यके वने ॥ 26 ॥
1.81.m: at that time the auspicious deeds of Rāma were composed [in verse] by Vālmīki. / What occurred in the past aeon was recounted by me in the Kāmyaka forest

1.81.s:
yudhiṣṭhirāya kathitaṃ dharmaputrāya pārthiva ..
kalpānāṃ sati sādṛśye bheda eṣa taveritaḥ..27..
1.81.d:
युधिष्ठिराय कथितं धर्मपुत्राय पार्थिव ॥
कल्पानां सति सादृश्ये भेद एष तवेरितः॥27॥
1.81.m: to Yudhiṣṭhirā, the son of Dharma, O ruler of the earth. / Although there is similarity among the aeons, this difference has been declared to you.

1.81.s:
teṣāṃ svarūpaṃ ca tathā tathā rājannanukramam ..
brahmajanmanisargāśca tathā tasya pṛthagvidhāḥ .. 28 ..
1.81.d:
तेषां स्वरूपं च तथा तथा राजन्ननुक्रमम् ॥
ब्रह्मजन्मनिसर्गाश्च तथा तस्य पृथग्विधाः ॥ 28 ॥
1.81.m: And likewise their essential nature, and likewise their sequence, O king, / and the various kinds of emissions at the birth of Brahmā,

1.81.s:
kārtikeyasya lakṣmyāśca tathā devasya śūlinaḥ ..
evamādyāḥ prabhedāstu tvayā jñeyā nu pārthiva ..
kalpādīnāṃ mahārāja cānyatrāpi yadūdvaha .. 29 ..
1.81.d:
कार्तिकेयस्य लक्ष्म्याश्च तथा देवस्य शूलिनः ॥
एवमाद्याः प्रभेदास्तु त्वया ज्ञेया नु पार्थिव ॥
कल्पादीनां महाराज चान्यत्रापि यदूद्वह ॥ 29 ॥
1.81.m: and of Kārtikeya, of Lakṣmī, and likewise of the trident-bearing god— / such differences are certainly to be known by you, O ruler of the earth, / regarding aeons and the rest, O scion of the Yadus, and elsewhere too, O great king.

1.81.s:
sādṛśyabhedāviha bhūmipāla kalpasyakalpasya mayoditau te ..
yugādibhinnasya ca daivatāni vakṣyāmyatastāni nibodha rājan ..1.81.30..
1.81.d:
सादृश्यभेदाविह भूमिपाल कल्पस्यकल्पस्य मयोदितौ ते ॥
युगादिभिन्नस्य च दैवतानि वक्ष्याम्यतस्तानि निबोध राजन् ॥1.81.30॥
1.81.m: The similarity and difference of each aeon have been spoken to you here, O protector of the earth. / Now I shall tell you the deities of [the divisions of time] differentiated into ages and the rest; understand them, O king.

1.82.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ... ..
bhagavānvāsudevaśca tathā saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ..
pradyumraścāniruddhaśca kṛtādīnāṃ ca daivatāḥ .. .. 1 ..
1.82.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥॥।
भगवान्वासुदेवश्च तथा संकर्षणः प्रभुः ॥
प्रद्युम्रश्चानिरुद्धश्च कृतादीनां च दैवताः ॥ ॥ 1 ॥
1.82.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The Blessed Vāsudeva, and likewise the lord Saṃkarṣaṇa, / Pradyumna, and Aniruddha are the deities of the Kṛta and following [ages].

1.82.s:
tathā khaṇḍayugānīha dvādaśoktāni bhūpate..
ṣaṣṭhābde ca vivartante pañcābdāni pṛthakpṛthak .. 2 ..
1.82.d:
तथा खण्डयुगानीह द्वादशोक्तानि भूपते॥
षष्ठाब्दे च विवर्तन्ते पञ्चाब्दानि पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 2 ॥
1.82.m: Likewise, twelve partial ages are spoken of here, O lord of the earth; / in sixty years, they revolve separately as five-year periods.

1.82.s:
teṣāṃ tava pravakṣyāmi daivatāṃstu pṛthakpṛthak ..
viṣṇurbṛhaspatiśśakro vahnistvaṣṭā tathaiva ca .. 3..
1.82.d:
तेषां तव प्रवक्ष्यामि दैवतांस्तु पृथक्पृथक् ॥
विष्णुर्बृहस्पतिश्शक्रो वह्निस्त्वष्टा तथैव च ॥ 3॥
1.82.m: I shall declare their deities to you, each separately: / Viṣṇu, Bṛhaspati, Śakra, Agni, and likewise Tvaṣṭṛ,

1.82.s:
ahirbudhnyaśca pitaro viśvedevā niśākaraḥ ..
indrāgnī caiva nāsatyau bhagaścaiva mahābalaḥ .. 4 ..
1.82.d:
अहिर्बुध्न्यश्च पितरो विश्वेदेवा निशाकरः ॥
इन्द्राग्नी चैव नासत्यौ भगश्चैव महाबलः ॥ 4 ॥
1.82.m: Ahirbudhnya, the ancestors, the Viśvedevas, the moon, / Indra and Agni, the two Nāsatyas, and Bhaga of great might.

1.82.s:
iti dvādaśa te proktā mayā khaṇḍayugeśvarāḥ..
atha ṣaṣṭyabdanāmāni nibodha gadato mama .. 9 ..
1.82.d:
इति द्वादश ते प्रोक्ता मया खण्डयुगेश्वराः॥
अथ षष्ट्यब्दनामानि निबोध गदतो मम ॥ 9 ॥
1.82.m: Thus the twelve lords of the partial ages have been told to you by me. / Now understand from me as I recite the names of the sixty years.

1.82.s:
vartamāne tathā kalpe ṣaṣṭhe manvantare gate..
tasyaiva ca caturviṃśe rājaṃstretāyuge tadā .. 6 ...
1.82.d:
वर्तमाने तथा कल्पे षष्ठे मन्वन्तरे गते॥
तस्यैव च चतुर्विंशे राजंस्त्रेतायुगे तदा ॥ 6 ॥।
1.82.m: And in the present aeon, when the sixth manvantara had passed, / then in the twenty-fourth Tretā age of that very one, O king,

1.82.s:
yadā rāmeṇa samare sagaṇo rāvaṇo hataḥ ..
lakṣmaṇena tathā rājankumbhakarṇo nipātitaḥ .. 7 ..
1.82.d:
यदा रामेण समरे सगणो रावणो हतः ॥
लक्ष्मणेन तथा राजन्कुम्भकर्णो निपातितः ॥ 7 ॥
1.82.m: when Rāvaṇa along with his host was slain in battle by Rāma, / Kumbhakarṇa was struck down then by Lakṣmaṇa, O king.

1.82.s:
māghaśuklaṃ samārabhya candrārkau vāsavarkṣagau ..
jīvayuktau yadā syātāṃ ṣaṣṭyabdādistadā smṛtaḥ .. 8..
1.82.d:
माघशुक्लं समारभ्य चन्द्रार्कौ वासवर्क्षगौ ॥
जीवयुक्तौ यदा स्यातां षष्ट्यब्दादिस्तदा स्मृतः ॥ 8॥
1.82.m: Beginning with the bright [fortnight] of Māgha, when the moon and the sun are in the asterism of the Vasus / together with Jupiter, that is commemorated as the beginning of the sixty-year cycle.

1.82.s:
prabhavo vibhavaḥ śuklaḥ pramodaśca prajāpatiḥ..
vaiṣṇave tu yuge pañca proktāssaṃvatsarāśśubhāḥ . 9
1.82.d:
प्रभवो विभवः शुक्लः प्रमोदश्च प्रजापतिः॥
वैष्णवे तु युगे पञ्च प्रोक्तास्संवत्सराश्शुभाः । 9
1.82.m: Prabhava, Vibhava, Śukla, Pramoda, and Prajāpati— / five auspicious years are declared in the age of Viṣṇu.

1.82.s:
aṅgirā śrīmukho bhāvo yuvā dhātā tathaiva ca..
abdo jīvayuge pañca yeṣāmādyāśśubhāstrayaḥ..1.82.10..
1.82.d:
अङ्गिरा श्रीमुखो भावो युवा धाता तथैव च॥
अब्दो जीवयुगे पञ्च येषामाद्याश्शुभास्त्रयः॥1.82.10॥
1.82.m:
Aṅgiras, Śrīmukha, Bhāva, Yuvan, and likewise Dhātṛ:
these are the five years in the cycle of Jīva, of which the first three are auspicious.

1.82.s:
īśvaro bahudhānyaśca pramāthī vikramo vaśaḥ..
śakrābdāḥ pañca nirdiṣṭā yeṣāmādyāvubhau śubhau..11..
1.82.d:
ईश्वरो बहुधान्यश्च प्रमाथी विक्रमो वशः॥
शक्राब्दाः पञ्च निर्दिष्टा येषामाद्यावुभौ शुभौ॥11॥
1.82.m:
Īśvara, Bahudhānya, Pramāthin, Vikrama, and Vaśa:
these are designated as the five years of Śakra, of which the first two are auspicious.

1.82.s:
vahnissvabhānustaraṇo vāridaśca tathā'vyayaḥ ..
āgneyāḥ pañca nirdiṣṭā dvitīyaṃ teṣvaśobhanam .. 12 ..
1.82.d:
वह्निस्स्वभानुस्तरणो वारिदश्च तथाऽव्ययः ॥
आग्नेयाः पञ्च निर्दिष्टा द्वितीयं तेष्वशोभनम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.82.m:
Vahni, Svabhānu, Tāraṇa, Vārida, and Avyaya:
these are designated as the five belonging to Agni; among them, the second is inauspicious.

1.82.s:
sarvajitsarvadhārī ca virodhī vikṛtiḥ kharaḥ ..
tvāṣṭre pañca་ yuge teṣāṃ dvitīyaṃ tu śubhapradam .. 13 ...
1.82.d:
सर्वजित्सर्वधारी च विरोधी विकृतिः खरः ॥
त्वाष्ट्रे पञ्च་ युगे तेषां द्वितीयं तु शुभप्रदम् ॥ 13 ॥।
1.82.m:
Sarvajit, Sarvadhārin, Virodhin, Vikṛti, and Khara:
these five are in the cycle of Tvaṣṭṛ; among them, the second bestows auspiciousness.

1.82.s:
nandano vijayaścaiva jayaḥ kāmaśca durmukhaḥ ..
āhirbudhnye yuge pañca yeṣāmādyā hitāstrayaḥ ..14 ..
1.82.d:
नन्दनो विजयश्चैव जयः कामश्च दुर्मुखः ॥
आहिर्बुध्न्ये युगे पञ्च येषामाद्या हितास्त्रयः ॥14 ॥
1.82.m:
Nandana, Vijaya, Jaya, Kāma, and Durmukha:
these five are in the cycle of Ahirbudhnya, of which the first three are beneficial.

1.82.s:
hemamālī vilambī ca vikārī śarvarī plavaḥ ..
paitrye pañcayuge teṣāṃ pañcamaśca śubhapradaḥ .. 19..
1.82.d:
हेममाली विलम्बी च विकारी शर्वरी प्लवः ॥
पैत्र्ये पञ्चयुगे तेषां पञ्चमश्च शुभप्रदः ॥ 19॥
1.82.m:
Hemamālin, Vilambin, Vikārin, Śarvarī, and Plava:
these five are in the cycle of the Pitṛs; among them, the fifth bestows auspiciousness.

1.82.s:
śokakṛcchubhakṛtkrodhī viśvāvasuparāvasū ..
vaiśve pañca śubhā vaiṣāmabdau rājandvipaṃcamau ..16..
1.82.d:
शोककृच्छुभकृत्क्रोधी विश्वावसुपरावसू ॥
वैश्वे पञ्च शुभा वैषामब्दौ राजन्द्विपंचमौ ॥16॥
1.82.m:
Śokakṛt, Śubhakṛt, Krodhin, Viśvāvasu, and Parāvasu:
these five belong to the Viśvedevas; among these, O king, the second and fifth are auspicious.

1.82.s:
plavaṅgaḥ kīlakassaumyassomo rodhakṛdeva ca ..
saumye pañca śubhāveṣāṃ prathamānantarāvubhau ..17..
1.82.d:
प्लवङ्गः कीलकस्सौम्यस्सोमो रोधकृदेव च ॥
सौम्ये पञ्च शुभावेषां प्रथमानन्तरावुभौ ॥17॥
1.82.m:
Plavaṅga, Kīlaka, Saumya, Soma, and Rodhakṛt:
these five belong to Soma; among these, the two immediately following the first are auspicious.

1.82.s:
dhāvanaṃ mathanaṃ vīraṃ rākṣasaṃ cānalaṃ tathā ..
indrāgnidaivate pañca sarve eva śubhapradāḥ ..18..
1.82.d:
धावनं मथनं वीरं राक्षसं चानलं तथा ॥
इन्द्राग्निदैवते पञ्च सर्वे एव शुभप्रदाः ॥18॥
1.82.m:
Dhāvana, Mathana, Vīra, Rākṣasa, and Anala:
these five belong to the dual deity Indrāgnī; all of them bestow auspiciousness.

1.82.s:
piṅgalaḥ kālayuktaśca siddhārtho raudradurmatī ..
āśvine'pi yuge pañca caturthasteṣu śasyate ..19..
1.82.d:
पिङ्गलः कालयुक्तश्च सिद्धार्थो रौद्रदुर्मती ॥
आश्विनेऽपि युगे पञ्च चतुर्थस्तेषु शस्यते ॥19॥
1.82.m:
Piṅgala, Kālayukta, Siddhārtha, Raudra, and Durmati:
these five are in the cycle of the Aśvins; among them, the fourth is praised.

1.82.s:
dundubhyaṅgārakau raktaḥ krodhaścāpi kṣayastathā ..
bhāgye pañca śubhāssarve viśeṣeṇa tu pañcamaḥ .. 1.82.20 ...
1.82.d:
दुन्दुभ्यङ्गारकौ रक्तः क्रोधश्चापि क्षयस्तथा ॥
भाग्ये पञ्च शुभास्सर्वे विशेषेण तु पञ्चमः ॥ 1.82.20 ॥।
1.82.m:
Dundubhi, Aṅgāraka, Rakta, Krodha, and Kṣaya:
these five belong to Bhaga; all are auspicious, but especially the fifth.

1.82.s:
ataḥ paraṃ cāravaśāddevācāryasya pārthiva ..
dvādaśābdādhipāṃstubhyaṃ kathayāmi phalānvitān .. 21 ..
1.82.d:
अतः परं चारवशाद्देवाचार्यस्य पार्थिव ॥
द्वादशाब्दाधिपांस्तुभ्यं कथयामि फलान्वितान् ॥ 21 ॥
1.82.m:
Beyond this, according to the transit of the preceptor of the gods, O ruler of the earth,
I shall tell you of the lords of the twelve years, along with their fruits.

1.82.s:
āgneyakṣage jīve varṣaṃ syādvahnidaivatam ..
ahitaṃ tadvinirdiṣṭaṃ godvijāgnyupajīvinām ..22..
1.82.d:
आग्नेयक्षगे जीवे वर्षं स्याद्वह्निदैवतम् ॥
अहितं तद्विनिर्दिष्टं गोद्विजाग्न्युपजीविनाम् ॥22॥
1.82.m:
When Jīva enters the asterisms of Agni, the year belongs to the deity Vahni;
it is declared harmful to those who subsist by cattle, twice-born, and fire.

1.82.s:
saumyaraudropage jīve saumyavarṣamudāhṛtam ..
ītayassakalā yatra cānāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ tathā .. 23 ..
1.82.d:
सौम्यरौद्रोपगे जीवे सौम्यवर्षमुदाहृतम् ॥
ईतयस्सकला यत्र चानावृष्टिभयं तथा ॥ 23 ॥
1.82.m:
When Jīva enters the asterisms of Soma and Rudra, it is spoken of as a year of Soma,
in which there are all manner of pestilences and fear of drought.

1.82.s:
adityapuṣyage cābdo vijñeyo guru daivataḥ ..
śubhaṅkarī hito loke kṣemārogyasubhikṣadaḥ .. 24 ..
1.82.d:
अदित्यपुष्यगे चाब्दो विज्ञेयो गुरु दैवतः ॥
शुभङ्करी हितो लोके क्षेमारोग्यसुभिक्षदः ॥ 24 ॥
1.82.m:
When it enters the asterisms of Aditi and Puṣya, the year is known to have Guru as its deity;
it creates good, is beneficial to the world, and grants security, health, and abundance of food.

1.82.s:
sārpapaitryopage jīve paitryaṃ varpamudāhatam ..
hārdaṃ vṛṣṭipradaṃ loke śivasaubhikṣyakārakam .. 25 ..
1.82.d:
सार्पपैत्र्योपगे जीवे पैत्र्यं वर्पमुदाहतम् ॥
हार्दं वृष्टिप्रदं लोके शिवसौभिक्ष्यकारकम् ॥ 25 ॥
1.82.m:
When Jīva enters the asterisms of the Serpents and the Pitṛs, the year is spoken of as belonging to the Pitṛs;
it is beloved, brings rain to the world, and causes auspiciousness and abundance of food.

1.82.s:
phālgunīdvayahastasthe varṣaṃ bhāgyamudāhṛtam ..
cauraprābalyakaṃ ghoraṃ nārīdaurbalyakārakam .. 26 ..
1.82.d:
फाल्गुनीद्वयहस्तस्थे वर्षं भाग्यमुदाहृतम् ॥
चौरप्राबल्यकं घोरं नारीदौर्बल्यकारकम् ॥ 26 ॥
1.82.m:
When it stands in the two Phālgunīs and Hasta, the year is spoken of as belonging to Bhaga;
it brings a terrible prevalence of thieves and causes weakness in women.

1.82.s:
citrāsvātigate jīve tvāṣṭraḥ saṃvatsaraḥ śubhaḥ ..
śūkadhānyakṣayakaraḥ śibidhānyavivardhanaḥ .. 27 ..
1.82.d:
चित्रास्वातिगते जीवे त्वाष्ट्रः संवत्सरः शुभः ॥
शूकधान्यक्षयकरः शिबिधान्यविवर्धनः ॥ 27 ॥
1.82.m:
When Jīva enters Citrā and Svātī, the year belonging to Tvaṣṭṛ is auspicious;
it causes the destruction of awned grains and increases leguminous grains.

1.82.s:
indrāgnidaivataṃ jīve viśākhāmaitrasaṃsthite ..
yajñakriyāpravṛttānāṃ hitaṃ muditamānavam .. 28 ..
1.82.d:
इन्द्राग्निदैवतं जीवे विशाखामैत्रसंस्थिते ॥
यज्ञक्रियाप्रवृत्तानां हितं मुदितमानवम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.82.m:
The year belonging to Indrāgnī occurs when Jīva stands in Viśākhā and Maitra;
it is beneficial to those engaged in sacrificial rites and makes humanity glad.

1.82.s:
jyeṣṭhāmūlagate jīve śāktamabdamudāhṛtam ..
śūkadhānyakṣayakaraṃ bhūtānāṃ bhayavardhanam .. 29 ..
1.82.d:
ज्येष्ठामूलगते जीवे शाक्तमब्दमुदाहृतम् ॥
शूकधान्यक्षयकरं भूतानां भयवर्धनम् ॥ 29 ॥
1.82.m:
When Jīva enters Jyeṣṭhā and Mūla, the year is spoken of as belonging to Śakra;
it causes the destruction of awned grains and increases fear among living beings.

1.82.s:
āṣāḍhādvayage jīve vaiśvadevamudāhṛtam ..
nāśubhaṃ na śubhaṃ loke rājñāṃ vigrahakārakam .. 1.82.30 ..
1.82.d:
आषाढाद्वयगे जीवे वैश्वदेवमुदाहृतम् ॥
नाशुभं न शुभं लोके राज्ञां विग्रहकारकम् ॥ 1.82.30 ॥
1.82.m:
When Jīva enters the two Āṣāḍhās, it is spoken of as belonging to the Viśvedevas;
it is neither inauspicious nor auspicious in the world, and causes conflict among kings.

1.82.s:
viṣṇuvāsavasaṃsthe tu vaiṣṇavaṃ parikīrtitam ..
kṣemasaubhikṣadaṃ loke pāṣaṃḍiparipīḍanam .. 31 ..
1.82.d:
विष्णुवासवसंस्थे तु वैष्णवं परिकीर्तितम् ॥
क्षेमसौभिक्षदं लोके पाषंडिपरिपीडनम् ॥ 31 ॥
1.82.m:
When it stands in the asterisms of Viṣṇu and the Vasus, it is proclaimed to belong to Viṣṇu;
it grants security and abundance of food in the world, and torments heretics.

1.82.s:
proṣṭhapadādvayagate jīve vāruṇasaṃsthite ..
pūrvadhānyapradaṃ tvājaṃ paścāddhānyavināśanam .. 32 ..
1.82.d:
प्रोष्ठपदाद्वयगते जीवे वारुणसंस्थिते ॥
पूर्वधान्यप्रदं त्वाजं पश्चाद्धान्यविनाशनम् ॥ 32 ॥
1.82.m:
When Jīva enters the two Proṣṭhapadās and stands in the asterism of Varuṇa,
the year belonging to Aja grants the early grains, but afterwards destroys the crops.

1.82.s:
pauṣṇāśviyāmyage jīve varṣaṃ syādaśvidaivatam ..
suvṛṣṭikṣemadaṃ loke sarvātaṅkavivarjitam .. 33 ..
1.82.d:
पौष्णाश्वियाम्यगे जीवे वर्षं स्यादश्विदैवतम् ॥
सुवृष्टिक्षेमदं लोके सर्वातङ्कविवर्जितम् ॥ 33 ॥
1.82.m:
When Jīva enters the asterisms of Pūṣan, the Aśvins, and Yama, the year has the Aśvins as its deities;
it brings abundant rain and security to the world, and is devoid of all distress.

1.82.s:
caitraśuklasamārambhe jagatāṃ jagadīśvara ..
sarvaṃ cakre tadā rājam̐statastasminsadā dine .. 34 ..
1.82.d:
चैत्रशुक्लसमारम्भे जगतां जगदीश्वर ॥
सर्वं चक्रे तदा राजम्̐स्ततस्तस्मिन्सदा दिने ॥ 34 ॥
1.82.m:
At the beginning of the bright [half] of Caitra, O lord of the world,
Brahmā fashioned all the worlds then, O king; therefore on that day always,

1.82.s:
saṃvatsareśaḥ kriyate brahmaṇā tu sadā grahaḥ ..
nāgo yajñaśca dharmajña gandharvaśca tathaiva ca .. 35 ..
1.82.d:
संवत्सरेशः क्रियते ब्रह्मणा तु सदा ग्रहः ॥
नागो यज्ञश्च धर्मज्ञ गन्धर्वश्च तथैव च ॥ 35 ॥
1.82.m:
the lord of the year is always appointed by Brahmā as a planet,
as well as a serpent, a sacrifice, O knower of dharma, and likewise a gandharva.

1.82.s:
sapta cchinne tu yaḥ śleṣaḥ kalipātasamāgaṇe ..
ādityādissa boddhavyo grahaḥ saṃvatsarādhipaḥ .. 36 ..
1.82.d:
सप्त च्छिन्ने तु यः श्लेषः कलिपातसमागणे ॥
आदित्यादिस्स बोद्धव्यो ग्रहः संवत्सराधिपः ॥ 36 ॥
1.82.m:
When divided by seven, whatever is the remainder in the sum of elapsed years of Kali,
that planet, beginning with the Sun, should be understood as the ruler of the year.

1.82.s:
ādityena sahānanto nāgo bhavati bhūmipa ..
citrāṅgadaśca gandharvo dīrghabhadro niśācaraḥ ..37..
1.82.d:
आदित्येन सहानन्तो नागो भवति भूमिप ॥
चित्राङ्गदश्च गन्धर्वो दीर्घभद्रो निशाचरः ॥37॥
1.82.m:
Together with the Sun, the serpent is Ananta, O ruler of the earth,
the gandharva is Citrāṅgada, and the night-wanderer is Dīrghabhadra.

1.82.s:
saumyena vāsukirnāgaḥ pūrṇabhadro niśācaraḥ ..
citrasenaśca gandharvaḥ samāścāmī prakīrtitāḥ ..38..
1.82.d:
सौम्येन वासुकिर्नागः पूर्णभद्रो निशाचरः ॥
चित्रसेनश्च गन्धर्वः समाश्चामी प्रकीर्तिताः ॥38॥
1.82.m:
With the Moon, the serpent is Vāsuki, the night-wanderer is Pūrṇabhadra,
and the gandharva is Citrasena; these are proclaimed for that year.

1.82.s:
bhaumena takṣako nāgo maṇibhadro niśācaraḥ ..
tadā citraratho nāma gandharvaścābhiṣicyate .. 39 ..
1.82.d:
भौमेन तक्षको नागो मणिभद्रो निशाचरः ॥
तदा चित्ररथो नाम गन्धर्वश्चाभिषिच्यते ॥ 39 ॥
1.82.m:
With Mars, the serpent is Takṣaka, and the night-wanderer is Maṇibhadra;
then the gandharva named Citraratha is consecrated.

1.82.s:
budhena nāgaḥ kārkoṭo yakṣabhadro niśācaraḥ ..
tumbururnāma gandharvaḥ samāsvāmyabhiṣicyate..1.82.40..
1.82.d:
बुधेन नागः कार्कोटो यक्षभद्रो निशाचरः ॥
तुम्बुरुर्नाम गन्धर्वः समास्वाम्यभिषिच्यते॥1.82.40॥
1.82.m:
With Mercury, the serpent is Kārkoṭa, and the night-wanderer is Yakṣabhadra;
the gandharva named Tumburu is consecrated as master of the year.

1.82.s:
jīvena nāgaḥ padmastu dīrghabāhurniśācaraḥ ..
gandharvaśca mahātejāstathā śāliśiraḥ prabhuḥ .. .. 41 ..
1.82.d:
जीवेन नागः पद्मस्तु दीर्घबाहुर्निशाचरः ॥
गन्धर्वश्च महातेजास्तथा शालिशिरः प्रभुः ॥ ॥ 41 ॥
1.82.m:
With Jīva, the serpent is Padma, and the night-wanderer is Dīrghabāhu;
and the gandharva is the lord Śāliśiras, possessed of great splendor.

1.82.s:
mahāpadmastu śukreṇa nāgo bhavati bhūpate ..
nāradaścaiva gandharvo mahābāhurniśācaraḥ .. 42 ..
1.82.d:
महापद्मस्तु शुक्रेण नागो भवति भूपते ॥
नारदश्चैव गन्धर्वो महाबाहुर्निशाचरः ॥ 42 ॥
1.82.m:
With Venus, O king, the serpent is Mahāpadma,
the gandharva is Nārada, and the night-wanderer is Mahābāhu.

1.82.s:
saureṇa nāgaḥ śaṅkhastu mahākarṇo niśācaraḥ ..
ūrṇāyuścaiva gandharvaḥ samāsvāmyabhiṣicyate .. 43 ..
1.82.d:
सौरेण नागः शङ्खस्तु महाकर्णो निशाचरः ॥
ऊर्णायुश्चैव गन्धर्वः समास्वाम्यभिषिच्यते ॥ 43 ॥
1.82.m:
With Saturn, the serpent is Śaṅkha, and the night-wanderer is Mahākarṇa;
and the gandharva Ūrṇāyu is consecrated as master of the year.

1.82.s:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi samārūpaṃ mahīpate ..
grahasvāmibhavaṃ tubhyaṃ śeṣāssarve tadāśrayāḥ .. 44 ..
1.82.d:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि समारूपं महीपते ॥
ग्रहस्वामिभवं तुभ्यं शेषास्सर्वे तदाश्रयाः ॥ 44 ॥
1.82.m:
Hereafter I shall tell you, O king, the nature of the year
arising from the planetary lord; all the rest depend upon that.

1.82.s:
tīkṣṇārkastvalpamatsyaśca gatamegho'tibhāskaraḥ ..
bahunāgavyādhigaṇo bhāskarābdo raṇākulaḥ..45..
1.82.d:
तीक्ष्णार्कस्त्वल्पमत्स्यश्च गतमेघोऽतिभास्करः ॥
बहुनागव्याधिगणो भास्कराब्दो रणाकुलः॥45॥
1.82.m:
The year of the Sun has fierce sunshine, few fish, departed clouds, intense light,
and hosts of many serpents and hunters, and is troubled by war.

1.82.s:
bahuvarṣo'tisasyaśca gavākṣīrapradāyakaḥ..
candrābdaḥ kāmināmiṣṭaḥ cityaṅkitamahītalaḥ .. 46 ..
1.82.d:
बहुवर्षोऽतिसस्यश्च गवाक्षीरप्रदायकः॥
चन्द्राब्दः कामिनामिष्टः चित्यङ्कितमहीतलः ॥ 46 ॥
1.82.m:
The year of the Moon brings much rain, abundant crops, yields milk from cows,
is dear to lovers, and has the surface of the earth marked by sacrificial altars.

1.82.s:
agnitaskararogāḍhyo nṛpavigrahadāyakaḥ ..
gatasasyo bahuvyālo bhaumābdo bālahā bhṛśam ..47..
1.82.d:
अग्नितस्कररोगाढ्यो नृपविग्रहदायकः ॥
गतसस्यो बहुव्यालो भौमाब्दो बालहा भृशम् ॥47॥
1.82.m:
The year of Mars is filled with fire, thieves, and diseases, causes conflicts among kings,
has perished crops, many wild beasts, and severely slays children.

1.82.s:
viprakṣatriyasasyānāṃ janānāṃ ca kalābhṛtām ..
buddhiprado'bdo bauddhastu bahusasyākaraḥ kṣitau .. 48 ..
1.82.d:
विप्रक्षत्रियसस्यानां जनानां च कलाभृताम् ॥
बुद्धिप्रदोऽब्दो बौद्धस्तु बहुसस्याकरः क्षितौ ॥ 48 ॥
1.82.m:
The year of Mercury grants intellect to brahmins, kṣatriyas, and people who practice the arts,
and produces an abundance of crops upon the earth.

1.82.s:
bahuyajño'tisasyaśca gogajāśvahitastathā ..
bahuvṛṣṭipradaḥ saumyo jīvābdo dvijapuṣṭidaḥ .. 49 ..
1.82.d:
बहुयज्ञोऽतिसस्यश्च गोगजाश्वहितस्तथा ॥
बहुवृष्टिप्रदः सौम्यो जीवाब्दो द्विजपुष्टिदः ॥ 49 ॥
1.82.m:
The year of Jīva has many sacrifices, abundant crops, benefits cows, elephants, and horses,
brings much rain, is gentle, and nourishes the twice-born.

1.82.s:
sasyāḍhyo dharmabahulo gatātaṃko bahūdakaḥ ..
kāmināṃ kāmadaḥ kāmaḥ sitābdo nṛpaśarmadaḥ .. 1.82.50 ..
1.82.d:
सस्याढ्यो धर्मबहुलो गतातंको बहूदकः ॥
कामिनां कामदः कामः सिताब्दो नृपशर्मदः ॥ 1.82.50 ॥
1.82.m:
The year of Venus is rich in crops, full of dharma, free of distress, has abundant water,
fulfills desires for lovers, is desirable, and grants comfort to kings.

1.82.s:
durbhikṣamarakānrogānkaroti pavanastathā ..
śanaiścarābdaḥ śokāṃśca vigrahāṇi ca bhūbhujām .. 51 ..
1.82.d:
दुर्भिक्षमरकान्रोगान्करोति पवनस्तथा ॥
शनैश्चराब्दः शोकांश्च विग्रहाणि च भूभुजाम् ॥ 51 ॥
1.82.m:
The year of Saturn causes famine, pestilences, diseases, winds,
sorrows, and conflicts among rulers of the earth.

1.82.s:
krameṇa parivarttante pañca yādava vatsarāḥ ..
teṣāmadhipatīnvakṣye nāmāni ca phalāni ca .. 52 ..
1.82.d:
क्रमेण परिवर्त्तन्ते पञ्च यादव वत्सराः ॥
तेषामधिपतीन्वक्ष्ये नामानि च फलानि च ॥ 52 ॥
1.82.m:
In succession, O Yādava, the five years revolve;
I shall tell of their lords, their names, and their fruits.

1.82.s:
pañca bhakte tu yaccheṣaṃ tiṣṭhedabdagaṇe gate ..
saṃvatsarādyaḥ saṃjñeyo nityaṃ saṃvatsaro budhaiḥ .. 53 ..
1.82.d:
पञ्च भक्ते तु यच्छेषं तिष्ठेदब्दगणे गते ॥
संवत्सराद्यः संज्ञेयो नित्यं संवत्सरो बुधैः ॥ 53 ॥
1.82.m:
When divided by five, whatever remainder stands from the group of elapsed years,
the wise should always understand the first year beginning with Saṃvatsara.

1.82.s:
ādyaḥ saṃvatsaro nāma dvitīyaḥ parivatsaraḥ ..
iḍākhyaśca tṛtīyo'tra caturthaścānuvatsaraḥ ..
idvatsarākhyaḥ kathitaḥ tathā caivātra pañcamaḥ .. 54 ..
1.82.d:
आद्यः संवत्सरो नाम द्वितीयः परिवत्सरः ॥
इडाख्यश्च तृतीयोऽत्र चतुर्थश्चानुवत्सरः ॥
इद्वत्सराख्यः कथितः तथा चैवात्र पञ्चमः ॥ 54 ॥
1.82.m: The first is named Saṃvatsara, the second is Parivatsara, / and the third here is named Iḍā, while the fourth is Anuvatsara; / and the fifth here is declared to be named Idvatsara.

1.82.s:
saṃvatsaro'gniḥ parivatsaro'rka iḍābhidhāno bhagavāñchaśāṅkaḥ ..
brahmā svayaṃbhūranuvatsaro'pi idvatsaraḥ śailasutāpatiśca .. 55 ..
1.82.d:
संवत्सरोऽग्निः परिवत्सरोऽर्क इडाभिधानो भगवाञ्छशाङ्कः ॥
ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूरनुवत्सरोऽपि इद्वत्सरः शैलसुतापतिश्च ॥ 55 ॥
1.82.m: Saṃvatsara is Agni, Parivatsara is the Sun, the one named Iḍā is the lord Moon, / Anuvatsara is Brahmā the Self-existent, and Idvatsara is the husband of the daughter of the Mountain [Śiva].

1.82.s:
vṛṣṭiḥ samākhye kathitā dvitīye prabhūtatoyā kathitā tṛtīye ..
paścājjalaṃ muñcati yaścaturthaḥ svalpodakaṃ paṃcamamabdamuktam .. 56 ..
1.82.d:
वृष्टिः समाख्ये कथिता द्वितीये प्रभूततोया कथिता तृतीये ॥
पश्चाज्जलं मुञ्चति यश्चतुर्थः स्वल्पोदकं पंचममब्दमुक्तम् ॥ 56 ॥
1.82.m: Rain is declared in the second, named [Parivatsara]; abundant water is declared in the third; / the fourth is one that releases water late; and the fifth year is said to have very little water.

1.83.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
uttaraṃ tvayanaṃ divyaṃ paitryaṃ syāddakṣiṇāyanam ..
vasantaścāgnidaivatyaḥ śākro grīṣma udāhṛtaḥ .. 1 ..
1.83.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
उत्तरं त्वयनं दिव्यं पैत्र्यं स्याद्दक्षिणायनम् ॥
वसन्तश्चाग्निदैवत्यः शाक्रो ग्रीष्म उदाहृतः ॥ 1 ॥
1.83.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The northern course of the sun (uttarāyaṇa) is divine, while the southern course (dakṣiṇāyana) belongs to the ancestors; / spring has Agni as its deity, and summer is declared to belong to Śakra;

1.83.s:
vaiśvadevī tathā prāvṛṭprājāpatyā śaratsmṛtā ..
hemanto vaiṣṇavaḥ prokto mārutaḥ śiśiraḥ smṛtaḥ .. 2 ..
1.83.d:
वैश्वदेवी तथा प्रावृट्प्राजापत्या शरत्स्मृता ॥
हेमन्तो वैष्णवः प्रोक्तो मारुतः शिशिरः स्मृतः ॥ 2 ॥
1.83.m: the rainy season belongs to the Viśvedevas, autumn is remembered as belonging to Prajāpati, / winter (hemanta) is declared to belong to Viṣṇu, and the cold season (śiśira) is remembered as belonging to Vāyu.

1.83.s:
tvāṣṭraścaitrastu vaiśākho māsaścaivāgnidaivataḥ ..
jyeṣṭhaśśākrassmṛto māsa āṣāḍho vaiśvadaivataḥ ..3..
1.83.d:
त्वाष्ट्रश्चैत्रस्तु वैशाखो मासश्चैवाग्निदैवतः ॥
ज्येष्ठश्शाक्रस्स्मृतो मास आषाढो वैश्वदैवतः ॥3॥
1.83.m: Caitra belongs to Tvaṣṭṛ, and the month of Vaiśākha has Agni as its deity; / Jyeṣṭha is remembered as belonging to Śakra, and Āṣāḍha has the Viśvedevas as its deities;

1.83.s:
śrāvaṇo viśvadaivatya ājo bhādrapadastathā..
aśvayuktāśvino māsa āgneyaḥ kārttikaḥ smṛtaḥ 4...
1.83.d:
श्रावणो विश्वदैवत्य आजो भाद्रपदस्तथा॥
अश्वयुक्ताश्विनो मास आग्नेयः कार्त्तिकः स्मृतः 4॥।
1.83.m: Śrāvaṇa has the Viśvedevas as its deity, and Bhādrapada belongs to Aja Ekapād; / the month of Āśvina belongs to the Aśvins, and Kārttika is remembered as belonging to Agni;

1.83.s:
mārgaśīrṣastathā saumyaḥ pauṣasyājjīvadaivataḥ..
paitryo māsassmṛto māghaḥ phālguno bhagadaivataḥ..5..
1.83.d:
मार्गशीर्षस्तथा सौम्यः पौषस्याज्जीवदैवतः॥
पैत्र्यो मासस्स्मृतो माघः फाल्गुनो भगदैवतः॥5॥
1.83.m: Mārgaśīrṣa likewise belongs to Soma, Pauṣa belongs to Bṛhaspati, / the month of Māgha is remembered as belonging to the ancestors, and Phālguna has Bhaga as its deity.

1.83.s:
māseṣu māsadaivatyā śuklapakṣāḥ prakīrttitāḥ..
vakṣyāmi kṛṣṇapakṣāṇāṃ daivatāni tavānagha .. 6 ..
1.83.d:
मासेषु मासदैवत्या शुक्लपक्षाः प्रकीर्त्तिताः॥
वक्ष्यामि कृष्णपक्षाणां दैवतानि तवानघ ॥ 6 ॥
1.83.m: Among the months, the bright fortnights are proclaimed to have the deities of those months; / I will tell you, O sinless one, the deities of the dark fortnights.

1.83.s:
caitro yāmyassmṛto rājannāgneyaścāpyanantaraḥ ..
jyeṣṭho raudraḥ smṛtaḥ pakṣastvāṣāḍhaḥ sārpa ucyate .. 7 ..
1.83.d:
चैत्रो याम्यस्स्मृतो राजन्नाग्नेयश्चाप्यनन्तरः ॥
ज्येष्ठो रौद्रः स्मृतः पक्षस्त्वाषाढः सार्प उच्यते ॥ 7 ॥
1.83.m: Caitra is remembered as belonging to Yama, O king, and the subsequent one belongs to Agni; / the fortnight of Jyeṣṭha is remembered as belonging to Rudra, and Āṣāḍha is said to belong to the Serpents;

1.83.s:
paitraśca śrāvaṇo māsaḥ sāvitraścāpyanantaraḥ ..
maitraścāśvayujo māsaḥ śākraścāpyagnidaivataḥ .. 8 ..
1.83.d:
पैत्रश्च श्रावणो मासः सावित्रश्चाप्यनन्तरः ॥
मैत्रश्चाश्वयुजो मासः शाक्रश्चाप्यग्निदैवतः ॥ 8 ॥
1.83.m: the month of Śrāvaṇa belongs to the ancestors, and the subsequent one belongs to Savitṛ; / the month of Āśvina belongs to Mitra, and [the dark fortnight of] Kārttika has Agni as its deity;

1.83.s:
tathā ca nairṛtaḥ saumyaḥ pauṣaḥ syādviṣṇudaivataḥ ..
vāruṇaśca tathā paitraḥ phālgunaḥ pauṣṇa ucyate .. 9 ..
1.83.d:
तथा च नैरृतः सौम्यः पौषः स्याद्विष्णुदैवतः ॥
वारुणश्च तथा पैत्रः फाल्गुनः पौष्ण उच्यते ॥ 9 ॥
1.83.m: Mārgaśīrṣa belongs to Nirṛti, Pauṣa belongs to Viṣṇu, / Māgha belongs to Varuṇa, and Phālguna is said to belong to Pūṣan.

1.83.s:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yaddevo yadgrahaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
agnirarkassmṛtassomo varuṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ..1.83.10..
1.83.d:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि यद्देवो यद्ग्रहः स्मृतः ॥
अग्निरर्कस्स्मृतस्सोमो वरुणः परिकीर्तितः॥1.83.10॥
1.83.m: Hereafter I shall declare which planet is considered to correspond to which deity: / the Sun is remembered as Agni, and the Moon is proclaimed to be Varuṇa;

1.83.s:
aṅgārakaḥ kumāraśca budhaśca bhagavānhariḥ ..
bṛhaspatissmṛtaḥ śakraḥ śukro devī ca pārvatī .. 11 ..
1.83.d:
अङ्गारकः कुमारश्च बुधश्च भगवान्हरिः ॥
बृहस्पतिस्स्मृतः शक्रः शुक्रो देवी च पार्वती ॥ 11 ॥
1.83.m: Mars is Kumāra, and Mercury is the blessed Hari; / Jupiter is remembered as Śakra, and Venus is the goddess Pārvatī;

1.83.s:
prajāpatiśśanaiścāro rāhujñeṃyo gaṇādhipaḥ ..
viśvakarmā smṛtaḥ keturye grahāste puraḥ smṛtāḥ .. 12 ..
1.83.d:
प्रजापतिश्शनैश्चारो राहुज्ञेंयो गणाधिपः ॥
विश्वकर्मा स्मृतः केतुर्ये ग्रहास्ते पुरः स्मृताः ॥ 12 ॥
1.83.m: Saturn is Prajāpati, Rāhu is known as the lord of the Gaṇas [Gaṇeśa], / and Ketu is remembered as Viśvakarman; these are remembered above as the planets.

1.83.s:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tava nakṣatradaivatāḥ ..
kṛttikā cāgnidaivatyā rohiṇyarkeśvarā smṛtā .. 13 ..
1.83.d:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि तव नक्षत्रदैवताः ॥
कृत्तिका चाग्निदैवत्या रोहिण्यर्केश्वरा स्मृता ॥ 13 ॥
1.83.m: Hereafter I shall declare to you the deities of the lunar mansions (nakṣatras): / Kṛttikā has Agni as its deity, and Rohiṇī is remembered as having Prajāpati as its lord;

1.83.s:
indvarkṣaḥ saumyadaivatyo raudrī ārdrā tathā smṛtā ..
punarvasustathādityo puṣyaśca gurudaivataḥ .. 14 ..
1.83.d:
इन्द्वर्क्षः सौम्यदैवत्यो रौद्री आर्द्रा तथा स्मृता ॥
पुनर्वसुस्तथादित्यो पुष्यश्च गुरुदैवतः ॥ 14 ॥
1.83.m: Mṛgaśīrṣa has Soma as its deity, and Ārdrā is likewise remembered as belonging to Rudra; / Punarvasu belongs to Aditi, and Puṣya has Guru [Bṛhaspati] as its deity;

1.83.s:
āśleṣā sarpadaivatyā maghā ca pitṛdaivatā ..
bhāgyāśca pūrvaphālgunya āryamāśca tathottarāḥ .. 15 ..
1.83.d:
आश्लेषा सर्पदैवत्या मघा च पितृदैवता ॥
भाग्याश्च पूर्वफाल्गुन्य आर्यमाश्च तथोत्तराः ॥ 15 ॥
1.83.m: Āśleṣā has the Serpents as deities, and Maghā has the ancestors as deities; / Pūrvaphālgunī belongs to Bhaga, and Uttaraphālgunī belongs to Aryaman;

1.83.s:
sāvitraśca tathā hastaścitrā tvāṣṭrī prakīrtitā ..
svātiśca vāyudaivatyā nakṣatre parikīrtitā .. 16 ..
1.83.d:
सावित्रश्च तथा हस्तश्चित्रा त्वाष्ट्री प्रकीर्तिता ॥
स्वातिश्च वायुदैवत्या नक्षत्रे परिकीर्तिता ॥ 16 ॥
1.83.m: Hasta belongs to Savitṛ, Citrā is proclaimed to belong to Tvaṣṭṛ, / and the lunar mansion Svātī is proclaimed to have Vāyu as its deity;

1.83.s:
indrāgnīdaivatā proktā viśākhā yadunandana ..
maitramṛkṣamanūrādhā śākraṃ jyeṣṭhā prakīrtitā .. 17 ..
1.83.d:
इन्द्राग्नीदैवता प्रोक्ता विशाखा यदुनन्दन ॥
मैत्रमृक्षमनूराधा शाक्रं ज्येष्ठा प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 17 ॥
1.83.m: Viśākhā is declared to have Indra and Agni as deities, O delight of the Yadus; / Anurādhā is the mansion belonging to Mitra, and Jyeṣṭhā is proclaimed to belong to Śakra;

1.83.s:
tathā nairṛtyadaivatyo mūlañca tadudāhṛtam ..
āpyastvāṣāḍhapūrvāḥ syuścottarā vaiśvadaivatāḥ .. 18 ..
1.83.d:
तथा नैरृत्यदैवत्यो मूलञ्च तदुदाहृतम् ॥
आप्यस्त्वाषाढपूर्वाः स्युश्चोत्तरा वैश्वदैवताः ॥ 18 ॥
1.83.m: Mūla is declared to have Nirṛti as its deity; / Pūrvāṣāḍhā belongs to Āpas (the Waters), and Uttarāṣāḍhā has the Viśvedevas as deities;

1.83.s:
brāhmī caivābhijitproktā śravaṇo vaiṣṇavaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
vāsavaṃ ca tathā ṛkṣaṃ dhaniṣṭhā procyate budhaiḥ .. 19 ..
1.83.d:
ब्राह्मी चैवाभिजित्प्रोक्ता श्रवणो वैष्णवः स्मृतः ॥
वासवं च तथा ऋक्षं धनिष्ठा प्रोच्यते बुधैः ॥ 19 ॥
1.83.m: Abhijit is declared to belong to Brahmā, Śravaṇa is remembered as belonging to Viṣṇu, / and Dhaniṣṭhā is proclaimed by the wise to be the mansion belonging to the Vasus;

1.83.s:
tathā śatabhiṣakproktaṃ nakṣatre vāruṇaṃ nṛpa ..
ājaṃ bhadrāpadāpūrvā āhirbudhnyaṃ tathottarā .. 1.83.20 ..
1.83.d:
तथा शतभिषक्प्रोक्तं नक्षत्रे वारुणं नृप ॥
आजं भद्रापदापूर्वा आहिर्बुध्न्यं तथोत्तरा ॥ 1.83.20 ॥
1.83.m: Śatabhiṣaj is declared to be the lunar mansion belonging to Varuṇa, O king; / Pūrvabhādrapadā belongs to Aja Ekapād, and Uttarabhādrapadā belongs to Ahirbudhnya;

1.83.s:
pauṣṇaṃ ca revatī cārkṣamaśvinī cāśvidaivatam ..
bharaṇyaśca tathā yāmya proktāste ṛkṣadaivatāḥ .. 21 ..
1.83.d:
पौष्णं च रेवती चार्क्षमश्विनी चाश्विदैवतम् ॥
भरण्यश्च तथा याम्य प्रोक्तास्ते ऋक्षदैवताः ॥ 21 ॥
1.83.m: the mansion Revatī belongs to Pūṣan, and Aśvinī has the Aśvins as deities; / Bharaṇī belongs to Yama: thus are declared the deities of the lunar mansions.

1.83.s:
brahmā prajāpatirviṣṇuryamassomastathaiva ca ..
kumāro munayassapta hyaṣṭau ca manavastathā .. 22 ..
1.83.d:
ब्रह्मा प्रजापतिर्विष्णुर्यमस्सोमस्तथैव च ॥
कुमारो मुनयस्सप्त ह्यष्टौ च मनवस्तथा ॥ 22 ॥
1.83.m: Brahmā, Prajāpati, Viṣṇu, Yama, and likewise Soma, / Kumāra, the seven sages, and the eight Manus,

1.83.s:
piśācaśca tathā dharmo rudrāścaikādaśa smṛtāḥ ..
ādityā dvādaśa tathā kāmadevastathaiva ca .. 23 ..
1.83.d:
पिशाचश्च तथा धर्मो रुद्राश्चैकादश स्मृताः ॥
आदित्या द्वादश तथा कामदेवस्तथैव च ॥ 23 ॥
1.83.m: Piśāca, Dharma, and the eleven Rudras are remembered, / as well as the twelve Ādityas, and Kāmadeva,

1.83.s:
yakṣāśca pitaraścaiva pratipatprabhṛtirnṛpa ..
tithīśvarāstathā proktā karaṇānnāmataḥ śṛṇu .. 24 ..
1.83.d:
यक्षाश्च पितरश्चैव प्रतिपत्प्रभृतिर्नृप ॥
तिथीश्वरास्तथा प्रोक्ता करणान्नामतः शृणु ॥ 24 ॥
1.83.m: and the Yakṣas, and the ancestors, beginning with the first lunar day (pratipad), O king, / are thus declared to be the lords of the lunar days (tithis). Now hear the divisions of the half-day (karaṇas) by name.

1.83.s:
tithyardhabhogi karaṇaṃ sadā bhavati pārthiva ..
sthirāṇi teṣāṃ catvāri sapta viddhi carāṇi ca .. 25 ..
1.83.d:
तिथ्यर्धभोगि करणं सदा भवति पार्थिव ॥
स्थिराणि तेषां चत्वारि सप्त विद्धि चराणि च ॥ 25 ॥
1.83.m: A karaṇa always endures for half a lunar day, O earth-ruler; / know that four of them are fixed and seven are movable.

1.83.s:
ante kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ dvitīye śakuniḥ smṛtaḥ ..
prathame pañcadaśyardhe kṛṣṇe proktaṃ catuṣpadam .. 26 ..
1.83.d:
अन्ते कृष्णचतुर्दश्यां द्वितीये शकुनिः स्मृतः ॥
प्रथमे पञ्चदश्यर्धे कृष्णे प्रोक्तं चतुष्पदम् ॥ 26 ॥
1.83.m: At the end, on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, in the second half, Śakuni is remembered; / in the first half of the fifteenth day in the dark fortnight, Catuṣpada is declared;

1.83.s:
tasyaiva cāpare rājannāgākhyaṃ karaṇaṃ matam ..
śuklapratipadārdhe tu kiṃstughnaṃ karaṇaṃ matam ..27..
1.83.d:
तस्यैव चापरे राजन्नागाख्यं करणं मतम् ॥
शुक्लप्रतिपदार्धे तु किंस्तुघ्नं करणं मतम् ॥27॥
1.83.m: and in the second half of that same [day], O king, the karaṇa named Nāga is accepted; / in the first half of the bright pratipad, the karaṇa Kiṃstughna is accepted.

1.83.s:
etāni rājanproktāni sthirāṇi karaṇāni tu ..
kalirdharmastathā sarpo yeṣāṃ vāyuśca daivatama..28..
1.83.d:
एतानि राजन्प्रोक्तानि स्थिराणि करणानि तु ॥
कलिर्धर्मस्तथा सर्पो येषां वायुश्च दैवतम॥28॥
1.83.m: These, O king, are declared to be the fixed karaṇas, / whose deities are Kali, Dharma, the Serpent, and Vāyu.

1.83.s: śuklapratipādārdhe tu dvitīye yadunandana..29..
1.83.d: शुक्लप्रतिपादार्धे तु द्वितीये यदुनन्दन॥29॥
1.83.m: Now, in the second half of the bright pratipad, O delight of the Yadus,

1.83.s:
pañcamyāṃ ca tathā hyardhe tvaṣṭamyāṃ ca tathā pare ..
dvādaśyardhe tathā pūrve paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā pare..1.83.30..
1.83.d:
पञ्चम्यां च तथा ह्यर्धे त्वष्टम्यां च तथा परे ॥
द्वादश्यर्धे तथा पूर्वे पौर्णमास्यां तथा परे॥1.83.30॥
1.83.m: and likewise in the [first] half of the fifth, and in the second [half] of the eighth, / and in the first half of the twelfth, and in the second [half] of the full-moon day,

1.83.s:
kṛṣṇapakṣacaturthyāṃ tu prathame'rdhe tathaiva ca ..
saptamyāṃ cāpare tvardhe hyekādaśyāṃ tathādyake..31..
1.83.d:
कृष्णपक्षचतुर्थ्यां तु प्रथमेऽर्धे तथैव च ॥
सप्तम्यां चापरे त्वर्धे ह्येकादश्यां तथाद्यके॥31॥
1.83.m: and on the fourth day of the dark fortnight, in the first half likewise, / and in the second half of the seventh, and in the first [half] of the eleventh:

1.83.s:
karaṇaṃ tu bavaṃ nāma kathitaṃ śakradaivatam ..
dvitīyārdhe tathādye tu pañcamyarthe tathā pare .. 32 ..
1.83.d:
करणं तु बवं नाम कथितं शक्रदैवतम् ॥
द्वितीयार्धे तथाद्ये तु पञ्चम्यर्थे तथा परे ॥ 32 ॥
1.83.m: the karaṇa named Bava is declared to have Śakra as its deity. / In the second half of the second [lunar day], and in the first half of the third, and in the second half of the fifth,

1.83.s:
naktasyardhe tathā pūrve dvādaśyardhe tathā pare ..
kṛṣṇapratipadādyārdhe caturthyardhe tathā pare..33..
1.83.d:
नक्तस्यर्धे तथा पूर्वे द्वादश्यर्धे तथा परे ॥
कृष्णप्रतिपदाद्यार्धे चतुर्थ्यर्धे तथा परे॥33॥
1.83.m: and in the first half of the ninth, and in the second half of the twelfth, / in the first half of the dark pratipad, and in the second half of the fourth,

1.83.s:
aṣṭamyardhe tathā pūrve hyekādaśyāṃ tathāpare ..
bālavaṃ nāma karaṇaṃ kathitaṃ brahmadaivatam .. 34 ..
1.83.d:
अष्टम्यर्धे तथा पूर्वे ह्येकादश्यां तथापरे ॥
बालवं नाम करणं कथितं ब्रह्मदैवतम् ॥ 34 ॥
1.83.m: and in the first half of the eighth, and in the second [half] of the eleventh: / the karaṇa named Bālava is declared to have Brahmā as its deity.

1.83.s:
śuklapakṣe dvitīyārdhe ṣaṣṭhyarthe prathame tathā ..
navamyardhe tathaivānte trayodaśyāṃ tathādyake .. 35 ..
1.83.d:
शुक्लपक्षे द्वितीयार्धे षष्ठ्यर्थे प्रथमे तथा ॥
नवम्यर्धे तथैवान्ते त्रयोदश्यां तथाद्यके ॥ 35 ॥
1.83.m: In the bright fortnight, in the second half [of the third day], and in the first half of the sixth, / and in the second half of the ninth, and in the first [half] of the thirteenth,

1.83.s:
kṛṣṇapratipadārdhe tu pañcamyāṃ prathame tathā ..
dvitīyārdhe tathāṣṭamyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ prathame tathā ..36..
1.83.d:
कृष्णप्रतिपदार्धे तु पञ्चम्यां प्रथमे तथा ॥
द्वितीयार्धे तथाष्टम्यां द्वादश्यां प्रथमे तथा ॥36॥
1.83.m: and in the second half of the dark pratipad, and in the first half of the fifth, / and in the second half of the eighth, and in the first [half] of the twelfth:

1.83.s:
kaulavaṃ nāma karaṇaṃ kathitaṃ mitradaivatam ..
ādye śuklaṃ tṛtīyārdhe ṣaṣṭhyardhe ca tathā pare .. 37 ..
1.83.d:
कौलवं नाम करणं कथितं मित्रदैवतम् ॥
आद्ये शुक्लं तृतीयार्धे षष्ठ्यर्धे च तथा परे ॥ 37 ॥
1.83.m: the karaṇa named Kaulava is declared to have Mitra as its deity. / In the first half of the bright third, and in the second half of the sixth,

1.83.s:
kṛṣṇadvitīyāprathame pañcamyardhe tathā pare ..
navamyardhe tathā pūrve dvādaśyardhe tathā pare ..38..
1.83.d:
कृष्णद्वितीयाप्रथमे पञ्चम्यर्धे तथा परे ॥
नवम्यर्धे तथा पूर्वे द्वादश्यर्धे तथा परे ॥38॥
1.83.m: and in the first [half] of the dark second, and in the second half of the fifth, / and in the first half of the ninth, and in the second half of the twelfth:

1.83.s:
tautilaṃ nāma karaṇamāryamṇaṃ kathitaṃ budhaiḥ ..
ante śuklatṛtīyārdhe saptamyāṃ prathame tathā..39..
1.83.d:
तौतिलं नाम करणमार्यम्णं कथितं बुधैः ॥
अन्ते शुक्लतृतीयार्धे सप्तम्यां प्रथमे तथा॥39॥
1.83.m: the karaṇa named Taitila is declared by the wise to belong to Aryaman. / In the second half of the bright third, and in the first [half] of the seventh,

1.83.s:
daśamyardhe tathaivānte caturdaśyāṃ tathādyake ..
kṛṣṇapakṣadvitīyānte ṣaṣṭhyardhe prathame tathā..1.83.40..
1.83.d:
दशम्यर्धे तथैवान्ते चतुर्दश्यां तथाद्यके ॥
कृष्णपक्षद्वितीयान्ते षष्ठ्यर्धे प्रथमे तथा॥1.83.40॥
1.83.m: In the second half of the tenth, and likewise in the second [half of the eleventh], and in the first of the fourteenth, / in the second [half] of the second of the dark fortnight, and in the first half of the sixth,

1.83.s:
navamyāṃ ca tathaivānte trayodaśyāṃ tathādyake..
garābhidhānaṃ karaṇaṃ pṛthivīdaivataṃ smṛtam..41..
1.83.d:
नवम्यां च तथैवान्ते त्रयोदश्यां तथाद्यके॥
गराभिधानं करणं पृथिवीदैवतं स्मृतम्॥41॥
1.83.m: and likewise in the second [half] of the ninth, and in the first of the thirteenth— / the karaṇa named Gara is stated to have the Earth as its deity.

1.83.s:
śuklapakṣacaturthyardhe saptamyāṃ ca tathā pare ..
ekādaśyāṃ tathā pūrve caturdaśyāṃ tathā pare .. 42 ..
1.83.d:
शुक्लपक्षचतुर्थ्यर्धे सप्तम्यां च तथा परे ॥
एकादश्यां तथा पूर्वे चतुर्दश्यां तथा परे ॥ 42 ॥
1.83.m: In the [first] half of the fourth of the bright fortnight, and in the second [half] of the seventh, / in the first [half] of the eleventh, and in the second of the fourteenth,

1.83.s:
kṛṣṇatṛtīyāprathame ṣaṣṭhyardhe ca tathā pare ..
daśamyardhe tathā pūrve trayodaśyāṃ tathā pare .. 43 ..
1.83.d:
कृष्णतृतीयाप्रथमे षष्ठ्यर्धे च तथा परे ॥
दशम्यर्धे तथा पूर्वे त्रयोदश्यां तथा परे ॥ 43 ॥
1.83.m: in the first [half] of the third of the dark fortnight, and in the second half of the sixth, / in the first half of the tenth, and in the second [half] of the thirteenth—

1.83.s:
vaṇijaṃ nāma karaṇaṃ śrīdevamabhidhīyate ..
śuklapakṣe caturthyante hyaṣṭamyāṃ prathame tathā .. 44 ..
1.83.d:
वणिजं नाम करणं श्रीदेवमभिधीयते ॥
शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्थ्यन्ते ह्यष्टम्यां प्रथमे तथा ॥ 44 ॥
1.83.m: the karaṇa named Vaṇij is proclaimed to have Śrī as its deity. / At the end of the fourth in the bright fortnight, and in the first [half] of the eighth,

1.83.s:
ekādaśyapare cārdhe paurṇamāsyāṃ tathādyake ..
ante kṛṣṇatṛtīyārdhe saptamyāṃ prathame tathā .. 45 ..
1.83.d:
एकादश्यपरे चार्धे पौर्णमास्यां तथाद्यके ॥
अन्ते कृष्णतृतीयार्धे सप्तम्यां प्रथमे तथा ॥ 45 ॥
1.83.m: and in the second half of the eleventh, and in the first of the full moon day, / at the end of the half of the third of the dark fortnight, and in the first of the seventh,

1.83.s:
dvitīye ca daśamyardhe caturdaśyāṃ tathādyake..
viṣṭirityeva karaṇaṃ kathitaṃ mṛtyudaivatam .. 46 ..
1.83.d:
द्वितीये च दशम्यर्धे चतुर्दश्यां तथाद्यके॥
विष्टिरित्येव करणं कथितं मृत्युदैवतम् ॥ 46 ॥
1.83.m: and in the second half of the tenth, and in the first [half] of the fourteenth— / the karaṇa [called] Viṣṭi is stated to have Death as its deity.

1.83.s:
sarvakarmasu rājendra sarvadā garhitaṃ ca tat ..
caturviṃśatyahorātre rājanhorāḥ prakīrttitāḥ .. 47 ..
1.83.d:
सर्वकर्मसु राजेन्द्र सर्वदा गर्हितं च तत् ॥
चतुर्विंशत्यहोरात्रे राजन्होराः प्रकीर्त्तिताः ॥ 47 ॥
1.83.m: And that is always censured in all actions, O king of kings. / In a day and night, O king, twenty-four horās are proclaimed.

1.83.s:
graheśadevagandharvanāgayakṣeśvaraprabhāḥ ..
sūryodayādathārabhya dinapādyāḥ krameṇa tāḥ..48..
1.83.d:
ग्रहेशदेवगन्धर्वनागयक्षेश्वरप्रभाः ॥
सूर्योदयादथारभ्य दिनपाद्याः क्रमेण ताः॥48॥
1.83.m: They have the splendours of planetary lords, gods, gandharvas, nāgas, and yakṣa lords. / Beginning from sunrise, they are headed by the lord of the day in order.

1.83.s:
ṣaṣṭhakrameṇa ca tathā kramaṃ tāsāṃ nibodha me..
arkaśukrarkṣarātrīśa saurajīvakujeśvarāḥ .. 49 ..
1.83.d:
षष्ठक्रमेण च तथा क्रमं तासां निबोध मे॥
अर्कशुक्रर्क्षरात्रीश सौरजीवकुजेश्वराः ॥ 49 ॥
1.83.m: And learn from me their order according to the sixth [day's lord]: / the lords of the Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon, Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars.

1.83.s:
sarvāsāṃ ca tathā kālaṃ rāhurbhuṅkte mahāgrahaḥ ..
kulikaśca tathā nāgo yakṣaḥ padmo'tiviśrutaḥ .. 1.83.50 ..
1.83.d:
सर्वासां च तथा कालं राहुर्भुङ्क्ते महाग्रहः ॥
कुलिकश्च तथा नागो यक्षः पद्मोऽतिविश्रुतः ॥ 1.83.50 ॥
1.83.m: And the great planet Rāhu consumes a portion of time of all of them; / so too the nāga Kulika, and the yakṣa Padma celebrated by many,

1.83.s:
aṅgāraparṇaśca tathā gandharvaścābhidhīyate ..
kulikasya tu yā velā sā varjyā sarvakarmasu .. 51 ..
1.83.d:
अङ्गारपर्णश्च तथा गन्धर्वश्चाभिधीयते ॥
कुलिकस्य तु या वेला सा वर्ज्या सर्वकर्मसु ॥ 51 ॥
1.83.m: and the gandharva designated as Aṅgāraparṇa. / But the period of Kulika is to be avoided in all undertakings.

1.83.s:
tasyāṃ bhukte bhavedvyādhirviṣaṃ bhuktaṃ na jīryate ..
pratyakṣamapi tārkṣyasya tasyāṃ daṣṭo na jīvati .. 52 ..
1.83.d:
तस्यां भुक्ते भवेद्व्याधिर्विषं भुक्तं न जीर्यते ॥
प्रत्यक्षमपि तार्क्ष्यस्य तस्यां दष्टो न जीवति ॥ 52 ॥
1.83.m: Disease occurs from eating during it; poison consumed [then] is not digested. / Even in the presence of Tārkṣya, one bitten during it does not live.

1.83.s:
bhuktaṃ tasyāṃ tu bhaiṣajyaṃ na tu kāryakaraṃ bhavet ..
sā tu kulividā jñeyā mantriṇā bhiṣajā tathā .. 53 ..
1.83.d:
भुक्तं तस्यां तु भैषज्यं न तु कार्यकरं भवेत् ॥
सा तु कुलिविदा ज्ञेया मन्त्रिणा भिषजा तथा ॥ 53 ॥
1.83.m: Medicine taken during it will not be effective. / That should be known by one versed in birds, and by a minister, and by a physician.

1.83.s:
avijñāya tu tāṃ velāṃ trayaste rājapuṅgava ..
vaiphalyakaraṇānmūḍhāḥ prāpnuvantyayaśo mahat..54..
1.83.d:
अविज्ञाय तु तां वेलां त्रयस्ते राजपुङ्गव ॥
वैफल्यकरणान्मूढाः प्राप्नुवन्त्ययशो महत्॥54॥
1.83.m: Not knowing that period, O bull among kings, these three, / deluded due to bringing about failure, attain great dishonour.

1.83.s:
pratyekasyaiva velāyāṃ rāhorbhāgaṃ nibodha me ..
ekaikā tu bhaveddhorā sārdhaṃ vighaṭikāśatam ..55..
1.83.d:
प्रत्येकस्यैव वेलायां राहोर्भागं निबोध मे ॥
एकैका तु भवेद्धोरा सार्धं विघटिकाशतम् ॥55॥
1.83.m: Learn from me the share of Rāhu in each individual period: / each horā is one hundred and fifty vighaṭikās.

1.83.s:
vināḍikāḥ saptaṣaṣṭyā raveḥ ṣoḍaśa kīrttitāḥ ..
horākulikavelastu śeṣaḥ kālo ravessmṛtaḥ .. 56 ..
1.83.d:
विनाडिकाः सप्तषष्ट्या रवेः षोडश कीर्त्तिताः ॥
होराकुलिकवेलस्तु शेषः कालो रवेस्स्मृतः ॥ 56 ॥
1.83.m: The vināḍikās of the Sun are stated as sixteen out of sixty-seven; / the remaining time of the Sun is remembered as the horā-kulika period.

1.83.s:
svahorānte tathā velāścatasrastu vināḍikāḥ ..
rāhoścakrasya kathitāḥ śeṣaḥ kālaḥ sitasya ca ..57..
1.83.d:
स्वहोरान्ते तथा वेलाश्चतस्रस्तु विनाडिकाः ॥
राहोश्चक्रस्य कथिताः शेषः कालः सितस्य च ॥57॥
1.83.m: At the end of his own horā, four vināḍikās / are declared for the cycle of Rāhu; the remaining time belongs to Venus.

1.83.s:
saumyahorāsamārambha capakau dvau prakīrtitau..
horā kulikavelā tu śeṣaḥ kālo budhasya ca .. 58 ..
1.83.d:
सौम्यहोरासमारम्भ चपकौ द्वौ प्रकीर्तितौ॥
होरा कुलिकवेला तु शेषः कालो बुधस्य च ॥ 58 ॥
1.83.m: At the beginning of the horā of Mercury, two caṣakas are proclaimed; / the remaining time of Mercury is the horā-kulika period.

1.83.s:
ekasaptatimullaṅghya horāyāṃ tu niśābhṛtaḥ ..
aṣṭau tu kulikasyoktāḥ śeṣaḥ kālo niśābhṛtaḥ .. 59 ..
1.83.d:
एकसप्ततिमुल्लङ्घ्य होरायां तु निशाभृतः ॥
अष्टौ तु कुलिकस्योक्ताः शेषः कालो निशाभृतः ॥ 59 ॥
1.83.m: Having passed seventy-one [caṣakas] in the horā of the Moon, / eight are declared for Kulika; the remaining time belongs to the Moon.

1.83.s:
ṣaḍaśītimatikramya caṣakānravijasya tu ..
yaccheṣastadvinirdiṣṭaḥ kālastu kulikasya ca .. 1.83.60 ..
1.83.d:
षडशीतिमतिक्रम्य चषकान्रविजस्य तु ॥
यच्छेषस्तद्विनिर्दिष्टः कालस्तु कुलिकस्य च ॥ 1.83.60 ॥
1.83.m: Having passed eighty-six caṣakas of the son of the Sun, / what remains is declared as the time of Kulika.

1.83.s:
saptasaptatyatikramya sārdhāṃstu caṣakāngurau ..
rāhostu caṣako horā śeṣakālo gurormataḥ ..61..
1.83.d:
सप्तसप्तत्यतिक्रम्य सार्धांस्तु चषकान्गुरौ ॥
राहोस्तु चषको होरा शेषकालो गुरोर्मतः ॥61॥
1.83.m: Having passed seventy-seven and a half caṣakas in [the horā of] Jupiter, / a caṣaka is Rāhu's horā; the remaining time is considered to be Jupiter's.

1.83.s:
bhaumahorāsamārambhe dvātriṃśattu vināḍikāḥ ..
velā tu kulikasyoktā śeṣaḥ kālaḥ kujasya tu .. 62 ..
1.83.d:
भौमहोरासमारम्भे द्वात्रिंशत्तु विनाडिकाः ॥
वेला तु कुलिकस्योक्ता शेषः कालः कुजस्य तु ॥ 62 ॥
1.83.m: At the beginning of the horā of Mars, thirty-two vināḍikās / are declared as the period of Kulika; the remaining time belongs to Mars.

1.83.s:
jīvajñaśukrahorāsu sarvakarmāṇi kārayet ..
krūrāsu ca tathānyāsu na kiñcitkulikasya ca .. 63 ..
1.83.d:
जीवज्ञशुक्रहोरासु सर्वकर्माणि कारयेत् ॥
क्रूरासु च तथान्यासु न किञ्चित्कुलिकस्य च ॥ 63 ॥
1.83.m: One should carry out all rites in the horās of Jupiter, Mercury, and Venus; / in fierce ones, and in other [malefic] ones, nothing [should be done], nor in that of Kulika.

1.83.s:
ataḥ paraṃ muhūrtānāṃ daivatāni nibodha me ..
sarvarkṣāṇi vivartante hyahorātreṇa pārthiva ..64..
1.83.d:
अतः परं मुहूर्तानां दैवतानि निबोध मे ॥
सर्वर्क्षाणि विवर्तन्ते ह्यहोरात्रेण पार्थिव ॥64॥
1.83.m: Next, learn from me the presiding deities of the muhūrtas. / All constellations revolve in a day and night, O protector of the earth.

1.83.s:
satataṃ te vinirdiṣṭā muhurtāstriṃśadeva tu ..
vajra uvāca ..
aṣṭāviṃśatiruktāni tvayā tāni mamānagha .. 65 ..
1.83.d:
सततं ते विनिर्दिष्टा मुहुर्तास्त्रिंशदेव तु ॥
वज्र उवाच ॥
अष्टाविंशतिरुक्तानि त्वया तानि ममानघ ॥ 65 ॥
1.83.m: Always thirty muhūrtas indeed are assigned to them. / Vajra said: / Twenty-eight of them were declared by you to me, O sinless one;

1.83.s:
triṃśanmuhūrtāśca kathaṃ ta eva dvijasattama ..
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dinarātryossamāraṃbhe hyardhaṃ bhavati pārthiva .. 66 ..
1.83.d:
त्रिंशन्मुहूर्ताश्च कथं त एव द्विजसत्तम ॥
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
दिनरात्र्योस्समारंभे ह्यर्धं भवति पार्थिव ॥ 66 ॥
1.83.m: and how are there thirty muhūrtas, O best of the twice-born? / Mārkaṇḍeya said: / At the commencement of day and night there is a half [muhūrta], O protector of the earth;

1.83.s:
tayormadhye ca satatamabhijiccābhidhīyate ..
tayordvitvānmayā triṃśanmuhūrtā vihitāstava .. 67 ..
1.83.d:
तयोर्मध्ये च सततमभिजिच्चाभिधीयते ॥
तयोर्द्वित्वान्मया त्रिंशन्मुहूर्ता विहितास्तव ॥ 67 ॥
1.83.m: and between the two, Abhijit is always proclaimed. / Because of the duality of those two, thirty muhūrtas have been laid down for you by me.

1.83.s:
nakṣatrairdaivataisteṣāṃ devatāḥ parikīrttitāḥ ..
kevalaṃ kramahāniśca kramasteṣāṃ nibodha me .. 68 ..
1.83.d:
नक्षत्रैर्दैवतैस्तेषां देवताः परिकीर्त्तिताः ॥
केवलं क्रमहानिश्च क्रमस्तेषां निबोध मे ॥ 68 ॥
1.83.m: Their presiding deities are proclaimed according to the asterisms [and their] deities; / only the order is altered; learn their order from me.

1.83.s:
raudrassārpastathā maitraḥ paitro vāsava eva ca ..
āpyo vaiśvastathā rājankeśvaraḥ śakradaivataḥ .. 69 ..
1.83.d:
रौद्रस्सार्पस्तथा मैत्रः पैत्रो वासव एव च ॥
आप्यो वैश्वस्तथा राजन्केश्वरः शक्रदैवतः ॥ 69 ॥
1.83.m: Raudra, Sārpa, Maitra, Paitra, and Vāsava, / Āpya, Vaiśva, O king, Ka-īśvara, that having Śakra as deity,

1.83.s:
aindrāgneyau nairṛtastu vāruṇaśca mahīpate ..
āryamṇastu tathā bhogyo muhūrttāstu divācarāḥ .. 1.83.70 ..
1.83.d:
ऐन्द्राग्नेयौ नैरृतस्तु वारुणश्च महीपते ॥
आर्यम्णस्तु तथा भोग्यो मुहूर्त्तास्तु दिवाचराः ॥ 1.83.70 ॥
1.83.m: Aindrāgneya, Nairṛta, and Vāruṇa, O lord of the earth, / and Āryamṇa, and Bhāgya: these are the muhūrtas that move by day.

1.83.s:
raudrā'jadevohirbudhnyāḥ pauṣṇaścāśvina eva ca..
yāmyo'gnidaivataścaiva brāhmassaumyastathaiva ca .. 71 ..
1.83.d:
रौद्राऽजदेवोहिर्बुध्न्याः पौष्णश्चाश्विन एव च॥
याम्योऽग्निदैवतश्चैव ब्राह्मस्सौम्यस्तथैव च ॥ 71 ॥
1.83.m: Raudra, Ajadeva, Ahirbudhnya, Pauṣṇa, and Āśvina, / Yāmya, Agnidaivata, and Brāhma, and Saumya,

1.83.s:
ādityo jīvadaivatyo vaiṣṇavaḥ sūryadaivataḥ ..
tvāṣṭraścaivātha vāyavyoḥ muhūrtā rātricāriṇaḥ .. 72 ..
1.83.d:
आदित्यो जीवदैवत्यो वैष्णवः सूर्यदैवतः ॥
त्वाष्ट्रश्चैवाथ वायव्योः मुहूर्ता रात्रिचारिणः ॥ 72 ॥
1.83.m: Āditya, Jīvadaivatya, Vaiṣṇava, Sūryadaivata, / Tvāṣṭra, and Vāyavya: these are the muhūrtas that move by night.

1.83.s:
ahnaḥ pañcadaśo bhāgo rātreśca yadunandana ..
muhūrtasaṃjñaḥ kathito munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ .. 73 ..
1.83.d:
अह्नः पञ्चदशो भागो रात्रेश्च यदुनन्दन ॥
मुहूर्तसंज्ञः कथितो मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः ॥ 73 ॥
1.83.m: A fifteenth part of the day and of the night, O joy of the Yadus, / is termed a muhūrta by sages who perceive the truth.

1.83.s:
mahākalyādathārabhya kālāvayavadaivatāḥ ..
uktāstava muhūrtāśca teṣāṃ kāle svake'rcanam .. 74 ..
1.83.d:
महाकल्यादथारभ्य कालावयवदैवताः ॥
उक्तास्तव मुहूर्ताश्च तेषां काले स्वकेऽर्चनम् ॥ 74 ॥
1.83.m: Beginning from early dawn, the presiding deities of the divisions of time / have been spoken of to you as muhūrtas; worship [of them] in their own time

1.83.s:
mahāphalaṃ hi nidiṣṭaṃ syādviyoge viśeṣataḥ ..
svakāle devatāḥ pūjyāḥ sopacārairviśeṣataḥ ..
tasyāssakāśāddharmajña kāmayadbhirmahatphalam .. 75 ..
1.83.d:
महाफलं हि निदिष्टं स्याद्वियोगे विशेषतः ॥
स्वकाले देवताः पूज्याः सोपचारैर्विशेषतः ॥
तस्यास्सकाशाद्धर्मज्ञ कामयद्भिर्महत्फलम् ॥ 75 ॥
1.83.m: is declared to have great fruit, especially at the time of conjunction. / The deities should be worshipped in their own time especially with offerings, / by those desiring great fruit from them, O knower of dharma.

1.83.s:
kāle svake yaḥ prayatastu bhaktyā devānyathāvatsamupaiti rājan ..
saparyayā tasya diśanti devāḥ phalānabhīṣṭānnṛṣu lohitākṣa ..76..
1.83.d:
काले स्वके यः प्रयतस्तु भक्त्या देवान्यथावत्समुपैति राजन् ॥
सपर्यया तस्य दिशन्ति देवाः फलानभीष्टान्नृषु लोहिताक्ष ॥76॥
1.83.m: O red-eyed king, to him who, restrained, with devotion duly approaches the gods / with worship in their proper time, the gods grant desired fruits among men.

1.84.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
lagnāni dvādaśoktāni dinarātreṇa nityaśaḥ ..
yatrādityaḥ sthito rāśau tadādyāni narādhipa .. 1 ..
1.84.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
लग्नानि द्वादशोक्तानि दिनरात्रेण नित्यशः ॥
यत्रादित्यः स्थितो राशौ तदाद्यानि नराधिप ॥ 1 ॥
1.84.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Twelve lagnas are proclaimed, occurring constantly throughout day and night. / Beginning with that sign in which the Sun is situated, O lord of men:

1.84.s:
meṣo vṛṣotha mithunaḥ kulīrassiṃha eva ca ..
kanyā tulā tathā kīṭo dhanvī makara eva ca .. 2 ..
1.84.d:
मेषो वृषोथ मिथुनः कुलीरस्सिंह एव च ॥
कन्या तुला तथा कीटो धन्वी मकर एव च ॥ 2 ॥
1.84.m: Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, / Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, and Capricorn,

1.84.s:
kumbho mīnaśca rājendra lagnā dvādaśa kīrttitāḥ ..
kujaśśukro budhaścandraḥ sūryaścāndrissitastathā .. 3 ..
1.84.d:
कुम्भो मीनश्च राजेन्द्र लग्ना द्वादश कीर्त्तिताः ॥
कुजश्शुक्रो बुधश्चन्द्रः सूर्यश्चान्द्रिस्सितस्तथा ॥ 3 ॥
1.84.m: Aquarius, and Pisces, O king of kings, are proclaimed as the twelve lagnas. / Mars, Venus, Mercury, Moon, Sun, Mercury, Venus,

1.84.s:
bhaumo jīvaśca sauraśca śanirjīvistathaiva ca ..
meṣādīnāṃ krameṇoktāḥ prabhāvaḥ pṛthivīpate ..4 ..
1.84.d:
भौमो जीवश्च सौरश्च शनिर्जीविस्तथैव च ॥
मेषादीनां क्रमेणोक्ताः प्रभावः पृथिवीपते ॥4 ॥
1.84.m: Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Saturn, and Jupiter / are declared in order as their rulers, beginning with Aries, O lord of the earth.

1.84.s:
lagrasyārdhaṃ smṛtā horā tayorviṣamarāśiṣu ..
ādityacandrau candrārkāvīśvarau samarāśiṣu .. 5 ..
1.84.d:
लग्रस्यार्धं स्मृता होरा तयोर्विषमराशिषु ॥
आदित्यचन्द्रौ चन्द्रार्कावीश्वरौ समराशिषु ॥ 5 ॥
1.84.m: A half of a lagna is considered a horā. In odd signs, / the Sun and the Moon [rule them]; in even signs, the Moon and the Sun are the rulers.

1.84.s:
lagnatribhāgo dreṣkāṇaḥ kramātteṣāṃ tatheśvarāḥ ..
lagneśaḥ paṃcameśaśca navameśastathaiva ca ..6..
1.84.d:
लग्नत्रिभागो द्रेष्काणः क्रमात्तेषां तथेश्वराः ॥
लग्नेशः पंचमेशश्च नवमेशस्तथैव च ॥6॥
