1.84.m: The third part of the ascendant is the decan. In order, their lords are / the lord of the ascendant, the lord of the fifth [house], and likewise the lord of the ninth [house].

1.84.s:
meṣādyāḥ kathitā nityaṃ meṣasiṃhadhanurdharāḥ ..
makarādyāstathā proktā vṛṣakanyāmṛgāstathā..7..
1.84.d:
मेषाद्याः कथिता नित्यं मेषसिंहधनुर्धराः ॥
मकराद्यास्तथा प्रोक्ता वृषकन्यामृगास्तथा॥7॥
1.84.m: Those beginning with Aries are always declared to be Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius. / Those beginning with Capricorn are said to be Taurus, Virgo, and Capricorn.

1.84.s:
tulādyā mithunastaulī kumbhaśca vasudhādhipa ..
kulīrādyāḥ kulīraśca kīṭo mīnastathaiva ca ..8..
1.84.d:
तुलाद्या मिथुनस्तौली कुम्भश्च वसुधाधिप ॥
कुलीराद्याः कुलीरश्च कीटो मीनस्तथैव च ॥8॥
1.84.m: Those beginning with Libra are Gemini, Libra, and Aquarius, O lord of the earth; / and those beginning with Cancer are Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces.

1.84.s:
ādyuktarāśiprabhṛti gaṇanīyā navāṃśakāḥ..
rāśīnāṃ tu yathoktānāṃ kramānnava naveśvarāḥ .. 9 ..
1.84.d:
आद्युक्तराशिप्रभृति गणनीया नवांशकाः॥
राशीनां तु यथोक्तानां क्रमान्नव नवेश्वराः ॥ 9 ॥
1.84.m: The ninefold divisions are to be counted beginning from the aforementioned signs. / For the specified signs, there are nine lords for each of the nine [divisions] in succession.

1.84.s:
svarāśitastathārabhya krameṇaiva naveśvarāḥ ..
rāśīśvareśvarāḥ proktā rāśīnāṃ dvādaśāṃśakāḥ .. 1.84.10 ..
1.84.d:
स्वराशितस्तथारभ्य क्रमेणैव नवेश्वराः ॥
राशीश्वरेश्वराः प्रोक्ता राशीनां द्वादशांशकाः ॥ 1.84.10 ॥
1.84.m: Beginning from one's own sign in sequence are the nine lords. / The lords of the signs are declared to be the lords of the twelvefold divisions of the signs.

1.84.s:
paṃca bhaumasya saurasya paṃca triṃśāṃśakā matāḥ ..
jīvasyāṣṭau vinirdiṣṭāḥ sapta proktā budhasya tu .. 11 ..
1.84.d:
पंच भौमस्य सौरस्य पंच त्रिंशांशका मताः ॥
जीवस्याष्टौ विनिर्दिष्टाः सप्त प्रोक्ता बुधस्य तु ॥ 11 ॥
1.84.m: Five [degrees] of the thirtyfold divisions are considered Mars's, and five Saturn's; / eight are assigned to Jupiter, and seven are stated for Mercury;

1.84.s:
śukrasyoktāstathā pañca rāśau viṣama saṃjñake ..
ādyāstu pañca śukrasya tatassapta budhasya ca .. 12 ..
1.84.d:
शुक्रस्योक्तास्तथा पञ्च राशौ विषम संज्ञके ॥
आद्यास्तु पञ्च शुक्रस्य ततस्सप्त बुधस्य च ॥ 12 ॥
1.84.m: five are stated for Venus in an odd-numbered sign. / But the first five belong to Venus, then seven to Mercury,

1.84.s:
jīvasyāṣṭau tathā proktāḥ pañca saurasya cāpyatha ..
kujasya tu tathā pañca rāśau tu samasaṃkhyake .. 13 ..
1.84.d:
जीवस्याष्टौ तथा प्रोक्ताः पञ्च सौरस्य चाप्यथ ॥
कुजस्य तु तथा पञ्च राशौ तु समसंख्यके ॥ 13 ॥
1.84.m: eight are likewise stated for Jupiter, then five for Saturn, / and five for Mars in an even-numbered sign.

1.84.s:
lagnaṃ ca horā ca tathā drikāṇaṃ navāṃśakaṃ dvādaśabhāgasaṃjñam ..
triṃśāṃśakaṃ cāpyatha ṣaṣṭhamatra ṣaḍbhedamāhurmunayaśca lagnam .. 14 ..
1.84.d:
लग्नं च होरा च तथा द्रिकाणं नवांशकं द्वादशभागसंज्ञम् ॥
त्रिंशांशकं चाप्यथ षष्ठमत्र षड्भेदमाहुर्मुनयश्च लग्नम् ॥ 14 ॥
1.84.m: The ascendant, the hour, the decan, the ninefold division, that designated the twelvefold division, / and the thirtyfold division as the sixth here—sages declare the ascendant to have six divisions.

1.85.s:
vajra uvāca ..
śubho vāpyaśubho vāpi kathaṃ kālo mahītale ..
jñāyate bhārgavaśreṣṭha tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ .. 1 ..
1.85.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
शुभो वाप्यशुभो वापि कथं कालो महीतले ॥
ज्ञायते भार्गवश्रेष्ठ तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः ॥ 1 ॥
1.85.m: Vajra said: / How on the surface of the earth is time known / to be auspicious or inauspicious, O best of the Bhṛgus? Tell me who am asking this.

1.85.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
kṛttikā yāmyavāyavye nāgavīthyuttarottare ..
gajavīthīhyudaṅmadhye prājāpatyādayastrayaḥ ..2..
1.85.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
कृत्तिका याम्यवायव्ये नागवीथ्युत्तरोत्तरे ॥
गजवीथीह्युदङ्मध्ये प्राजापत्यादयस्त्रयः ॥2॥
1.85.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Kṛttikā is in the southern and north-western [part], in the northern-most Serpent Path. / In the Elephant Path, in the north-central [part], are the three beginning with Prājāpatya;

1.85.s:
airāvaṇe hyudagbhāge ahorātracatuṣṭayam..
madhye vare tathā vīthī phalgunī ṛkṣayordvayoḥ ..3 ..
1.85.d:
ऐरावणे ह्युदग्भागे अहोरात्रचतुष्टयम्॥
मध्ये वरे तथा वीथी फल्गुनी ऋक्षयोर्द्वयोः ॥3 ॥
1.85.m: in the Airāvata [Path], in the northern region, is a set of four day-and-nights. / In the excellent middle is the path in the two Phalgunī constellations.

1.85.s:
madhyemadhye tu govīthī ajādyaṃ bhacatuṣṭayam ..
madhyayāme jaradgaḥ syāttritayaṃ śravaṇādikam .. 4 ..
1.85.d:
मध्येमध्ये तु गोवीथी अजाद्यं भचतुष्टयम् ॥
मध्ययामे जरद्गः स्यात्त्रितयं श्रवणादिकम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.85.m: In the very middle is the Cow Path, the quartet of constellations beginning with the Goat. / In the middle-southern [part] is the Old Bull [Path], the triad beginning with Śravaṇa.

1.85.s:
yāmyottareṇa tu mṛgā hastacitre prakīrtite ..
ajādakṣiṇamadhye tu viśākhā maitrayossmṛtāḥ ..5..
1.85.d:
याम्योत्तरेण तु मृगा हस्तचित्रे प्रकीर्तिते ॥
अजादक्षिणमध्ये तु विशाखा मैत्रयोस्स्मृताः ॥5॥
1.85.m: To the south-north are the Deer, Hasta and Citrā are proclaimed; / in the south-central of the Goat are Viśākhā and Maitra.

1.85.s:
āvikāyāmyayāmye tu śakrādyaṃ bhacatuṣṭayam ..
vaiśvānarapathaṃ prāhustamevātyantadāruṇam ..6..
1.85.d:
आविकायाम्ययाम्ये तु शक्राद्यं भचतुष्टयम् ॥
वैश्वानरपथं प्राहुस्तमेवात्यन्तदारुणम् ॥6॥
1.85.m: In the southernmost Sheep [Path] is the quartet of constellations beginning with Śakra. / They call that the Fire Path, which is exceedingly terrible.

1.85.s:
udayāstamayābhyāṃ ca cāreṇa ca tathā grahāḥ ..
uttarāsu śubhāḥ proktā dakṣiṇāstvaśubhāvahāḥ ..7..
1.85.d:
उदयास्तमयाभ्यां च चारेण च तथा ग्रहाः ॥
उत्तरासु शुभाः प्रोक्ता दक्षिणास्त्वशुभावहाः ॥7॥
1.85.m: Through rising and setting, and likewise through their course, / planets in the northern [paths] are said to be auspicious, while those in the southern bring misfortune.

1.85.s:
suprabhāraśmimantaśca nāgavīthyāṃ yadā grahāḥ ..
na tadasti śubhaṃ loke yatra paśyanti mānavāḥ .. 8 ..
1.85.d:
सुप्रभारश्मिमन्तश्च नागवीथ्यां यदा ग्रहाः ॥
न तदस्ति शुभं लोके यत्र पश्यन्ति मानवाः ॥ 8 ॥
1.85.m: When planets in the Serpent Path are brilliant and endowed with rays, / there is no good in the world where men see them.

1.85.s:
viraśmayo vivarṇāśca vaiśvānarapathāśritāḥ ..
na tadasti śubhaṃ rāma yanna kuryurjagattraye .. 9 ..
1.85.d:
विरश्मयो विवर्णाश्च वैश्वानरपथाश्रिताः ॥
न तदस्ति शुभं राम यन्न कुर्युर्जगत्त्रये ॥ 9 ॥
1.85.m: Devoid of rays, discoloured, and positioned in the Fire Path, / there is no good, O Rāma, that they do not destroy in the three worlds.

1.85.s:
rohiṇīśakaṭaṃ bhindyurgrahā yadi bhavettadā ..
nāśaḥ prajānāṃ kūraśca viśeṣeṇātra lakṣyate..1.85.10..
1.85.d:
रोहिणीशकटं भिन्द्युर्ग्रहा यदि भवेत्तदा ॥
नाशः प्रजानां कूरश्च विशेषेणात्र लक्ष्यते॥1.85.10॥
1.85.m: If planets should cleave the cart of Rohiṇī, then / especially cruel destruction of the subjects is observed here.

1.85.s:
saurārasūryāḥ krūrāstu tathā kṣīṇaśca candramāḥ..
kūrairyukto budhaścaiva rāhuḥ ketustathaiva ca..11..
1.85.d:
सौरारसूर्याः क्रूरास्तु तथा क्षीणश्च चन्द्रमाः॥
कूरैर्युक्तो बुधश्चैव राहुः केतुस्तथैव च॥11॥
1.85.m: Saturn, Mars, and the Sun are malefic, as is the waning Moon; / Mercury joined with malefics is also [malefic], as are Rāhu and Ketu.

1.85.s:
śeṣāssaumyagrahāḥ proktā munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ ..
rohiṇī kṛttikā pitryaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ maitrameva ca..12..
1.85.d:
शेषास्सौम्यग्रहाः प्रोक्ता मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः ॥
रोहिणी कृत्तिका पित्र्यं वैष्णवं मैत्रमेव च॥12॥
1.85.m: The rest are declared benefic planets by sages who perceive the truth. / Rohiṇī, Kṛttikā, the constellation of the Fathers, the constellation of Viṣṇu, and that of Mitra—

1.85.s:
pīḍayanto grahā hanyurdiśaṃ varuṇapālitām..
pūrvasyāṃ diśi dṛśyante sarvatārāgrahā yadi .. 13 ..
1.85.d:
पीडयन्तो ग्रहा हन्युर्दिशं वरुणपालिताम्॥
पूर्वस्यां दिशि दृश्यन्ते सर्वताराग्रहा यदि ॥ 13 ॥
1.85.m: planets afflicting these destroy the direction guarded by Varuṇa. / If all stellar planets are seen in the eastern quarter,

1.85.s:
prācyānāṃ tu tadā rājñāṃ bhavetpīḍā sudāruṇā ..
madhye ca yadi dṛśyante madhyadeśanivāsi nām .. 14 ..
1.85.d:
प्राच्यानां तु तदा राज्ञां भवेत्पीडा सुदारुणा ॥
मध्ये च यदि दृश्यन्ते मध्यदेशनिवासि नाम् ॥ 14 ॥
1.85.m: then exceedingly severe affliction will befall the kings of the easterners; / and if they are seen in the centre, [affliction will befall] the inhabitants of the central country.

1.85.s:
vāruṇyāṃ yadi dṛśyaṃte tāṃ diśaṃ pīḍayanti ca ..
hīnādhikaṃ carantaśca vyabhre vā'darśanaṃ gatāḥ ..15..
1.85.d:
वारुण्यां यदि दृश्यंते तां दिशं पीडयन्ति च ॥
हीनाधिकं चरन्तश्च व्यभ्रे वाऽदर्शनं गताः ॥15॥
1.85.m: If they are seen in the western quarter, they afflict that direction. / Moving abnormally, or disappearing in a cloudless sky,

1.85.s:
dhūmāyanto jvalanto vā vedayanti mahadbhayam ..
ekāntaritanakṣatragatāḥ syuścedgrahā divi .. 16..
1.85.d:
धूमायन्तो ज्वलन्तो वा वेदयन्ति महद्भयम् ॥
एकान्तरितनक्षत्रगताः स्युश्चेद्ग्रहा दिवि ॥ 16॥
1.85.m: smoking or blazing, they announce great danger. / If the planets in the sky should occupy alternate constellations,

1.85.s:
mālānāma bhavedyogo madhyadeśakṣitīśahā ..
prāsaścakraṃ dhanurvajraṃ sasyānāṃ kṣudravṛṣṭidāḥ .. .. 17..
1.85.d:
मालानाम भवेद्योगो मध्यदेशक्षितीशहा ॥
प्रासश्चक्रं धनुर्वज्रं सस्यानां क्षुद्रवृष्टिदाः ॥ ॥ 17॥
1.85.m: a planetary combination named 'Garland' occurs, which slays the kings of the central country. / The Dart, the Discus, the Bow, the Thunderbolt bring poor rain for crops.

1.85.s:
grahā bhayāvahā nityaṃ śṛṅgāṭakapurogamāḥ ..
bhaveyurekarkṣagatāstribhirūrddhvaṃ yadā grahāḥ .. 18..
1.85.d:
ग्रहा भयावहा नित्यं शृङ्गाटकपुरोगमाः ॥
भवेयुरेकर्क्षगतास्त्रिभिरूर्द्ध्वं यदा ग्रहाः ॥ 18॥
1.85.m: Planets headed by the Triangle always bring danger. / When more than three planets come to occupy a single constellation,

1.85.s:
vināśāyaiva lokānāṃ vijñeyāssumahīkṣitām ..
ekena yadi vā dvābhyāṃ grahābhyāṃ sahito guruḥ .. 19 ..
1.85.d:
विनाशायैव लोकानां विज्ञेयास्सुमहीक्षिताम् ॥
एकेन यदि वा द्वाभ्यां ग्रहाभ्यां सहितो गुरुः ॥ 19 ॥
1.85.m: they must be known to bring destruction to the worlds of great kings. / If Jupiter is accompanied by one or by two planets,

1.85.s:
śanaiścaro vā dṛśyeta tadā durbhikṣamādiśet ..
citrāyāṃ lohito yatra mūle devagurustathā .. .. 1.85.20 ..
1.85.d:
शनैश्चरो वा दृश्येत तदा दुर्भिक्षमादिशेत् ॥
चित्रायां लोहितो यत्र मूले देवगुरुस्तथा ॥ ॥ 1.85.20 ॥
1.85.m: or if Saturn is seen [thus], then one should predict famine. / Where Mars is in Citrā, Jupiter is in Mūla,

1.85.s:
bhārgavaśca śraviṣṭhāsu tadā ghoraṃ bhayaṃ bhavet ..
kṛttikāsu śanaiścārī viśākhāsu bṛhaspatiḥ .. 21 ..
1.85.d:
भार्गवश्च श्रविष्ठासु तदा घोरं भयं भवेत् ॥
कृत्तिकासु शनैश्चारी विशाखासु बृहस्पतिः ॥ 21 ॥
1.85.m: and Venus is in Śraviṣṭhā, then terrible danger will arise. / Saturn staying in Kṛttikā and Jupiter in Viśākhā

1.85.s:
sthitau prajānāṃ pīḍāyai vṛṣṭimantardivaṃ bhavet ..
prāgdvāreṣu caranbheṣu sauro vakrabhiyādyadi .. 22 ..
1.85.d:
स्थितौ प्रजानां पीडायै वृष्टिमन्तर्दिवं भवेत् ॥
प्राग्द्वारेषु चरन्भेषु सौरो वक्रभियाद्यदि ॥ 22 ॥
1.85.m: bring affliction to the subjects and rain ceases from the sky. / If Saturn, moving through the constellations of the eastern gate, goes retrograde out of fear,

1.85.s:
pṛthivīṃ pīḍayetsarvāṃ pūrvadeśaṃ viśeṣata ..
raudre haste tathaivāpye āhirbudhnye śanaiścaraḥ .. 23 ..
1.85.d:
पृथिवीं पीडयेत्सर्वां पूर्वदेशं विशेषत ॥
रौद्रे हस्ते तथैवाप्ये आहिर्बुध्न्ये शनैश्चरः ॥ 23 ॥
1.85.m: it will afflict the entire earth, especially the eastern region. / When Saturn attains its rising in Raudra, Hasta,

1.85.s:
yadodayaṃ prapadyeta tadā naśyanti pārthivāḥ ..
saumye tvāṣṭre śraviṣṭhāsu sthite saurai mahīkṣitaḥ .. 24 ..
1.85.d:
यदोदयं प्रपद्येत तदा नश्यन्ति पार्थिवाः ॥
सौम्ये त्वाष्ट्रे श्रविष्ठासु स्थिते सौरै महीक्षितः ॥ 24 ॥
1.85.m: in Āpya, or in Āhirbudhnya, then rulers perish. / When Saturn stands in Saumya, Tvāṣṭra, or Śraviṣṭhā, kings

1.85.s:
sarvapīḍāṃ samarhanti yayā yānti yamāntikam ..
pūrvāṃ parāśāṃ saṃprāpto bhṛgujīvau parasparam .. 25 ..
1.85.d:
सर्वपीडां समर्हन्ति यया यान्ति यमान्तिकम् ॥
पूर्वां पराशां संप्राप्तो भृगुजीवौ परस्परम् ॥ 25 ॥
1.85.m: suffer all afflictions by which they go to the presence of Yama. / When Venus and Jupiter, having reached the eastern and western horizons opposite each other,

1.85.s:
saptamarkṣagatau syātāṃ tadatra devo na varṣati ..
aparvaṇi śaśāṅkārkau tvaṣṭānāma mahāgrahaḥ .. 26 ..
1.85.d:
सप्तमर्क्षगतौ स्यातां तदत्र देवो न वर्षति ॥
अपर्वणि शशाङ्कार्कौ त्वष्टानाम महाग्रहः ॥ 26 ॥
1.85.m: occupy the seventh constellation [from each other], then the god does not rain here. / Outside the conjunction, the great planet named Tvaṣṭṛ,

1.85.s:
āvṛṇoti tamaḥ śyāmaḥ sarvalokavipattaye ..
udayāstamaye bhānoścandrasya ca yadā bhavet .. 27 ..
1.85.d:
आवृणोति तमः श्यामः सर्वलोकविपत्तये ॥
उदयास्तमये भानोश्चन्द्रस्य च यदा भवेत् ॥ 27 ॥
1.85.m: a dark darkness, covers the Sun and the Moon, causing ruin to all the worlds. / When at the rising or setting of the Sun and of the Moon

1.85.s:
pariveṣastadā rājā kṣipraṃ vadhamavāpnuyāt ..
sakalaṃ cedahassūyo rātriṃ cetsakalāṃ śaśī .. 28 ..
1.85.d:
परिवेषस्तदा राजा क्षिप्रं वधमवाप्नुयात् ॥
सकलं चेदहस्सूयो रात्रिं चेत्सकलां शशी ॥ 28 ॥
1.85.m: there is a halo, then the king quickly meets death. / If the Sun is haloed for the entire day, or the Moon for the entire night,

1.85.s:
pariveṣī bhavedrājā tatrāpi vadhamarhati ..
dvisūrye gagane vṛddhiṃ kṣattriyāṇāṃ vinirdiśet .. 29 ..
1.85.d:
परिवेषी भवेद्राजा तत्रापि वधमर्हति ॥
द्विसूर्ये गगने वृद्धिं क्षत्त्रियाणां विनिर्दिशेत् ॥ 29 ॥
1.85.m: the king also deserves death in that case. / If there are two Suns in the sky, one should predict increase for kṣatriyas;

1.85.s:
dvicandre brāhmaṇānāṃ tu cādhikyaṃ pralayāya tu ..
udayāstamayau yatra somārkau raktamaṇḍalau .. 1.85.30 ..
1.85.d:
द्विचन्द्रे ब्राह्मणानां तु चाधिक्यं प्रलयाय तु ॥
उदयास्तमयौ यत्र सोमार्कौ रक्तमण्डलौ ॥ 1.85.30 ॥
1.85.m: if there are two Moons, [increase] for brahmins, but excess brings dissolution. / Where the Moon and Sun at rising and setting have red orbs

1.85.s:
na cātrābhrāṇi dṛśyante tanmahābhayalakṣaṇam ..
candramā janmanakṣatraṃ parityajati yasya tu .. 31 ..
1.85.d:
न चात्राभ्राणि दृश्यन्ते तन्महाभयलक्षणम् ॥
चन्द्रमा जन्मनक्षत्रं परित्यजति यस्य तु ॥ 31 ॥
1.85.m: and no clouds are seen, that is a mark of great danger. / When the Moon leaves a person's birth-constellation,

1.85.s:
śyāvo rūkṣopasavyaṃ tu tasya vidyādupadravam ..
atyantā darśane rāhostathā cātyantadarśane .. 32 ..
1.85.d:
श्यावो रूक्षोपसव्यं तु तस्य विद्यादुपद्रवम् ॥
अत्यन्ता दर्शने राहोस्तथा चात्यन्तदर्शने ॥ 32 ॥
1.85.m: turning dark, rough, and passing to the left, one should recognise calamity for him. / At the extreme invisibility of Rāhu, or at its extreme visibility,

1.85.s:
prajāpīḍā vinirdeśyā vyādhidurbhikṣataskaraiḥ ..
yannakṣatragato rāhurgrasate candrabhāskarau .. 33 ..
1.85.d:
प्रजापीडा विनिर्देश्या व्याधिदुर्भिक्षतस्करैः ॥
यन्नक्षत्रगतो राहुर्ग्रसते चन्द्रभास्करौ ॥ 33 ॥
1.85.m: affliction of the subjects through disease, famine, and thieves is to be predicted. / In whichever constellation Rāhu stands when it eclipses the Moon and Sun,

1.85.s:
tajjātānāṃ bhavetpīḍā ye narāśśāntivarjitāḥ ..
grahopasṛṣṭe nakṣatre grahaṇaṃ tu yadā bhavet .. 34 ..
1.85.d:
तज्जातानां भवेत्पीडा ये नराश्शान्तिवर्जिताः ॥
ग्रहोपसृष्टे नक्षत्रे ग्रहणं तु यदा भवेत् ॥ 34 ॥
1.85.m: affliction will befall those born in it, men who are devoid of propitiatory rites. / But when an eclipse occurs in a constellation afflicted by a planet,

1.85.s:
tadā pīḍā vinirdeśyā sainikānāṃ nṛpaissaha ..
gṛhīto rāhuṇā candraḥ sūryo vā gaganāccyutaḥ .. 35 ..
1.85.d:
तदा पीडा विनिर्देश्या सैनिकानां नृपैस्सह ॥
गृहीतो राहुणा चन्द्रः सूर्यो वा गगनाच्च्युतः ॥ 35 ॥
1.85.m: Then suffering should be indicated for soldiers along with kings. / If the moon or the sun, eclipsed by Rāhu, falls from the sky,

1.85.s:
ulkāni hanyāttatrānyo rājā rājyaṃ kariṣyati ..
gṛhītau pariveṣe tau yadā candradivākarau..36..
1.85.d:
उल्कानि हन्यात्तत्रान्यो राजा राज्यं करिष्यति ॥
गृहीतौ परिवेषे तौ यदा चन्द्रदिवाकरौ॥36॥
1.85.m: or if a meteor strikes it, another king will rule the kingdom there. / When the sun and moon are seized within a halo,

1.85.s:
samantātpīḍyate deśaḥ śastrakopaśca jāyate ..
meghaissaṃchādyate rāhustvativarṣati vā yadā .. 37 ..
1.85.d:
समन्तात्पीड्यते देशः शस्त्रकोपश्च जायते ॥
मेघैस्संछाद्यते राहुस्त्वतिवर्षति वा यदा ॥ 37 ॥
1.85.m: the country is tormented all around, and fury of weapons arises. / When Rāhu is covered by clouds, or when it rains excessively,

1.85.s:
akālajaistadā rājño bhayaṃ vidyādupasthitam ..
yanna kṣatrāgate sūrye chidraṃ vai saṃprapadyate .. 38 ..
1.85.d:
अकालजैस्तदा राज्ञो भयं विद्यादुपस्थितम् ॥
यन्न क्षत्रागते सूर्ये छिद्रं वै संप्रपद्यते ॥ 38 ॥
1.85.m: one should know that untimely danger has arrived for the king. / When a flaw occurs while the sun is in a constellation,

1.85.s:
tajjātaḥ pārthivaḥ kṣipraṃ yamalokaṃ gamiṣyati ..
tāmrakuṅkumarūkṣābho ghṛtahāridrasannibhaḥ .. 39 ..
1.85.d:
तज्जातः पार्थिवः क्षिप्रं यमलोकं गमिष्यति ॥
ताम्रकुङ्कुमरूक्षाभो घृतहारिद्रसन्निभः ॥ 39 ॥
1.85.m: the king born under it will swiftly go to the realm of Yama. / Having the rough luster of copper or saffron, or resembling ghee and turmeric,

1.85.s:
bandhujīvanibho bhānuḥ śiśirādyeṣu śasyate ..
asvacchavarṇaḥ paruṣo vepanaḥ khaṇḍamaṇḍalaḥ ..1.85.40..
1.85.d:
बन्धुजीवनिभो भानुः शिशिराद्येषु शस्यते ॥
अस्वच्छवर्णः परुषो वेपनः खण्डमण्डलः ॥1.85.40॥
1.85.m: or resembling the bandhujīva flower, the sun is praised in the seasons beginning with Śiśira. / Unclear in color, harsh, trembling, with its disk broken,

1.85.s:
sacchidre rajasā dhvasta ulkādyupahatopi vā ..
maṇḍalādanyasaṃsthānaṃ meghaiścāyudhasannibhaiḥ..41..
1.85.d:
सच्छिद्रे रजसा ध्वस्त उल्काद्युपहतोपि वा ॥
मण्डलादन्यसंस्थानं मेघैश्चायुधसन्निभैः॥41॥
1.85.m: having holes, obscured by dust, or struck by meteors and the like, / possessing a shape other than a disk, or covered with clouds resembling weapons

1.85.s:
udayāstamaye cchannaḥ pārthivānāṃ na śasyate..
pakṣādau cāpasaṃsthāne yuddhaṃ śaśini nirdiśet..42..
1.85.d:
उदयास्तमये च्छन्नः पार्थिवानां न शस्यते॥
पक्षादौ चापसंस्थाने युद्धं शशिनि निर्दिशेत्॥42॥
1.85.m: at rising or setting, it is not auspicious for kings. / At the beginning of a fortnight, if the moon has the shape of a bow, one should indicate war.

1.85.s:
lābhasteṣāṃ jayasteṣāṃ yatra dṛṣṭaṃ bhayaṃ tataḥ ..
samakoṭiviśālaśca kiṃcidvāpyuttaronnataḥ .. 43 ..
1.85.d:
लाभस्तेषां जयस्तेषां यत्र दृष्टं भयं ततः ॥
समकोटिविशालश्च किंचिद्वाप्युत्तरोन्नतः ॥ 43 ॥
1.85.m: Gain belongs to them, victory belongs to them, from where fear is seen. / Having even horns and broad, or slightly elevated to the north,

1.85.s:
māsādau candramāḥ śasto vāma eva viparyayaḥ ..
maṇḍalenāntarīkurvañśṛṅge sā yadi vā spṛśet .. 44 ..
1.85.d:
मासादौ चन्द्रमाः शस्तो वाम एव विपर्ययः ॥
मण्डलेनान्तरीकुर्वञ्शृङ्गे सा यदि वा स्पृशेत् ॥ 44 ॥
1.85.m: the moon at the beginning of the month is auspicious; the reverse is just unfavourable. / If, obscuring with its disk, or if it touches with its horns

1.85.s:
tārāgrahaṃ tadā kuryādbhayaṃ janapade śaśī ..
śuklapakṣasya yā vṛddhirloke kṣemasubhikṣadā..45 ..
1.85.d:
ताराग्रहं तदा कुर्याद्भयं जनपदे शशी ॥
शुक्लपक्षस्य या वृद्धिर्लोके क्षेमसुभिक्षदा॥45 ॥
1.85.m: a planet, then the moon will cause danger in the countryside. / The increase of the bright fortnight brings safety and abundance to the world;

1.85.s:
sā sitetarapakṣasya pṛthivyāṃ naiva gamyate ..
śravaṇebhyudito bhaumaḥ puṣye vakramiyādyadi .. 46 ..
1.85.d:
सा सितेतरपक्षस्य पृथिव्यां नैव गम्यते ॥
श्रवणेभ्युदितो भौमः पुष्ये वक्रमियाद्यदि ॥ 46 ॥
1.85.m: that of the dark fortnight is not perceived [as such] on earth. / If Mars, having risen in Śravaṇa, goes retrograde in Puṣya,

1.85.s:
prājāpatyuditaścandro nāśāya syānmahīkṣitāma ..
gatāgataṃ yadā kuryānmaghāmadhyena lohitaḥ.. 47 ..
1.85.d:
प्राजापत्युदितश्चन्द्रो नाशाय स्यान्महीक्षिताम ॥
गतागतं यदा कुर्यान्मघामध्येन लोहितः॥ 47 ॥
1.85.m: or if the moon rises in Rohiṇī, it will cause the destruction of kings. / When the Red Planet moves forward and backward through the middle of Maghā,

1.85.s:
tadā bhavatyanāvṛṣṭiḥ pāṇḍyo rājā vinaśyati ..
phalgunyorudayaṃ kṛtvā vakraḥ syādvaiśvadaivake..48..
1.85.d:
तदा भवत्यनावृष्टिः पाण्ड्यो राजा विनश्यति ॥
फल्गुन्योरुदयं कृत्वा वक्रः स्याद्वैश्वदैवके॥48॥
1.85.m: then drought occurs, and the Pāṇḍya king perishes. / Having risen in the two Phalgunīs, if it should turn retrograde in Uttarāṣāḍhā,

1.85.s:
prajāpatye pravāsaśca trailokyaṃ tatra pīḍyate ..
dhruveṣu vaiṣṇave mūle śākre ca vicarankujaḥ .. 49 ..
1.85.d:
प्रजापत्ये प्रवासश्च त्रैलोक्यं तत्र पीड्यते ॥
ध्रुवेषु वैष्णवे मूले शाक्रे च विचरन्कुजः ॥ 49 ॥
1.85.m: and stay in Rohiṇī, the three worlds are afflicted there. / When Mars wanders in the fixed [constellations], Śravaṇa, Mūla, and Jyeṣṭhā,

1.85.s:
ghorāṃ karotyanāvṛṣṭiṃ kṛttikāsu maghāsu ca ..
kārttike'śvayuje pauṣe cāṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe budhaḥ ..1.85.50..
1.85.d:
घोरां करोत्यनावृष्टिं कृत्तिकासु मघासु च ॥
कार्त्तिकेऽश्वयुजे पौषे चाषाढे श्रावणे बुधः ॥1.85.50॥
1.85.m: it causes severe drought, as also in Kṛttikā and Maghā. / In Kārttika, Āśvina, Pauṣa, Āṣāḍha, and Śrāvaṇa, Mercury,

1.85.s:
dṛṣṭo loke bhayāya syānmāghavaiśākhayostathā ..
akasmādyatra dṛśyeta divā devapurohitaḥ..51..
1.85.d:
दृष्टो लोके भयाय स्यान्माघवैशाखयोस्तथा ॥
अकस्माद्यत्र दृश्येत दिवा देवपुरोहितः॥51॥
1.85.m: when seen, brings fear to the world, and likewise in Māgha and Vaiśākha. / Where the priest of the gods is suddenly seen by day,

1.85.s:
rājā vā mriyate tatra sa vā deśo vinaśyati ..
ahassarvaṃ yadā śukro dṛśyate'tha mahāgrahaḥ .. 52 ..
1.85.d:
राजा वा म्रियते तत्र स वा देशो विनश्यति ॥
अहस्सर्वं यदा शुक्रो दृश्यतेऽथ महाग्रहः ॥ 52 ॥
1.85.m: either the king dies there, or that country perishes. / When Venus, the great planet, is seen for the entire day,

1.85.s:
tadā tvagnyādibhirgrāmānbādhate nagarāṇi ca ..
kārttike tu yadā māsi kurvāte'stamayādayau .. 53 ..
1.85.d:
तदा त्वग्न्यादिभिर्ग्रामान्बाधते नगराणि च ॥
कार्त्तिके तु यदा मासि कुर्वातेऽस्तमयादयौ ॥ 53 ॥
1.85.m: then it afflicts villages and cities with fire and other [calamities]. / But when they set and rise in the month of Kārttika,

1.85.s:
tadahnāṃ navati pūrṇaṃ bhuvi devo na varṣati ..
śanaiścaro deśapīḍāṃ deśanakṣatrapīḍane .. 54 ..
1.85.d:
तदह्नां नवति पूर्णं भुवि देवो न वर्षति ॥
शनैश्चरो देशपीडां देशनक्षत्रपीडने ॥ 54 ॥
1.85.m: then for ninety full days the god does not rain upon the earth. / Saturn causes affliction to a country when the country's constellation is afflicted,

1.85.s:
dhruvaṃ karoti rājendra nityaṃ cāravaśena tu ..
saptāhāntargatā ye vai divyapārthivanābhasāḥ ..
grahoparāge tīvrāssyurutpātāḥ svaphaleṣu te .. 55 ..
1.85.d:
ध्रुवं करोति राजेन्द्र नित्यं चारवशेन तु ॥
सप्ताहान्तर्गता ये वै दिव्यपार्थिवनाभसाः ॥
ग्रहोपरागे तीव्रास्स्युरुत्पाताः स्वफलेषु ते ॥ 55 ॥
1.85.m: certainly, O best of kings, constantly through its movement. / Portents of the heavens, the earth, and the atmosphere that occur within seven days

1.85.s:
ekasminyadi māse syādgrahaṇaṃ candrasūryayoḥ ..
brahmakṣatravirodhāya viparītavivṛddhaye .. 56 ..
1.85.d:
एकस्मिन्यदि मासे स्याद्ग्रहणं चन्द्रसूर्ययोः ॥
ब्रह्मक्षत्रविरोधाय विपरीतविवृद्धये ॥ 56 ॥
1.85.m: of an eclipse of a planet become severe in their effects. / If an eclipse of the sun and moon should occur in a single month,

1.85.s:
yasmindṛśyeta nakṣatre viśākhāyāṃ pradhūpavat ..
taddeśajātā pīḍā syādbudhaketumahāgrahāḥ .. 57 ..
1.85.d:
यस्मिन्दृश्येत नक्षत्रे विशाखायां प्रधूपवत् ॥
तद्देशजाता पीडा स्याद्बुधकेतुमहाग्रहाः ॥ 57 ॥
1.85.m: it leads to conflict between brahmins and kṣatriyas and to an increase of adversity. / In whichever constellation, [or] in Viśākhā, Mercury, Ketu, [or] the great planets

1.85.s:
ulkādyabhihate sūrye ketubhirvā vidhūmite ..
agastye vā dhruve vāpi prajāpīḍāṃ vinirdiśeta .. 58 ..
1.85.d:
उल्काद्यभिहते सूर्ये केतुभिर्वा विधूमिते ॥
अगस्त्ये वा ध्रुवे वापि प्रजापीडां विनिर्दिशेत ॥ 58 ॥
1.85.m: are seen like smoke, affliction will arise for those born in that country. / When the sun is struck by meteors and the like, or obscured by smoke from comets,

1.85.s:
ulkayābhihatā rūkṣā sphuraṇā rajasā yutāḥ ..
ṛṣayassapta lokānāṃ vināśāya ca bhūbhṛtām .. 59 ..
1.85.d:
उल्कयाभिहता रूक्षा स्फुरणा रजसा युताः ॥
ऋषयस्सप्त लोकानां विनाशाय च भूभृताम् ॥ 59 ॥
1.85.m: or when Agastya or Dhruva [are so struck], one should declare affliction for the subjects. / Struck by a meteor, rough, flickering, and accompanied by dust,

1.85.s:
kṛttikābhissahodeti śāṃkarī diśamāśritaḥ ..
kumārīprītito hanyālloke nṛpakumārakān .. 1.85.60 ..
1.85.d:
कृत्तिकाभिस्सहोदेति शांकरी दिशमाश्रितः ॥
कुमारीप्रीतितो हन्याल्लोके नृपकुमारकान् ॥ 1.85.60 ॥
1.85.m: the Seven Sages [bring] destruction to the worlds and to kings. / Rising with the Kṛttikās, situated in the northeastern direction,

1.85.s:
samāgame grahāṇāṃ tu candramāḥ śasyate hyudak ..
nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca rājendra dakṣiṇena na śasyate .. 61 ..
1.85.d:
समागमे ग्रहाणां तु चन्द्रमाः शस्यते ह्युदक् ॥
नक्षत्राणां च राजेन्द्र दक्षिणेन न शस्यते ॥ 61 ॥
1.85.m: out of love for Kumārī, it kills royal princes in the world. / In the conjunction of planets, the moon is indeed praised in the north;

1.85.s:
rāhuḥ ketuḥ kujaḥ śakraścandreṇa sahayāyinaḥ ..
budho jīvaśca sauraśca nāgarā raviṇā saha..62..
1.85.d:
राहुः केतुः कुजः शक्रश्चन्द्रेण सहयायिनः ॥
बुधो जीवश्च सौरश्च नागरा रविणा सह॥62॥
1.85.m: and to the south of the constellations, O best of kings, it is not praised. / Rāhu, Ketu, Mars, and Saturn are marchers along with the moon; / Mercury, Jupiter, and Saturn are city-dwellers along with the sun.

1.85.s:
yāyinā vijite paure rājñāṃ syādyāyināṃ jayaḥ ..
yāyigrahe paurajite purā rājñāṃ jayo mṛdhe .. 63 ..
1.85.d:
यायिना विजिते पौरे राज्ञां स्याद्यायिनां जयः ॥
यायिग्रहे पौरजिते पुरा राज्ञां जयो मृधे ॥ 63 ॥
1.85.m: When a city-dweller is conquered by a marcher, victory will belong to marching kings. / When a marching planet is conquered by a city-dweller, victory belongs to city kings in battle.

1.85.s:
paureṇa vijite paure pauraiḥ paurakṣayaṃ vadet ..
yāyinā yāyini hate yāyibhyo yāyināṃ kṣayaḥ .. 64 ..
1.85.d:
पौरेण विजिते पौरे पौरैः पौरक्षयं वदेत् ॥
यायिना यायिनि हते यायिभ्यो यायिनां क्षयः ॥ 64 ॥
1.85.m: When a city-dweller is conquered by a city-dweller, one should declare the destruction of city-dwellers by city-dwellers. / When a marcher is struck down by a marcher, there is destruction of marchers from marchers.

1.85.s:
grahāṇāṃ cedbhavetsāmyaṃ sāmyaṃ rājñāṃ vinirdiśet ..
jayājayau narendrāṇāṃ nirdeśyo grahavadbudhaiḥ .. 65 ..
1.85.d:
ग्रहाणां चेद्भवेत्साम्यं साम्यं राज्ञां विनिर्दिशेत् ॥
जयाजयौ नरेन्द्राणां निर्देश्यो ग्रहवद्बुधैः ॥ 65 ॥
1.85.m: If there is equality among the planets, one should declare equality among the kings. / Victory and defeat of rulers of men should be indicated by the wise according to the planets.

1.85.s:
grahārūḍhaścyutassthānātsphureṇa vijito grahaḥ ..
vijito jayaliṅgaiśca kṛṣṇaḥ śyāmadyutistathā .. 66 ..
1.85.d:
ग्रहारूढश्च्युतस्स्थानात्स्फुरेण विजितो ग्रहः ॥
विजितो जयलिङ्गैश्च कृष्णः श्यामद्युतिस्तथा ॥ 66 ॥
1.85.m: A planet mounted by another planet, fallen from its place, [or] conquered by trembling, / is conquered, as is one with the marks of victory [reversed], black, or of dark brilliance.

1.85.s:
udaṅmārgagatiḥ snigdho vimalo vimalaprabhaḥ ..
bṛhadrūpotiśukraśca vijayī kathito grahaḥ .. 67 ..
1.85.d:
उदङ्मार्गगतिः स्निग्धो विमलो विमलप्रभः ॥
बृहद्रूपोतिशुक्रश्च विजयी कथितो ग्रहः ॥ 67 ॥
1.85.m: Moving on a northern path, glossy, spotless, of clean brilliance, / large in form, and very bright, a planet is declared victorious.

1.85.s:
na deyametaccapalasya loke na nāstikasyādhamapūruṣasya ..
guhyaṃ munīnāmapi pārthivendra mayeritaṃ kālaviniścayaṃ te..68..
1.85.d:
न देयमेतच्चपलस्य लोके न नास्तिकस्याधमपूरुषस्य ॥
गुह्यं मुनीनामपि पार्थिवेन्द्र मयेरितं कालविनिश्चयं ते॥68॥
1.85.m: This must not be given to an unsteady man in the world, nor to an atheist, the lowest of men. / This secret even of the sages, the determination of time, has been spoken by me to you, O best of kings.

1.85.s: iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 grahaśubhāśubhaparijñānavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcāśītitamoyāyaḥ .. 85 ..
1.85.d: इति श्रीविष्णुधर्मोत्तरे प्रथमखण्डे मा0सं0 ग्रहशुभाशुभपरिज्ञानवर्णनं नाम पञ्चाशीतितमोयायः ॥ 85 ॥
1.85.m: Thus ends the eighty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Knowledge of Auspicious and Inauspicious Planetary Signs,' in the First Book of the venerable Viṣṇudharmottara, in the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Vajra.

1.86.s:
vajra uvāca ..
pratideśaṃ mahābhāga kathaṃ prāptamupadravam ..
vijñāyate dvijaśreṣṭha tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ .. 1 ..
1.86.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
प्रतिदेशं महाभाग कथं प्राप्तमुपद्रवम् ॥
विज्ञायते द्विजश्रेष्ठ तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः ॥ 1 ॥
1.86.m: Vajra said: / In each region, O fortunate one, how is an impending calamity / recognized, O best of the twice-born? Tell me that as I ask.

1.86.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
kṛttikāṃ rohiṇīṃ saumyaṃ madhyadeśasya nirdiśet ..
pīḍite tritaye'tasminmadhyadeśaḥ prapīḍyate .. 2 ..
1.86.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
कृत्तिकां रोहिणीं सौम्यं मध्यदेशस्य निर्दिशेत् ॥
पीडिते त्रितयेऽतस्मिन्मध्यदेशः प्रपीड्यते ॥ 2 ॥
1.86.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / One should assign Kṛttikā, Rohiṇī, and Mṛgaśīrṣa to the central country. / When this triad is afflicted, the central country is afflicted.

1.86.s:
ārdrāṃ punarvasuṃ puṣyaṃ pūrvadeśasya nirdiśet ..
pīḍite tritaye tasminpūrvadeśaḥ prapīḍyate .. 3 ..
1.86.d:
आर्द्रां पुनर्वसुं पुष्यं पूर्वदेशस्य निर्दिशेत् ॥
पीडिते त्रितये तस्मिन्पूर्वदेशः प्रपीड्यते ॥ 3 ॥
1.86.m: One should assign Ārdrā, Punarvasu, and Puṣya to the eastern country. / When this triad is afflicted, the eastern country is afflicted.

1.86.s:
āśleṣāṃ tu maghāṃ pūrvāṃ cāgneyyāṃ diśi nirdiśet ..
pīḍite tritaye tasminnāgneyī pīḍyate'tha dik .. 4 ..
1.86.d:
आश्लेषां तु मघां पूर्वां चाग्नेय्यां दिशि निर्दिशेत् ॥
पीडिते त्रितये तस्मिन्नाग्नेयी पीड्यतेऽथ दिक् ॥ 4 ॥
1.86.m: One should assign Āśleṣā, Maghā, and Pūrvaphalgunī to the southeastern direction. / When this triad is afflicted, then the southeastern direction is afflicted.

1.86.s:
āryamṇamatha hastaṃ ca tvāṣṭraṃ syāddiśi dakṣiṇe ..
pīḍite tritaye tasminpīḍyate dakṣiṇā ca dik .. 5 ..
1.86.d:
आर्यम्णमथ हस्तं च त्वाष्ट्रं स्याद्दिशि दक्षिणे ॥
पीडिते त्रितये तस्मिन्पीड्यते दक्षिणा च दिक् ॥ 5 ॥
1.86.m: Uttarāphalgunī, Hasta, and Citrā pertain to the southern direction. / When this triad is afflicted, the southern direction is afflicted.

1.86.s:
svātiṃ viśākhāṃ maitraṃ ca nairṛtyāṃ diśi nirdiśet .
pīḍite tritaye tasminpīḍyate nairṛtī ca dik .. 6 ..
1.86.d:
स्वातिं विशाखां मैत्रं च नैरृत्यां दिशि निर्दिशेत् ।
पीडिते त्रितये तस्मिन्पीड्यते नैरृती च दिक् ॥ 6 ॥
1.86.m: One should assign Svātī, Viśākhā, and Anurādhā to the southwestern direction. / When this triad is afflicted, the southwestern direction is afflicted.

1.86.s:
vāyavyāṃ diśi nirdiṣṭā vaiśvavaiṣṇavavāsavāḥ .
pīḍite tritaye tasminvāyavī pīḍyate ca dik .. 7 ..
1.86.d:
वायव्यां दिशि निर्दिष्टा वैश्ववैष्णववासवाः ।
पीडिते त्रितये तस्मिन्वायवी पीड्यते च दिक् ॥ 7 ॥
1.86.m: Uttarāṣāḍhā, Śravaṇa, and Dhaniṣṭhā are assigned to the northwestern direction. / When this triad is afflicted, the northwestern direction is afflicted.

1.86.s:
vāruṇaṃ cājadaivatyaṃ cāhirbudhnyaṃ tathottare ..
pīḍite tritaye tasminnuttarā dikprapīḍyate .. 8 ..
1.86.d:
वारुणं चाजदैवत्यं चाहिर्बुध्न्यं तथोत्तरे ॥
पीडिते त्रितये तस्मिन्नुत्तरा दिक्प्रपीड्यते ॥ 8 ॥
1.86.m: Śatabhiṣaj, Pūrvabhādrapadā, and Uttarabhādrapadā [belong] likewise to the north. / When this triad is afflicted, the northern direction is afflicted.

1.86.s:
revatī cāśvinī yāmyamaiśānī dik prapīḍitā ..
pīḍite tritaye tasminnīśānī dik prapīḍyate .. 9 ..
1.86.d:
रेवती चाश्विनी याम्यमैशानी दिक् प्रपीडिता ॥
पीडिते त्रितये तस्मिन्नीशानी दिक् प्रपीड्यते ॥ 9 ॥
1.86.m: Revatī, Aśvinī, and Bharaṇī are afflicted for the northeastern direction. / When this triad is afflicted, the northeastern direction is afflicted.

1.86.s:
ādityo bhṛgujo bhaumo rāhussauro niśākaraḥ ..
budho bṛhaspatiścaiva prācyādīśāḥ prakīrtitāḥ .. .. 1.86.10 ..
1.86.d:
आदित्यो भृगुजो भौमो राहुस्सौरो निशाकरः ॥
बुधो बृहस्पतिश्चैव प्राच्यादीशाः प्रकीर्तिताः ॥ ॥ 1.86.10 ॥
1.86.m: The Sun, Venus, Mars, Rāhu, Saturn, the Moon, / Mercury, and Jupiter are declared to be the lords of the directions beginning with the east.

1.86.s:
vidhvastavapuṣaste ca grahayuddhe parājitāḥ ..
nīcāḥ pitṛgṛhasthāśca svāṃ diśaṃ pīḍayanti te .. 11 ..
1.86.d:
विध्वस्तवपुषस्ते च ग्रहयुद्धे पराजिताः ॥
नीचाः पितृगृहस्थाश्च स्वां दिशं पीडयन्ति ते ॥ 11 ॥
1.86.m: When their bodies are destroyed, defeated in planetary war, / debilitated, or situated in the house of the deceased, they afflict their own direction.

1.86.s:
vajra uvāca ..
svadeśapīḍanaṃ kuryānnakṣatraḥ pīḍitaḥ katham ..
sarvametanmamācakṣva sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara .. 12 ..
1.86.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
स्वदेशपीडनं कुर्यान्नक्षत्रः पीडितः कथम् ॥
सर्वमेतन्ममाचक्ष्व सर्वधर्मभृतां वर ॥ 12 ॥
1.86.m: Vajra said: / How does an afflicted asterism cause affliction to its own region? / Tell me all this, O best among all upholders of dharma.

1.86.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
śanaiścarārkau cāreṇa vakreṇāṅgārako grahaḥ ..
uparāgeṇa rāhuśca ketuścādhūmanodayaiḥ .. 13 ..
1.86.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
शनैश्चरार्कौ चारेण वक्रेणाङ्गारको ग्रहः ॥
उपरागेण राहुश्च केतुश्चाधूमनोदयैः ॥ 13 ॥
1.86.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Saturn and the Sun [afflict] by their transit, the planet Mars by retrograde motion, / Rāhu by eclipse, and Ketu by smoky risings;

1.86.s:
udayāstamayābhyāṃ ca jīvaśukraśaśāṅkajāḥ ..
saṃcchādanena ca śaśī hyagastyaścaiva yogataḥ .. 14 ...
1.86.d:
उदयास्तमयाभ्यां च जीवशुक्रशशाङ्कजाः ॥
संच्छादनेन च शशी ह्यगस्त्यश्चैव योगतः ॥ 14 ॥।
1.86.m: Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury by their rising and setting, / the Moon by occultation, and Agastya by conjunction.

1.86.s:
tathā yasmim̐śca nakṣatre divyapārthivanābhasāḥ ..
dṛśyante tu mahotpātāḥ svāṃ diśaṃ saṃprapīḍayet .. 15 ..
1.86.d:
तथा यस्मिम्̐श्च नक्षत्रे दिव्यपार्थिवनाभसाः ॥
दृश्यन्ते तु महोत्पाताः स्वां दिशं संप्रपीडयेत् ॥ 15 ॥
1.86.m: Likewise, in whichever asterism celestial, terrestrial, and atmospheric / great portents are seen, it afflicts its own direction.

1.86.s:
deśeṣu sarveṣu mayeritaṃ te śubhāśubhaṃ yādava mukhyanātha ..
ataḥ paraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha vadasva kiṃ te kathayāmi rājan ..16..
1.86.d:
देशेषु सर्वेषु मयेरितं ते शुभाशुभं यादव मुख्यनाथ ॥
अतः परं धर्मभृतां वरिष्ठ वदस्व किं ते कथयामि राजन् ॥16॥
1.86.m: I have explained to you the good and evil concerning all countries, O foremost lord of the Yādavas; / beyond this, O supreme among upholders of dharma, speak: what shall I tell you, O king?

1.87.s:
.. vajra uvāca ..
śubhāśubhaparijñānaṃ bhagavanpuruṣaṃ prati ..
tvattohaṃ śrotumicchāmi tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ .. 1 ..
1.87.d:
॥ वज्र उवाच ॥
शुभाशुभपरिज्ञानं भगवन्पुरुषं प्रति ॥
त्वत्तोहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः ॥ 1 ॥
1.87.m: Vajra said: / O lord, I wish to hear from you the discernment / of good and evil with respect to an individual; tell that to me who am asking.

1.87.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca..
janmāśritastriṣaṣṭhaśca saptamo daśamastathā ..
ekādaśaḥ śaśī yeṣāṃ tadā teṣāṃ śubhaṃ bhavet..2..
1.87.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच॥
जन्माश्रितस्त्रिषष्ठश्च सप्तमो दशमस्तथा ॥
एकादशः शशी येषां तदा तेषां शुभं भवेत्॥2॥
1.87.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the Moon is in the natal [sign], third, sixth, seventh, tenth, / or eleventh for them, then they will have good fortune.

1.87.s:
janmanyatha caturthe ca sāṣṭame daśame tathā ..
ekādeśe budho yeṣāṃ teṣāmapi śubhaṃ vadet .. 3 ..
1.87.d:
जन्मन्यथ चतुर्थे च साष्टमे दशमे तथा ॥
एकादेशे बुधो येषां तेषामपि शुभं वदेत् ॥ 3 ॥
1.87.m: When Mercury is in the natal [sign], fourth, eighth, tenth, / or eleventh for them, one should state that they also have good fortune.

1.87.s:
dvipañcamagato jīvassaptamo navamastathā ..
ekādaśastathā hyeṣāṃ teṣāmapi śubhaṃ vadet.. .. 4 ..
1.87.d:
द्विपञ्चमगतो जीवस्सप्तमो नवमस्तथा ॥
एकादशस्तथा ह्येषां तेषामपि शुभं वदेत्॥ ॥ 4 ॥
1.87.m: When Jupiter is in the second, fifth, seventh, ninth, / or eleventh for them, one should state that they also have good fortune.

1.87.s:
ṣaṣṭhasaptamagaḥ śukro daśame na ca śobhanaḥ ..
dvādaśaśca tathā hyeṣāṃ teṣāṃ pīḍāṃ vinirdiśet .. 5 ..
1.87.d:
षष्ठसप्तमगः शुक्रो दशमे न च शोभनः ॥
द्वादशश्च तथा ह्येषां तेषां पीडां विनिर्दिशेत् ॥ 5 ॥
1.87.m: Venus in the sixth or seventh, and in the tenth, is not auspicious; / and likewise in the twelfth for them—one should predict affliction for them.

1.87.s:
tṛtīye daśame ṣaṣṭhe tathā caikādaśe śubhā ..
saurāratīkṣṇakiraṇā yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ śubhaṃ vadet .. 6 ..
1.87.d:
तृतीये दशमे षष्ठे तथा चैकादशे शुभा ॥
सौरारतीक्ष्णकिरणा येषां तेषां शुभं वदेत् ॥ 6 ॥
1.87.m: Saturn, Mars, and the Sun are auspicious in the third, tenth, sixth, / and eleventh; for those who have them thus, one should declare good fortune.

1.87.s:
yasminhi jananaṃ yasya janmarkṣaṃ tasya tatsmṛtam ..
caturthaṃ mānasaṃ tasmāddaśamaṃ karmasaṃjñitam .. 7 ..
1.87.d:
यस्मिन्हि जननं यस्य जन्मर्क्षं तस्य तत्स्मृतम् ॥
चतुर्थं मानसं तस्माद्दशमं कर्मसंज्ञितम् ॥ 7 ॥
1.87.m: The asterism in which one's birth takes place is called one's natal asterism. / The fourth from it is the mental [asterism], and the tenth is called the action [asterism].

1.87.s:
saṃgātakaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ syādviṃśaṃ syātsāmudāyikam ..
vaināśakaṃ tu nakṣatraṃ karmarkṣaṃ yattrayodaśam .. 8 ...
1.87.d:
संगातकं षोडशं स्याद्विंशं स्यात्सामुदायिकम् ॥
वैनाशकं तु नक्षत्रं कर्मर्क्षं यत्त्रयोदशम् ॥ 8 ॥।
1.87.m: The sixteenth is the collective [asterism], the twentieth is the gathering [asterism], / while the destructive asterism is the thirteenth from the action asterism.

1.87.s:
ṣaṇṇakṣatrastu puruṣassarvaḥ prokto mahīpate ..
rājā ca navanakṣatro nakṣatratritayaṃ śṛṇu .. 9 ..
1.87.d:
षण्णक्षत्रस्तु पुरुषस्सर्वः प्रोक्तो महीपते ॥
राजा च नवनक्षत्रो नक्षत्रत्रितयं शृणु ॥ 9 ॥
1.87.m: Every man, O lord of the earth, is said to have six asterisms, / but a king has nine asterisms; hear the triad of asterisms

1.87.s:
nityamabhyadhikaṃ ṣaḍbhyaḥ pārthivasya nṛpottama ...
deśābhiṣekanakṣatrau jātinakṣatrameva ca .. 1.87.10 ..
1.87.d:
नित्यमभ्यधिकं षड्भ्यः पार्थिवस्य नृपोत्तम ॥।
देशाभिषेकनक्षत्रौ जातिनक्षत्रमेव च ॥ 1.87.10 ॥
1.87.m: that is always in addition to the six for an earthly ruler, O best of kings: / the country asterism, the coronation asterism, and the caste asterism.

1.87.s:
jātyāśritāni vakṣyāmi nakṣatrāṇi tavānagha ..
pūrvātrayamathāgneyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ prakīrtitam .. 11 ...
1.87.d:
जात्याश्रितानि वक्ष्यामि नक्षत्राणि तवानघ ॥
पूर्वात्रयमथाग्नेयं ब्राह्मणानां प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 11 ॥।
1.87.m: I shall declare to you the asterisms associated with castes, O sinless one: / the triad of Pūrva [asterisms] and the one sacred to Agni are proclaimed for brahmins;

1.87.s:
uttarātritayaṃ puṣyaṃ kṣattriyāṇāṃ prakīrttitam ..
pauṣṇaṃ maitraṃ tathā pitryaṃ prājāpatyaṃ viśāṃ smṛtam .. 12 ..
1.87.d:
उत्तरात्रितयं पुष्यं क्षत्त्रियाणां प्रकीर्त्तितम् ॥
पौष्णं मैत्रं तथा पित्र्यं प्राजापत्यं विशां स्मृतम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.87.m: the triad of Uttara [asterisms] and Puṣya are proclaimed for kṣatriyas; / Pauṣṇa, Maitra, that sacred to the Ancestors, and that sacred to Prajāpati are remembered for vaiśyas;

1.87.s:
ādityamāśvinaṃ hastaḥ śūdrāṇāmabhijittathā ..
sārpaṃ viśākhā yāmyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ ca narādhipa .. 13 ..
1.87.d:
आदित्यमाश्विनं हस्तः शूद्राणामभिजित्तथा ॥
सार्पं विशाखा याम्यं च वैष्णवं च नराधिप ॥ 13 ॥
1.87.m: that sacred to Aditi, that sacred to the Aśvins, Hasta, and Abhijit are for śūdras; / and that sacred to the Serpents, Viśākhā, that sacred to Yama, and that sacred to Viṣṇu, O lord of men,

1.87.s:
pratilomabhavānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ parikīrtitam ..
īhāde hyarthahānissyājjanmarkṣe copatāpite .. 14 ..
1.87.d:
प्रतिलोमभवानां च सर्वेषां परिकीर्तितम् ॥
ईहादे ह्यर्थहानिस्स्याज्जन्मर्क्षे चोपतापिते ॥ 14 ॥
1.87.m: are proclaimed for all those born against the natural order of castes. / When the natal asterism is afflicted, there is loss of wealth in this world;

1.87.s:
karmarkṣe karmaṇāṃ hāniḥ pīḍā manasi mānase ..
mūrttidraviṇabandhūnāṃ hānissaṃghātike hate .. 15 ..
1.87.d:
कर्मर्क्षे कर्मणां हानिः पीडा मनसि मानसे ॥
मूर्त्तिद्रविणबन्धूनां हानिस्संघातिके हते ॥ 15 ॥
1.87.m: when the action asterism is afflicted, there is loss of actions; when the mental is afflicted, distress in the mind; / when the collective is struck, loss of bodily health, wealth, and kinsmen;
when the gathering asterism is scorched, destruction of friends, servants, and wealth; / when the destructive asterism is afflicted, there is destruction of the body, wealth, and fortunes;

1.87.s:
pīḍite cābhiṣekarkṣe rājyabhraṃśaṃ vinirdiśet ..
deśarkṣe pīḍite pīḍāṃ deśasya ca purasya ca .. 17 ..
1.87.d:
पीडिते चाभिषेकर्क्षे राज्यभ्रंशं विनिर्दिशेत् ॥
देशर्क्षे पीडिते पीडां देशस्य च पुरस्य च ॥ 17 ॥
1.87.m: when the coronation asterism is afflicted, one should predict fall from the kingdom; / when the country asterism is afflicted, distress for the country and city;

1.87.s:
pīḍite jātinakṣatre rājño vyādhiṃ vinirdiśet .. 18 ..
graharkṣajātā samavāpya pīḍāṃ pūjā tu kāryā vidhinā svakena ..
tataśśubhaṃ vindati rājasiṃha vidhūtapāpaḥ puruṣassadaiva ..15
1.87.d:
पीडिते जातिनक्षत्रे राज्ञो व्याधिं विनिर्दिशेत् ॥ 18 ॥
ग्रहर्क्षजाता समवाप्य पीडां पूजा तु कार्या विधिना स्वकेन ॥
ततश्शुभं विन्दति राजसिंह विधूतपापः पुरुषस्सदैव ॥15
1.87.m:
and when the caste asterism is afflicted, one should predict illness for the king.
Having encountered affliction born of planets and asterisms, worship should be performed according to its own rule; / then, O lion among kings, the person, freed from evil, always attains good fortune.

1.88.s:
vajra uvāca ..
grahāṇāṃ bhṛguśārdūla nakṣatrāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ..
pūjane vidhimācakṣva tatra me saṃśayo mahān .. 1 ..
1.88.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
ग्रहाणां भृगुशार्दूल नक्षत्राणां तथैव च ॥
पूजने विधिमाचक्ष्व तत्र मे संशयो महान् ॥ 1 ॥
1.88.m: Vajra said: / O tiger among the Bhṛgus, tell me the rule for worshiping / the planets and likewise the asterisms; I have great doubt in that matter.

1.88.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
grahassādhipatiḥ kāryo nityaṃ maṇḍalake budhaiḥ ..
nakṣatraścandrasahitastathā sādhipatirnṛpa .. 2 ..
1.88.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
ग्रहस्साधिपतिः कार्यो नित्यं मण्डलके बुधैः ॥
नक्षत्रश्चन्द्रसहितस्तथा साधिपतिर्नृप ॥ 2 ॥
1.88.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / The planet along with its presiding deity should always be drawn by the wise in a sacred diagram; / and the asterism together with the Moon and its presiding deity, O king.

1.88.s:
saṃkhyātā tārakāstasya yathāvanmanujeśvara ..
teṣāṃ tārakasaṃkhyānaṃ nibodha gadato mama .. 3 ..
1.88.d:
संख्याता तारकास्तस्य यथावन्मनुजेश्वर ॥
तेषां तारकसंख्यानं निबोध गदतो मम ॥ 3 ॥
1.88.m: Its stars are counted properly, O lord of men; / learn the count of those stars from me as I speak.

1.88.s:
raudraṃ puṣyaṃ tathā tvāṣṭraṃ vāyavyaṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā ..
pauṣṇaṃ ca pārthivaśreṣṭha kathitaṃ tvekatārakam..4..
1.88.d:
रौद्रं पुष्यं तथा त्वाष्ट्रं वायव्यं वारुणं तथा ॥
पौष्णं च पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ कथितं त्वेकतारकम्॥4॥
1.88.m: Raudra, Puṣya, Tvāṣṭra, Vāyavya, Vāruṇa, / and Pauṣṇa are declared to have one star, O best of earthly rulers.

1.88.s:
dvitāraṃ phalgunīyugmaṃ tathā bhādrapadādvayam..
ādityaṃ ca tathā mūlaṃ caindrāgnaṃ cāśvinaṃ tathā..5..
1.88.d:
द्वितारं फल्गुनीयुग्मं तथा भाद्रपदाद्वयम्॥
आदित्यं च तथा मूलं चैन्द्राग्नं चाश्विनं तथा॥5॥
1.88.m: The two Phalgunīs have two stars, as do the two Bhādrapadās, / Āditya, Mūla, Aindrāgna, and Āśvina.

1.88.s:
tritāraṃ bharaṇī saumyamaindraṃ brāhmaṃ savaiṣṇavam ..
catustāramathāṣāḍhe dve maitraṃ yadunandana .. 6 ..
1.88.d:
त्रितारं भरणी सौम्यमैन्द्रं ब्राह्मं सवैष्णवम् ॥
चतुस्तारमथाषाढे द्वे मैत्रं यदुनन्दन ॥ 6 ॥
1.88.m: Bharaṇī, Saumya, Aindra, Brāhma, and Vaiṣṇava have three stars; / both the Āṣāḍhās and Maitra have four stars, O joy of the Yadus.

1.88.s:
pañcatāraḥ smṛto hastaḥ prājāpatyaṃ ca vāsavam ..
sārpaṃ pitryamathāgneyaṃ ṣaṭtāraṃ parikīrtitam .. 7 ..
1.88.d:
पञ्चतारः स्मृतो हस्तः प्राजापत्यं च वासवम् ॥
सार्पं पित्र्यमथाग्नेयं षट्तारं परिकीर्तितम् ॥ 7 ॥
1.88.m: Hasta, Prājāpatya, and Vāsava are recorded as having five stars; / that sacred to the Serpents, that sacred to the Ancestors, and that sacred to Agni are proclaimed to have six stars.

1.88.s:
ādityamaṇḍalaṃ kāryaṃ padmavarṇaṃ narādhipa ..
śvetaṃ candramasaḥ kāryaṃ raktaṃ kāryaṃ kujasya ca .. 8 ..
1.88.d:
आदित्यमण्डलं कार्यं पद्मवर्णं नराधिप ॥
श्वेतं चन्द्रमसः कार्यं रक्तं कार्यं कुजस्य च ॥ 8 ॥
1.88.m: The sacred diagram of the Sun should be made lotus-coloured, O lord of men; / that of the Moon should be made white, and that of Mars red.

1.88.s:
nīlaṃ budhasya karttavyaṃ pītavarṇaṃ bṛhaspateḥ ..
śvetaṃ śukrasya karttavyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ saurasya pārthiva .. 9 ..
1.88.d:
नीलं बुधस्य कर्त्तव्यं पीतवर्णं बृहस्पतेः ॥
श्वेतं शुक्रस्य कर्त्तव्यं कृष्णं सौरस्य पार्थिव ॥ 9 ॥
1.88.m: That of Mercury should be made blue, that of Jupiter yellow, / that of Venus should be made white, and that of Saturn black, O earthly ruler.

1.88.s:
ākāśavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ ketordhūmaprabhaṃ tathā ..
raktavarṇaṃ kṛttikānāṃ phalgunīdvitayasya ca .. 1.88.10 ..
1.88.d:
आकाशवर्णं तमसः केतोर्धूमप्रभं तथा ॥
रक्तवर्णं कृत्तिकानां फल्गुनीद्वितयस्य च ॥ 1.88.10 ॥
1.88.m: That of Rāhu should be sky-coloured, and that of Ketu smoke-coloured; / the colour of Kṛttikā and the pair of Phalgunīs is red,

1.88.s:
hastasya ca sapauṣṇasya maitrasya ca narādhipa ..
pītaṃ puṣyasya keśasya śākravāḍavayostathā .. 11 ..
1.88.d:
हस्तस्य च सपौष्णस्य मैत्रस्य च नराधिप ॥
पीतं पुष्यस्य केशस्य शाक्रवाडवयोस्तथा ॥ 11 ॥
1.88.m: and of Hasta along with Pauṣṇa and Maitra, O lord of men; / yellow is that of Puṣya, Keśa, and Śākravāḍava;

1.88.s:
śvetaṃ saumyasya raudrasya āpyavāruṇayostathā ..
ādityasārpapitryāṇāṃ brāhmavāyavyayostathā .. 12 ..
1.88.d:
श्वेतं सौम्यस्य रौद्रस्य आप्यवारुणयोस्तथा ॥
आदित्यसार्पपित्र्याणां ब्राह्मवायव्ययोस्तथा ॥ 12 ॥
1.88.m: white is that of Saumya, Raudra, Āpya, Vāruṇa, / Āditya, Sārpa, Pitrya, Brāhma, and Vāyavya;

1.88.s:
proṣṭhapādadvayasyātha śvetamevābhidhīyate ..
vicitravarṇaṃ tvāṣṭrasya vaiśvadevasya cāpyatha .. 13 ..
1.88.d:
प्रोष्ठपादद्वयस्याथ श्वेतमेवाभिधीयते ॥
विचित्रवर्णं त्वाष्ट्रस्य वैश्वदेवस्य चाप्यथ ॥ 13 ॥
1.88.m: and that of the two Proṣṭhapadās is declared to be white as well. / Variegated in colour is that of Tvāṣṭra and Vaiśvadeva;

1.88.s:
āśvinasya tathā kāryaṃ nityameva narādhipa ..
kṛṣṇaṃ yāmyasya mūlasya pālāśaṃ śravaṇasya ca .. 14 ..
1.88.d:
आश्विनस्य तथा कार्यं नित्यमेव नराधिप ॥
कृष्णं याम्यस्य मूलस्य पालाशं श्रवणस्य च ॥ 14 ॥
1.88.m: that of Āśvina should always be made likewise, O lord of men; / black is that of Yāmya and Mūla, and green that of Śravaṇa;
for Viśākhā, O king, the sacred diagram should be made yellow-red.

1.88.s:
yathoktavarṇena narendra kṛtvā pūrvaṃ grahasyānagha maṇḍalaṃ svam ..
ṛkṣasya vā pūjyatamasya rājanpūjā vidheyā tadanantaraṃ ca .. 16 ..
1.88.d:
यथोक्तवर्णेन नरेन्द्र कृत्वा पूर्वं ग्रहस्यानघ मण्डलं स्वम् ॥
ऋक्षस्य वा पूज्यतमस्य राजन्पूजा विधेया तदनन्तरं च ॥ 16 ॥
1.88.m: Having first made the planet's own sacred diagram with the prescribed colour, O sinless lord of men, / or that of the asterism to be worshipped, O king, worship should be performed immediately thereafter.

1.89.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
śakṛnmūtraṃ tu saṃgṛhya śvetasya vṛṣabhasya ca ..
śvetagoḥ payasā sārdhaṃ snātavyaṃ kuśavāriṇā ..1 ..
1.89.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
शकृन्मूत्रं तु संगृह्य श्वेतस्य वृषभस्य च ॥
श्वेतगोः पयसा सार्धं स्नातव्यं कुशवारिणा ॥1 ॥
1.89.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having collected dung and urine of a white bull, / along with the milk of a white cow, one should bathe with water infused with kuśa grass.
When the birth-asterism is afflicted, one is freed from that fault. / A man [bathed] with water [infused with] śirīṣa, sandalwood, aśvattha, tāṭa, and nāga,

1.89.s:
snānaścenmānase tapte tasmāddoṣo vimucyate ..
siddhārthakānpriyaṅguṃ ca śatapuṣpāṃ śatāvarīm .. 3 ..
1.89.d:
स्नानश्चेन्मानसे तप्ते तस्माद्दोषो विमुच्यते ॥
सिद्धार्थकान्प्रियङ्गुं च शतपुष्पां शतावरीम् ॥ 3 ॥
1.89.m: when afflicted in mind, if he bathes, is freed from that fault. / Having cast white mustard seeds, priyaṅgu, dill, and śatāvarī
into water, one should bathe when the karma-asterism is afflicted, O king. / Priyaṅgu, bilva, white mustard seeds, barley, aśvattha, and surāhvaya,

1.89.s:
candanodakasaṃyukte snāne sāṃghātike hate ..
sarvagandhodakaiḥ snānaṃ tathā siddhārthakaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 5 ..
1.89.d:
चन्दनोदकसंयुक्ते स्नाने सांघातिके हते ॥
सर्वगन्धोदकैः स्नानं तथा सिद्धार्थकैः शुभैः ॥ 5 ॥
1.89.m: combined with sandalwood water, for a bath when the sāṃghātika [asterism] is harmed. / A bath with all-fragrance waters and auspicious white mustard seeds

1.89.s:
pīḍite sāmudāyarkṣe puṃsāṃ kalmaṣanāśanam ..
vṛṣaśṛṅgoddhṛtamṛdā tathā bilvodakaiśśubhaiḥ .. 6..
1.89.d:
पीडिते सामुदायर्क्षे पुंसां कल्मषनाशनम् ॥
वृषशृङ्गोद्धृतमृदा तथा बिल्वोदकैश्शुभैः ॥ 6॥
1.89.m: destroys the sins of men when the sāmudāyika asterism is afflicted. / With earth raised by the horn of a bull, and with auspicious bilva-water,

1.89.s:
śatapuṣpāsasomāhvaiḥ snānaṃ vaināśike bhavet ..
pīḍite cābhiṣekarkṣe sarvaratnodakaistathā .. 7 ...
1.89.d:
शतपुष्पाससोमाह्वैः स्नानं वैनाशिके भवेत् ॥
पीडिते चाभिषेकर्क्षे सर्वरत्नोदकैस्तथा ॥ 7 ॥।
1.89.m: along with dill and the plant called soma, the bath should be when the vaināśika [asterism is afflicted]. / And when the coronation-asterism is afflicted, [a bath] with water [containing] all jewels;

1.89.s:
pīḍite deśanakṣatre mṛdbhissnānaṃ vidhīyate ..
mṛttikāśca pravakṣyāmi gadataḥ śṛṇu me nṛpa .. 8 ..
1.89.d:
पीडिते देशनक्षत्रे मृद्भिस्स्नानं विधीयते ॥
मृत्तिकाश्च प्रवक्ष्यामि गदतः शृणु मे नृप ॥ 8 ॥
1.89.m: when the region's asterism is afflicted, a bath with earths is prescribed. / And I shall declare the earths; listen to me speaking, O king:
from both banks of a river, from its middle, from a confluence, from the shore of a lake, / from a stable for horses, from a station for elephants, from a cow-pen, from a mountain summit,
from a dwelling of serpents, from an anthill, from the king’s palace, from a temple of the gods, / and that raised by an elephant’s tusk, and that raised by a bull’s horn.

1.89.s:
sarvabījodakasnāto jātinakṣatrapīḍane ..
mucyate kilbiṣādrājannātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 11 ..
1.89.d:
सर्वबीजोदकस्नातो जातिनक्षत्रपीडने ॥
मुच्यते किल्बिषाद्राजन्नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥ 11 ॥
1.89.m: One who has bathed with water containing all kinds of seeds when the caste-asterism is afflicted / is freed from sin, O king; there should be no doubt about this.
[The hymn beginning with] 'idam āpaḥ pravahata' is proclaimed as the bath-mantras.

1.89.s:
snātastathaivaṃ nṛpacandra paścātsnānaṃ prakurvīta grahopadiṣṭam ..
pīḍākarasyātha tatastu kāryaṃ nakṣatrayāgābhihitaṃ yathāvat .. 13 ..
1.89.d:
स्नातस्तथैवं नृपचन्द्र पश्चात्स्नानं प्रकुर्वीत ग्रहोपदिष्टम् ॥
पीडाकरस्याथ ततस्तु कार्यं नक्षत्रयागाभिहितं यथावत् ॥ 13 ॥
1.89.m: Having thus bathed, O moon among kings, one should then perform the bath prescribed for the planet; / then, properly, the sacrifice prescribed for the asterism causing affliction should be performed.

1.89.s:
pūjā grahendrasya narendracandra pīḍākarasyātha tatastu kāryā ..
taṃ pūjayeccāpyatha candrayuktaṃ tataḥ sa doṣānsakalāñjahāti . . 14 ..
1.89.d:
पूजा ग्रहेन्द्रस्य नरेन्द्रचन्द्र पीडाकरस्याथ ततस्तु कार्या ॥
तं पूजयेच्चाप्यथ चन्द्रयुक्तं ततः स दोषान्सकलाञ्जहाति ॥ 14 ॥
1.89.m: Then, O moon among kings, worship of the lord of planets causing affliction must be performed; / and one should worship him together with the moon; then he casts off all faults.

1.90.s:
.. vajra uvāca ..
grahāṇāṃ bhārgavaśreṣṭha nakṣatrāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ..
pūjāvidhimahaṃ tvattaḥ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ .. 1 ..
1.90.d:
॥ वज्र उवाच ॥
ग्रहाणां भार्गवश्रेष्ठ नक्षत्राणां तथैव च ॥
पूजाविधिमहं त्वत्तः श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः ॥ 1 ॥
1.90.m: Vajra said: / O best of the Bhṛgus, I wish to hear from you the rule of worship / for the planets and likewise for the asterisms, in truth.

1.90.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
grahaṃ vāpyatha nakṣatraṃ yaṃ pūjayitumicchati . .
upaspṛśya śucirbhūtvā kṛtvā tasyātha maṇḍalam..2..
1.90.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
ग्रहं वाप्यथ नक्षत्रं यं पूजयितुमिच्छति ॥
उपस्पृश्य शुचिर्भूत्वा कृत्वा तस्याथ मण्डलम्॥2॥
1.90.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Whichever planet or asterism one desires to worship, / having sipped water and become pure, and having made its sacred diagram,

1.90.s:
maṇḍale kalpitaṃ vāpi svayaṃ daivavidā nṛpa ..
pūjyasnānena vidhivatsnātaḥ prayatamānasaḥ .. 3 ..
1.90.d:
मण्डले कल्पितं वापि स्वयं दैवविदा नृप ॥
पूज्यस्नानेन विधिवत्स्नातः प्रयतमानसः ॥ 3 ॥
1.90.m: or [one] prepared on a sacred diagram by an astrologer himself, O king; / bathed according to rule with the bath suitable for the worshipped, composed in mind,

1.90.s:
vidhinopasamādāya prayato jātavedasam ..
atha vopasamādāne kṛte tatra purodhasā .. 4 ..
1.90.d:
विधिनोपसमादाय प्रयतो जातवेदसम् ॥
अथ वोपसमादाने कृते तत्र पुरोधसा ॥ 4 ॥
1.90.m: having carefully kindled the fire according to rule; / or when the kindling has been performed there by the family priest,

1.90.s:
prāktantre ca kṛte tatra cakṣuṣpatre yathāvidhi ..
maṇḍalātpaścime bhāge prāṅmukhaḥ prayataśśuciḥ .. 5 ..
1.90.d:
प्राक्तन्त्रे च कृते तत्र चक्षुष्पत्रे यथाविधि ॥
मण्डलात्पश्चिमे भागे प्राङ्मुखः प्रयतश्शुचिः ॥ 5 ॥
1.90.m: and the preliminary ritual has been performed there with the vessel for sprinkling according to rule, / on the western side of the sacred diagram, facing east, self-restrained and pure,

1.90.s:
maṇḍalasya tu śaucārthaṃ pañcagavyaṃ prakalpayet ..
abhyukṣya pañcagavyena maṇḍalaṃ prayataḥ śuciḥ .. 6 . .
1.90.d:
मण्डलस्य तु शौचार्थं पञ्चगव्यं प्रकल्पयेत् ॥
अभ्युक्ष्य पञ्चगव्येन मण्डलं प्रयतः शुचिः ॥ 6 ॥
1.90.m: one should prepare the five products of the cow for the purification of the sacred diagram. / Having sprinkled the sacred diagram with the five products of the cow, composed and pure,

1.90.s:
arghyādikalpanāṃ kuryātpādyāntāṃ tadanantaram ..
jīvādānaṃ tataḥ kuryājjīvasyāvāhanaṃ tataḥ .. 7 ..
1.90.d:
अर्घ्यादिकल्पनां कुर्यात्पाद्यान्तां तदनन्तरम् ॥
जीवादानं ततः कुर्याज्जीवस्यावाहनं ततः ॥ 7 ॥
1.90.m: one should then make the preparations beginning with water for guest-offering and ending with water for the feet; / then one should perform the installation of the life-force, and then the invocation of the life-force.

1.90.s:
pūjyasyāvāhanaṃ kuryāttato'rghyaṃ vinivedayet ..
pādyaṃ nivedayetpaścādāsanaṃ ca nivedayet .. 8 ..
1.90.d:
पूज्यस्यावाहनं कुर्यात्ततोऽर्घ्यं विनिवेदयेत् ॥
पाद्यं निवेदयेत्पश्चादासनं च निवेदयेत् ॥ 8 ॥
1.90.m: One should perform the invocation of the deity to be worshipped, and then offer the guest-offering; / one should then offer water for the feet, and offer a seat.

1.90.s:
dattvaivācamanīyaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ nivedayet ..
tato'nulepanaṃ dadyāttato dadyādvibhūṣaṇam . . 9 ..
1.90.d:
दत्त्वैवाचमनीयं च मधुपर्कं निवेदयेत् ॥
ततोऽनुलेपनं दद्यात्ततो दद्याद्विभूषणम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.90.m: Having given water for sipping, one should offer the honey-mixture; / then one should give an unguent, and then one should give an ornament,

1.90.s:
tato yajñopavītaṃ ca tataḥ pratisarāñśubhān ..
vastraṃ tathā patākāṃ ca puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ tathaiva ca .. 1.90.10 ..
1.90.d:
ततो यज्ञोपवीतं च ततः प्रतिसराञ्शुभान् ॥
वस्त्रं तथा पताकां च पुष्पं धूपं तथैव च ॥ 1.90.10 ॥
1.90.m: then the sacred thread, and then auspicious protective amulets, / cloth, and likewise a banner, flowers, and incense,

1.90.s:
dīpaṃ ca dattvā naivedyaṃ mukhavāsaṃ ca pārthiva ..
tato'gnihavanaṃ kuryādyasya yasya yathā bhavet .. 11 ..
1.90.d:
दीपं च दत्त्वा नैवेद्यं मुखवासं च पार्थिव ॥
ततोऽग्निहवनं कुर्याद्यस्य यस्य यथा भवेत् ॥ 11 ॥
1.90.m: and having given a lamp, food offering, and aromatic mouth-purifier, O king, / one should then perform oblation into the fire, whatever is appropriate for each.

1.90.s:
kṛtvaivottaratantraṃ ca dattvā pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ ..
taduktāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā maṇḍale pratipādayet .. 12 ..
1.90.d:
कृत्वैवोत्तरतन्त्रं च दत्त्वा पूर्णाहुतिं ततः ॥
तदुक्तां दक्षिणां दत्त्वा मण्डले प्रतिपादयेत् ॥ 12 ॥
1.90.m: Having performed the concluding ritual and offered the final oblation, / having given the sacrificial fee prescribed for it, one should present it upon the sacred diagram.

1.90.s:
hoturvastrayugaṃ deyaṃ gaussuvarṇaṃ tathaiva ca ..
grāhyaṃ kālavidā tacca yaddattaṃ grahamaṇḍale .. 13 ..
1.90.d:
होतुर्वस्त्रयुगं देयं गौस्सुवर्णं तथैव च ॥
ग्राह्यं कालविदा तच्च यद्दत्तं ग्रहमण्डले ॥ 13 ॥
1.90.m: A pair of garments, a cow, and gold should be given to the hotṛ priest; / and whatever is given on the planetary diagram should be received by the astrologer.

1.90.s:
yathāśakti ca dātavyā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca dakṣiṇā ..
visarjanaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ tato brāhmaṇabhojanam .. .. 14 . .
1.90.d:
यथाशक्ति च दातव्या ब्राह्मणानां च दक्षिणा ॥
विसर्जनं ततः कार्यं ततो ब्राह्मणभोजनम् ॥ ॥ 14 ॥
1.90.m: And a sacrificial fee should be given to the brahmins according to one's capacity; / dismissal [of the deities] should then be made, and after that the feeding of the brahmins.

1.90.s:
bhuktavatsu ca vipreṣu pramārṣṭirmaṇḍale bhavet . .
arghyapuṣpādikaṃ sarvaṃ jale prakṣipya pārthiva .. 15 ..
1.90.d:
भुक्तवत्सु च विप्रेषु प्रमार्ष्टिर्मण्डले भवेत् ॥
अर्घ्यपुष्पादिकं सर्वं जले प्रक्षिप्य पार्थिव ॥ 15 ॥
1.90.m: When the brahmins have eaten, the clearing of the sacred diagram should take place, / casting all the guest-offerings, flowers, and the rest into water, O king.
Gratification with water should be performed; worship should take place after that.

1.90.s:
pūjāvidhiste gadito mayādya samāsataḥ pārthivasaṃghamukhya . .
ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmi tubhyaṃ tanme vadasvākhilarājasiṃha .. .. 17 ..
iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare prathamakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ 0 graharkṣapūjāvidhivarṇanaṃ nāma navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ . . 9 0 ..
1.90.d:
पूजाविधिस्ते गदितो मयाद्य समासतः पार्थिवसंघमुख्य ॥
अतः परं किं कथयामि तुभ्यं तन्मे वदस्वाखिलराजसिंह ॥ ॥ 17 ॥
इति श्रीविष्णुधर्मोत्तरे प्रथमखण्डे मा0 सं 0 ग्रहर्क्षपूजाविधिवर्णनं नाम नवतितमोऽध्यायः ॥ 9 0 ॥
1.90.m:
The ritual of worship has been declared by me today in brief, O head of the assembly of kings; / what more shall I tell you beyond this? Speak to me, O lion among all kings!
Thus ends the ninetieth chapter, named 'Description of the Ritual of Worship of Planets and Asterisms', in the first book of the venerable Viṣṇudharmottara, in the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Vajra.

1.91.s:
vajra uvāca ..
grahāṇāṃ bhārgavaśreṣṭha nakṣatrāṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthak ..
snānāni śrotumicchāmi tatpīḍāśamanānyaham .. 1 . .
1.91.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
ग्रहाणां भार्गवश्रेष्ठ नक्षत्राणां पृथक्पृथक् ॥
स्नानानि श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्पीडाशमनान्यहम् ॥ 1 ॥
1.91.m: Vajra said: / O best of the Bhṛgus, I wish to hear about the separate baths / for the planets and the asterisms that pacify affliction from them.

1.91.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
mañjiṣṭhāṃ mātuluṃgaṃ ca kuṃkumaṃ raktacandanam ..
pūrṇakumbhe kṛte tāmre sūryasnānaṃ vidhīyate .. 2 . .
1.91.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
मञ्जिष्ठां मातुलुंगं च कुंकुमं रक्तचन्दनम् ॥
पूर्णकुम्भे कृते ताम्रे सूर्यस्नानं विधीयते ॥ 2 ॥
1.91.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Madder, citron, saffron, and red sandalwood / placed in a full copper jar are prescribed as the bath for the Sun.

1.91.s:
uśīraṃ ca śirīṣaṃ ca padmakaṃ candanaṃ tathā ..
śaṃkhe nyastamidaṃ snānaṃ candradoṣanivāraṇam .. . . 3 ..
1.91.d:
उशीरं च शिरीषं च पद्मकं चन्दनं तथा ॥
शंखे न्यस्तमिदं स्नानं चन्द्रदोषनिवारणम् ॥ ॥ 3 ॥
1.91.m: Uśīra, śirīṣa, padmaka, and sandalwood / placed in a conch shell: this bath wards off the afflictions of the Moon.

1.91.s:
khadiraṃ devadāruṃ ca tilānyāmalakāni ca . .
pūrṇakumbhe kṛte raupye bhaumapīḍāvināśanam .. 4 ..
1.91.d:
खदिरं देवदारुं च तिलान्यामलकानि च ॥
पूर्णकुम्भे कृते रौप्ये भौमपीडाविनाशनम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.91.m: Khadira, deodar, sesame seeds, and āmalaka fruits / placed in a full silver jar destroy the affliction of Mars.

1.91.s:
nadīsaṃgamatoyāni tanmṛdā sahitāni ca ..
nyastāni kumbhe māhīye budhapīḍāvināśanam .. 5 ..
1.91.d:
नदीसंगमतोयानि तन्मृदा सहितानि च ॥
न्यस्तानि कुम्भे माहीये बुधपीडाविनाशनम् ॥ 5 ॥
1.91.m: Waters from river confluences along with their earth, / placed in an earthen jar, destroy the affliction of Mercury.

1.91.s:
gorocanaṃ nāgamadaṃ śatapuṣpā śatāvarī ..
vinyasya rājate kumbhe śukrapīḍānivāraṇam .. 6 ..
1.91.d:
गोरोचनं नागमदं शतपुष्पा शतावरी ॥
विन्यस्य राजते कुम्भे शुक्रपीडानिवारणम् ॥ 6 ॥
1.91.m: Gorocanā, musk, dill, and śatāvarī / placed in a silver jar ward off the affliction of Venus.

1.91.s:
tilānmāṣānpriyaṃguṃ ca gandhapatraṃ tathaiva ca ..
nyastaṃ kārṣṇāyase kumbhe saurapīḍānivāraṇam .. 7 ..
1.91.d:
तिलान्माषान्प्रियंगुं च गन्धपत्रं तथैव च ॥
न्यस्तं कार्ष्णायसे कुम्भे सौरपीडानिवारणम् ॥ 7 ॥
1.91.m: Sesame seeds, māṣa beans, priyaṅgu, and fragrant leaf / placed in an iron jar ward off the affliction of Saturn.

1.91.s:
gugguluṃ hiṃgulaṃ tālaṃ śubhāṃ caiva manaḥśilām ..
śṛṃge ca māhiṣe nyastaṃ rāhupīḍāvināśanam .. 8 ..
1.91.d:
गुग्गुलुं हिंगुलं तालं शुभां चैव मनःशिलाम् ॥
शृंगे च माहिषे न्यस्तं राहुपीडाविनाशनम् ॥ 8 ॥
1.91.m: Guggulu, cinnabar, orpiment, and auspicious realgar / placed in a buffalo horn destroy the affliction of Rāhu.

1.91.s:
varāhanirhṛtāṃ rājanparvatāgramṛdaṃ tathā ..
chāgaṃ kṣīraṃ khaḍgapātre ketupīḍāvināśanam .. 9 ..
1.91.d:
वराहनिर्हृतां राजन्पर्वताग्रमृदं तथा ॥
छागं क्षीरं खड्गपात्रे केतुपीडाविनाशनम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.91.m: Earth brought up by a boar, O king, and soil from a mountain peak, / along with goat's milk in an iron or rhinoceros-horn vessel, destroys the affliction caused by Ketu.

1.91.s:
grahasnānamidaṃ proktamṛkṣasnānamataḥ śṛṇu ..
yena samyakprayuktena mucyate kilviṣānnaraḥ .. .. 1.91.10 ..
1.91.d:
ग्रहस्नानमिदं प्रोक्तमृक्षस्नानमतः शृणु ॥
येन सम्यक्प्रयुक्तेन मुच्यते किल्विषान्नरः ॥ ॥ 1.91.10 ॥
1.91.m: This bath for the planets has been described; hear now about the asterism bath, / by which, when properly performed, a man is freed from sin.

1.91.s:
vaṭāśvatthaśirīṣāṇāṃ patrāṇi tu tilaissaha ..
sarvagandhopapannāni kṛttikāsu vidhīyate .. 11 ..
1.91.d:
वटाश्वत्थशिरीषाणां पत्राणि तु तिलैस्सह ॥
सर्वगन्धोपपन्नानि कृत्तिकासु विधीयते ॥ 11 ॥
1.91.m: The leaves of the banyan, holy fig, and siris tree, together with sesame seeds / and endowed with all fragrances, are prescribed during [the asterism] Kṛttikā.

1.91.s:
sarvabījodakasnānaṃ rohiṇīṣu praśasyate ..
sarvaratnodakasnānaṃ mṛgaśīrṣe vidhīyate .. 12 ..
1.91.d:
सर्वबीजोदकस्नानं रोहिणीषु प्रशस्यते ॥
सर्वरत्नोदकस्नानं मृगशीर्षे विधीयते ॥ 12 ॥
1.91.m: A bath in water with all varieties of seeds is commended during Rohiṇī; / a bath in water with all kinds of gems is prescribed during Mṛgaśīrṣa.

1.91.s:
vacā ca gandhā kāntābhiḥ snānaṃ raudre prakīrtitam ..
goṣṭhamṛdgomayasnānamāditye pāpanāśanam .. 13 ..
1.91.d:
वचा च गन्धा कान्ताभिः स्नानं रौद्रे प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
गोष्ठमृद्गोमयस्नानमादित्ये पापनाशनम् ॥ 13 ॥
1.91.m: Sweet flag and fragrances with priyaṅgu herbs are declared for the bath in Raudra (Ārdrā); / a bath with cowshed soil and cow dung during Āditya (Punarvasu) destroys sin.

1.91.s:
sarvauṣadhyaḥ pañcagavyaṃ tathā gaurāśca śālayaḥ ..
siddhārthakāssarvagandhāṃstiṣyasnāne śubhapradāḥ .. 14 ..
1.91.d:
सर्वौषध्यः पञ्चगव्यं तथा गौराश्च शालयः ॥
सिद्धार्थकास्सर्वगन्धांस्तिष्यस्नाने शुभप्रदाः ॥ 14 ॥
1.91.m: All medicinal herbs, the five cow products, white winter rice, / and white mustard seeds with all fragrances bestow good fortune when bathing in Tiṣya (Puṣya).

1.91.s:
valmīkāgramṛdā snānaṃ tathā sārpe śubhapradam ..
satilaṃ devanirmālyaṃ snānaṃ śastaṃ maghāsu ca .. 15 ..
1.91.d:
वल्मीकाग्रमृदा स्नानं तथा सार्पे शुभप्रदम् ॥
सतिलं देवनिर्माल्यं स्नानं शस्तं मघासु च ॥ 15 ॥
1.91.m: A bath with soil from the top of an anthill brings good fortune during Sārpa (Āśleṣā); / a bath with remains of divine flower offerings along with sesame is commended during Maghā.

1.91.s:
phalgunīṣu ca pūrvāsu śāḍvalaṃ lavaṇaṃ ghṛtam ..
uttarāsu tathā snānaṃ śimbimustāpriyaṃgubhiḥ .. 16 ..
1.91.d:
फल्गुनीषु च पूर्वासु शाड्वलं लवणं घृतम् ॥
उत्तरासु तथा स्नानं शिम्बिमुस्ताप्रियंगुभिः ॥ 16 ॥
1.91.m: During Pūrvaphalgunī, turf, salt, and clarified butter [are used]; / during Uttaraphalgunī, a bath with pods, nutgrass, and priyaṅgu.

1.91.s:
haste snānaṃ praśaṃsanti parvatāgrasaromṛdā ..
citrāsu devanirmālyaṃ svātau puṣpairjalodbhavaiḥ .. 17 ..
1.91.d:
हस्ते स्नानं प्रशंसन्ति पर्वताग्रसरोमृदा ॥
चित्रासु देवनिर्माल्यं स्वातौ पुष्पैर्जलोद्भवैः ॥ 17 ॥
1.91.m: They praise bathing during Hasta with earth from mountain peaks and lakes; / during Citrā with remains of divine offerings; during Svāti with water-born flowers.

1.91.s:
viśākhāsu praśaṃsanti raudracandanapadmakaiḥ ..
nadīkūladvayānmṛdbhirmaitre snānaṃ prakīrtitam .. 18 ..
1.91.d:
विशाखासु प्रशंसन्ति रौद्रचन्दनपद्मकैः ॥
नदीकूलद्वयान्मृद्भिर्मैत्रे स्नानं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 18 ॥
1.91.m: During Viśākhā they praise [a bath] with rudrākṣa, sandalwood, and red lotuses; / a bath with earth from both banks of a river is proclaimed during Maitra (Anurādhā).

1.91.s:
jyeṣṭhodakena jyeṣṭhāsu suvarṇasahitaṃ hitam ..
sarvamūlajalaiḥ snānamāpye muktāphalodakaiḥ .. 19 ..
1.91.d:
ज्येष्ठोदकेन ज्येष्ठासु सुवर्णसहितं हितम् ॥
सर्वमूलजलैः स्नानमाप्ये मुक्ताफलोदकैः ॥ 19 ॥
1.91.m: During Jyeṣṭhā, [a bath] with the finest water together with gold is beneficial; / during Āpya (Pūrvāṣāḍhā), a bath with water of all roots and pearl-infused water.

1.91.s:
vaiśvadeve praśaṃsanti padmakośīracandanaiḥ ..
sarvauṣadhaiścābhijiti śravaṇe saṃgamodakaiḥ .. 1.91.20 ..
1.91.d:
वैश्वदेवे प्रशंसन्ति पद्मकोशीरचन्दनैः ॥
सर्वौषधैश्चाभिजिति श्रवणे संगमोदकैः ॥ 1.91.20 ॥
1.91.m: During Vaiśvadeva (Uttarāṣāḍhā) they praise [a bath] with lotuses, vetiver, and sandalwood; / during Abhijit with all medicinal herbs; during Śravaṇa with waters from river confluences.

1.91.s:
nadīvāpījalayutairvāruṇe tu praśasyate ..
āje śrīvāsakaṃ snānaṃ kāntā puruhitaṃ hitam .. 21 ..
1.91.d:
नदीवापीजलयुतैर्वारुणे तु प्रशस्यते ॥
आजे श्रीवासकं स्नानं कान्ता पुरुहितं हितम् ॥ 21 ॥
1.91.m: During Vāruṇa (Śatabhiṣaj), [water] mixed with water from rivers and step-wells is praised; / during Āja (Pūrvabhādrapadā), a bath with turpentine resin, priyaṅgu, and turmeric is beneficial.

1.91.s:
āhirbudhnye tathā snānaṃ padmakośīracandanaiḥ ..
kuṅkumāgurukarpūraiḥ sahitaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
darbhermūlayutaiḥ pauṣṇe haridrādvayacandanaiḥ .. 22 ..
1.91.d:
आहिर्बुध्न्ये तथा स्नानं पद्मकोशीरचन्दनैः ॥
कुङ्कुमागुरुकर्पूरैः सहितं पापनाशनम् ॥
दर्भेर्मूलयुतैः पौष्णे हरिद्राद्वयचन्दनैः ॥ 22 ॥
1.91.m: Likewise, a bath during Āhirbudhnya (Uttarabhādrapadā) with lotuses, vetiver, and sandalwood, / together with saffron, agarwood, and camphor, destroys sin; / during Pauṣṇa (Revatī), [a bath] with darbha roots, both turmerics, and sandalwood.

1.91.s:
nāgāśvagandhā madavantikā ca kṣaudrānvitā cāśvinake pradiṣṭā ..
surāhva kāṣṭhaṃ rajanīdvayaṃ ca snānaṃ vacābhiḥ sahitaṃ ca yāmyam .. 23 ..
1.91.d:
नागाश्वगन्धा मदवन्तिका च क्षौद्रान्विता चाश्विनके प्रदिष्टा ॥
सुराह्व काष्ठं रजनीद्वयं च स्नानं वचाभिः सहितं च याम्यम् ॥ 23 ॥
1.91.m: Indian ironwood, aśvagandhā, and madayantī mixed with honey are prescribed during Āśvina; / during Yāmya (Bharaṇī), a bath with deodar wood, both turmerics, and sweet flag [is prescribed].

1.92.s:
.. vajra uvāca .. ..
prāktantrottaratantrau dvau sarveṣāmagnikarmaṇām ..
tvatto'haṃ śrotumicchāmi sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara .. 1 ..
1.92.d:
॥ वज्र उवाच ॥ ॥
प्राक्तन्त्रोत्तरतन्त्रौ द्वौ सर्वेषामग्निकर्मणाम् ॥
त्वत्तोऽहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि सर्वधर्मभृतां वर ॥ 1 ॥
1.92.m: Vajra said: / The two preliminary and subsequent procedures of all fire rituals, / I wish to hear from you, O best of all maintainers of dharma.

1.92.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
uddhṛtyorvīmayīṃ śuddhe deśe vediṃ ca kārayet ..
prāgudakpravaṇāṃ śuddhāmāyāmātpadasaptakam .. 2 ..
1.92.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
उद्धृत्योर्वीमयीं शुद्धे देशे वेदिं च कारयेत् ॥
प्रागुदक्प्रवणां शुद्धामायामात्पदसप्तकम् ॥ 2 ॥
1.92.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Having raised an earthen altar in a clean place, one should construct it, / pure, sloping towards the east and north, measuring seven paces in length.

1.92.s:
pūrvabhāge ca vijñeyā vistarātpadapañcakam ..
paścime ca tathā bhāge vistarātsyāccatuṣṭayam .. 3 ..
1.92.d:
पूर्वभागे च विज्ञेया विस्तरात्पदपञ्चकम् ॥
पश्चिमे च तथा भागे विस्तरात्स्याच्चतुष्टयम् ॥ 3 ॥
1.92.m: In its eastern portion, it is to be known as five paces in width; / and in its western portion, it should be four [paces] in width.

1.92.s:
āgāradeśe ca tathā vistṛtā sā padatrayam ..
pūrvabhāgādatikramya paścātpadacatuṣṭayam .. 4 ..
1.92.d:
आगारदेशे च तथा विस्तृता सा पदत्रयम् ॥
पूर्वभागादतिक्रम्य पश्चात्पदचतुष्टयम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.92.m: And likewise in the fireplace area, it is extended to three paces; / having passed beyond the eastern part, towards the rear it is four paces.

1.92.s:
yāmyenottarataścaiva vijñeyaṃ tu padaṃ padam ..
āgārātpaścime bhāge vedī jñeyā padadvayam .. 5 ..
1.92.d:
याम्येनोत्तरतश्चैव विज्ञेयं तु पदं पदम् ॥
आगारात्पश्चिमे भागे वेदी ज्ञेया पदद्वयम् ॥ 5 ॥
1.92.m: Towards the south and towards the north, one pace should be known; / behind the hearth area, the altar is to be known as two paces.

1.92.s:
vedimevaṃvidhāṃ kṛtvā snātvācamya prayatnataḥ ..
sauvarṇānrājatām̐stāmrānathavāpi mahīmayān .. 6 ..
1.92.d:
वेदिमेवंविधां कृत्वा स्नात्वाचम्य प्रयत्नतः ॥
सौवर्णान्राजताम्̐स्ताम्रानथवापि महीमयान् ॥ 6 ॥
1.92.m: Having made such an altar, having bathed and sipped water with concentrated effort, / [one should procure] golden, silver, copper, or earthen [pitchers].

1.92.s:
sūtrārghyamālyairgandhaiśca saphalaiḥ pallavairyutān ..
pūrṇodakumbhāṃścaturo vidikṣu sudṛḍhaṃ nyaset .. 7 ..
1.92.d:
सूत्रार्घ्यमाल्यैर्गन्धैश्च सफलैः पल्लवैर्युतान् ॥
पूर्णोदकुम्भांश्चतुरो विदिक्षु सुदृढं न्यसेत् ॥ 7 ॥
1.92.m: Endowed with cords, respectful offerings, garlands, fragrances, fruits, and sprouts, / four pitchers filled with water should be firmly placed in the intermediate directions.

1.92.s:
vedyāmullikhanaṃ kāryamaindrībhirnṛpasattama ..
udumbarasya śākhābhiḥ prāgagrābhiḥ samantataḥ .. 8 ..
1.92.d:
वेद्यामुल्लिखनं कार्यमैन्द्रीभिर्नृपसत्तम ॥
उदुम्बरस्य शाखाभिः प्रागग्राभिः समन्ततः ॥ 8 ॥
1.92.m: The furrowing of the altar is to be performed with twigs of the udumbara tree / pointing toward the east, in the eastern quarter and all around, O best of kings.

1.92.s:
śuṣkendhanasamṛddhastu tataḥ kāryyo hutāśanaḥ ..
na dhamettālavṛntena na śūrpeṇa na vāsasā .. 9 ..
1.92.d:
शुष्केन्धनसमृद्धस्तु ततः कार्य्यो हुताशनः ॥
न धमेत्तालवृन्तेन न शूर्पेण न वाससा ॥ 9 ॥
1.92.m: The fire is then to be built up, enriched with dry fuel; / one should not fan it with a palm leaf, nor with a winnowing basket, nor with a garment.

1.92.s:
mukhenopadhamedagniṃ mukhādagnirajāyata ..
parisamuhya paryukṣya pariṣicya paristaret .. 1.92.10 ..
1.92.d:
मुखेनोपधमेदग्निं मुखादग्निरजायत ॥
परिसमुह्य पर्युक्ष्य परिषिच्य परिस्तरेत् ॥ 1.92.10 ॥
1.92.m: One should fan the fire with the mouth, [for] fire was born from the mouth; / having swept around it, sprinkled it, sprinkled around it, one should strew [the grass around].

1.92.s:
hutāśanaṃ bodhayitvā bhūyaścāvāhayedbudhaḥ ..
vakṣyāmi bodhane mantraṃ tathā cāvāhane nṛpa .. 11 ..
1.92.d:
हुताशनं बोधयित्वा भूयश्चावाहयेद्बुधः ॥
वक्ष्यामि बोधने मन्त्रं तथा चावाहने नृप ॥ 11 ॥
1.92.m: Having awakened the fire, the wise one should further invoke it; / I will declare the mantra for awakening, and also for invocation, O king:

1.92.s:
udbuddhyāgne bodhayanti devatāstāssavāsavāḥ ..
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca skando vaiśravaṇo yamaḥ .. 12 ..
1.92.d:
उद्बुद्ध्याग्ने बोधयन्ति देवतास्तास्सवासवाः ॥
ब्रह्मा विष्णुश्च रुद्रश्च स्कन्दो वैश्रवणो यमः ॥ 12 ॥
1.92.m: 'Awake, O Fire! Those deities headed by Indra awaken [you]: / Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra, Skanda, Kubera, and Yama;

1.92.s:
varuṇo vāyurākāśaṃ candrādityau prabhākarau ..
ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgāstrailokyāmaladarśanāḥ .. 13 ..
1.92.d:
वरुणो वायुराकाशं चन्द्रादित्यौ प्रभाकरौ ॥
ऋषयश्च महाभागास्त्रैलोक्यामलदर्शनाः ॥ 13 ॥
1.92.m: Varuṇa, Vāyu, Space, the Sun and the Moon, makers of light; / and the fortunate sages of pure vision in the three worlds;

1.92.s:
vedāśca vedamātā ca sāvitrī pāpanāśinī ..
oṣadhyo'tha vaṣaṭkāro mantrāśca vividhāstathā .. 14 ..
1.92.d:
वेदाश्च वेदमाता च सावित्री पापनाशिनी ॥
ओषध्योऽथ वषट्कारो मन्त्राश्च विविधास्तथा ॥ 14 ॥
1.92.m: the Vedas, and the mother of the Vedas, Sāvitrī, destroyer of sin; / the plants, and the exclamation vaṣaṭ, and the various mantras;

1.92.s:
kālasyāvayavāssarve diśaśca vidiśastathā ..
udabuddhya yajamānasya sarvānkāmānprayaccha vai .. 15 ..
1.92.d:
कालस्यावयवास्सर्वे दिशश्च विदिशस्तथा ॥
उदबुद्ध्य यजमानस्य सर्वान्कामान्प्रयच्छ वै ॥ 15 ॥
1.92.m: all the divisions of time, and the directions and intermediate directions; / having awakened, grant indeed all the desires of the patron of the sacrifice!'

1.92.s:
(om)āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ devadevaṃ hutāśanam ..
jagato'sya samutpattisthitisaṃhārakārakam .. 16 ..
1.92.d:
(ओम्)आवाहयाम्यहं देवं देवदेवं हुताशनम् ॥
जगतोऽस्य समुत्पत्तिस्थितिसंहारकारकम् ॥ 16 ॥
1.92.m: 'Om! I invoke the god, the god of gods, Fire, / the cause of creation, maintenance, and destruction of this universe;

1.92.s:
vedamūrtiṃ tadādhāraṃ sarvadevamukhaṃ vibhum ..
piṅgekṣaṇaṃ piṅgajaṭaṃ dhūmaketuṃ vibhāvasum .. 17 ..
1.92.d:
वेदमूर्तिं तदाधारं सर्वदेवमुखं विभुम् ॥
पिङ्गेक्षणं पिङ्गजटं धूमकेतुं विभावसुम् ॥ 17 ॥
1.92.m: the embodiment of the Veda, its support, the mouth of all gods, the all-pervading lord, / yellow-eyed, with reddish-brown matted locks, the smoke-bannered shining one;

1.92.s:
śukayānagamaṃ devaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ..
sarvagaṃ varadaṃ bhānuṃ jaṭharasthaṃ ca dehinām .. 18 ..
1.92.d:
शुकयानगमं देवं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् ॥
सर्वगं वरदं भानुं जठरस्थं च देहिनाम् ॥ 18 ॥
1.92.m: the god who moves in a parrot chariot, adorned with all ornaments, / omnipresent, granter of boons, radiant, residing in the stomach of embodied beings;

1.92.s:
tejomūrttiṃ durādharṣaṃ saptajihvaṃ mahābalam ..
saptārciṣaṃ saptarṣikaṃ ca samitsaptakamacyutam .. 19 ..
1.92.d:
तेजोमूर्त्तिं दुराधर्षं सप्तजिह्वं महाबलम् ॥
सप्तार्चिषं सप्तर्षिकं च समित्सप्तकमच्युतम् ॥ 19 ॥
1.92.m: the embodiment of splendour, invincible, seven-tongued, of great power, / seven-flamed, accompanied by the seven sages, possessing seven sacrificial sticks, the imperishable one;

1.92.s:
viṣṇoraṃśamanirdeśyaṃ bhāvanaṃ jātavedasam ..
pāvanaṃ puṣṭidaṃ saumyaṃ bhaktānāṃ bhūtivardhanam .. 1.92.20 ..
1.92.d:
विष्णोरंशमनिर्देश्यं भावनं जातवेदसम् ॥
पावनं पुष्टिदं सौम्यं भक्तानां भूतिवर्धनम् ॥ 1.92.20 ॥
1.92.m: the indefinable portion of Viṣṇu, creator, Jātavedas, / purifier, giver of nourishment, benevolent, increaser of the prosperity of devotees!

1.92.s:
taddattamāhutigaṇaṃ saṃpratīccha jagadguro ..
tena bhāvaya deveśa yathāhaṃ devatāgaṇān .. 21 ..
1.92.d:
तद्दत्तमाहुतिगणं संप्रतीच्छ जगद्गुरो ॥
तेन भावय देवेश यथाहं देवतागणान् ॥ 21 ॥
1.92.m: 'O teacher of the world, receive that host of oblations given by him; / O lord of the gods, satisfy through it the hosts of deities according to my wish!

1.92.s:
yājakaṃ yajamānaṃ ca puṣṭyā vibhaja sarvaśaḥ ..
idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ pragṛhyatām .. 22 ..
1.92.d:
याजकं यजमानं च पुष्ट्या विभज सर्वशः ॥
इदमर्घ्यमिदं पाद्यं धूपं दीपं प्रगृह्यताम् ॥ 22 ॥
1.92.m: Share out fully with nourishment both the officiating priest and the sacrificer; / let this respectful offering, this foot-water, incense, and lamp be received!'

1.92.s:
evamāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā pādyārghyaṃ vinivedayet ..
vedyāmeva na tau deyau vahnau yadukulodvaha .. 23 ..
1.92.d:
एवमावाहनं कृत्वा पाद्यार्घ्यं विनिवेदयेत् ॥
वेद्यामेव न तौ देयौ वह्नौ यदुकुलोद्वह ॥ 23 ॥
1.92.m: Having thus performed the invocation, one should offer the foot-water and the respectful offering; / those two should be given on the altar itself, not in the fire, O descendant of the Yadu race.

1.92.s:
gandhapuṣpādikaṃ deyaṃ sakalañjātavedasi ..
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ sanaivaidyaṃ vedyāmeva nivedayet .. 24 ..
1.92.d:
गन्धपुष्पादिकं देयं सकलञ्जातवेदसि ॥
धूपं दीपं सनैवैद्यं वेद्यामेव निवेदयेत् ॥ 24 ॥
1.92.m: Perfumes, flowers, and the like should all be given into the fire; / incense, lamp, and food offerings one should present on the altar itself.

1.92.s:
tatastu prastaredvedimakṣatāgraiḥ kuśairdvija ..
upamūlādadholūnaiḥ prāgagraiḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ .. 25 ..
1.92.d:
ततस्तु प्रस्तरेद्वेदिमक्षताग्रैः कुशैर्द्विज ॥
उपमूलादधोलूनैः प्रागग्रैः प्रयतः शुचिः ॥ 25 ॥
1.92.m: Then, O twice-born, the attentive and pure [sacrificer] should strew the altar / with kuśa grass with unbroken tips, cut below near the root, with points facing east.

1.92.s:
pūrve ca prāgdakṣiṇataḥ paścāccaivāpasavyataḥ ..
uttareṇa tataḥ kuryātprastarasya samāpanam .. 26 ..
1.92.d:
पूर्वे च प्राग्दक्षिणतः पश्चाच्चैवापसव्यतः ॥
उत्तरेण ततः कुर्यात्प्रस्तरस्य समापनम् ॥ 26 ॥
1.92.m: In the east, [pointing] east; from the south; and in the west, counter-clockwise; / then from the north, he should complete the strewing of grass.

1.92.s:
mūlacchinnantu dātavyaṃ prastare bhūbhṛtāṃ vara ..
oṣadhyaḥ phalavantyaśca parvavatyastathaiva ca .. 27 ..
1.92.d:
मूलच्छिन्नन्तु दातव्यं प्रस्तरे भूभृतां वर ॥
ओषध्यः फलवन्त्यश्च पर्ववत्यस्तथैव च ॥ 27 ॥
1.92.m: Plants with cut roots are to be laid down in the strewing, O best of kings, / as well as those that bear fruit and possess joints.

1.92.s:
darbhābhāve praśaṃsanti tisrastatra ca varjayet ..
rājasīravarūkaṃ ca paribādhamathotkaṭam .. 28 ..
1.92.d:
दर्भाभावे प्रशंसन्ति तिस्रस्तत्र च वर्जयेत् ॥
राजसीरवरूकं च परिबाधमथोत्कटम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.92.m: In the absence of darbha grass, they praise [other grasses], but three should be avoided there: / rājasīra, varūka, and paribādha, as well as utkaṭa.

1.92.s:
viṣṇurmanasā pūte sto mantreṇānena suvrata ..
dārbhaṃ pavitramutsajya tābhyāṃ ca tadanantaram .. 29 ..
1.92.d:
विष्णुर्मनसा पूते स्तो मन्त्रेणानेन सुव्रत ॥
दार्भं पवित्रमुत्सज्य ताभ्यां च तदनन्तरम् ॥ 29 ॥
1.92.m: With this mantra, "Viṣṇu, by mind you two are purified," O one of good vows, / having thrown down the darbha strainer, and immediately after that with those two,

1.92.s:
devova ityathaitena utpūyamudakaṃ śuci ..
sruksruvāvatha pālāśau śamīnyagrodhasaṃbhavau .. 1.92.30 ..
1.92.d:
देवोव इत्यथैतेन उत्पूयमुदकं शुचि ॥
स्रुक्स्रुवावथ पालाशौ शमीन्यग्रोधसंभवौ ॥ 1.92.30 ॥
1.92.m: having purified pure water with "Devo vaḥ,"/ the sruc and sruva ladles should then be made of palāśa, or born of śamī or nyagrodha,

1.92.s:
udumbaramayau tāmrau rūpyarukmamayau tathā ..
ājyasthālī ca kartavyā taijasadravyasambhavā ..31 ..
1.92.d:
उदुम्बरमयौ ताम्रौ रूप्यरुक्ममयौ तथा ॥
आज्यस्थाली च कर्तव्या तैजसद्रव्यसम्भवा ॥31 ॥
1.92.m: or made of udumbara, of copper, or made of silver or gold; / and the ghee-pot should be made from metallic material,

1.92.s:
māheyī vāpi bhūpāla nityasarvāgnikarmasu ..
hastamātraḥ sruvaḥ kāryo sruva bāhusamaṃ tathā..32..
1.92.d:
माहेयी वापि भूपाल नित्यसर्वाग्निकर्मसु ॥
हस्तमात्रः स्रुवः कार्यो स्रुव बाहुसमं तथा॥32॥
1.92.m: or of clay, O king, in all regular fire rituals. / The sruva should be made one cubit long, and the sruc equal [in length] to the arm.

1.92.s:
aṅguṣṭhamadhyapratimaṃ homasthānaṃ sruvasya tu..
ājyasthālyāḥ pramāṇantu yathākāmantu kārayet..33..
1.92.d:
अङ्गुष्ठमध्यप्रतिमं होमस्थानं स्रुवस्य तु॥
आज्यस्थाल्याः प्रमाणन्तु यथाकामन्तु कारयेत्॥33॥
1.92.m: The cavity for offering in the sruva should match the middle of the thumb, / but one may have the size of the ghee-pot made according to desire.

1.92.s:
grāmaṃ pṛścāpayosīti mantreṇājyaṃ narādhipa..
ājyasthālyāḥ payotpūtaṃ pañcānāmiti pañcakam .. 34 ..
1.92.d:
ग्रामं पृश्चापयोसीति मन्त्रेणाज्यं नराधिप॥
आज्यस्थाल्याः पयोत्पूतं पञ्चानामिति पञ्चकम् ॥ 34 ॥
1.92.m: With the mantra, "grāmaṃ pṛścāpaya"... "you are milk," O ruler of men, / the milk purified from the ghee-pot... reciting the set of five beginning with "pañcānām",

1.92.s:
paṭhangṛhṇīta rājendra arjetyagnāvadhiśrayet ..
ājyasyātha pavitreṇa kārya mutplavanaṃ dvija .. 35 ..
1.92.d:
पठन्गृह्णीत राजेन्द्र अर्जेत्यग्नावधिश्रयेत् ॥
आज्यस्याथ पवित्रेण कार्य मुत्प्लवनं द्विज ॥ 35 ॥
1.92.m: one should take it, O king of kings, and with "arja" place it on the fire. / Then, O twice-born, the skimming of the ghee should be done with a strainer.

1.92.s:
agnirjihveti satataṃ havirasyutpavanāntaram ..
akṣīṇantu na kartavyaṃ satataṃ pārthivottama .. 36 ..
1.92.d:
अग्निर्जिह्वेति सततं हविरस्युत्पवनान्तरम् ॥
अक्षीणन्तु न कर्तव्यं सततं पार्थिवोत्तम ॥ 36 ॥
1.92.m: Constantly with "agnirjihvā"... and after the purification of the oblation, / it should never be made deficient, O best of kings.

1.92.s:
śubhābhyāṃ sruksruvau rājanpratyuṣṭamiti bhāvaya ..
