pavitrasyāgradarbheṇa āyurityeva mānada .. 37 ..
1.92.d:
शुभाभ्यां स्रुक्स्रुवौ राजन्प्रत्युष्टमिति भावय ॥
पवित्रस्याग्रदर्भेण आयुरित्येव मानद ॥ 37 ॥
1.92.m: Regard the sruc and sruva ladles with auspicious [substances] as heated, O king, with "pratyuṣṭam." / With the tip-darbha of the strainer, with "āyuḥ," O giver of honour,

1.92.s:
pratimārṣṭi bhuvaṃ paścāccakṣurityeva pārthiva ..
pratimārṣṭi sruvaṃ tām̐śca darbhānvahnāvathotsṛjet ..38..
1.92.d:
प्रतिमार्ष्टि भुवं पश्चाच्चक्षुरित्येव पार्थिव ॥
प्रतिमार्ष्टि स्रुवं ताम्̐श्च दर्भान्वह्नावथोत्सृजेत् ॥38॥
1.92.m: he wipes the earth behind, and with "cakṣuḥ," O king, / he wipes the sruva, and should then discard those darbhas into the fire.

1.92.s:
darbhotsarge paṭhenmantramimaṃ pārthivasattama ..
divi śilpamavatataṃ pṛthivyāḥ kakṣibhiḥ śritam .. 39..
1.92.d:
दर्भोत्सर्गे पठेन्मन्त्रमिमं पार्थिवसत्तम ॥
दिवि शिल्पमवततं पृथिव्याः कक्षिभिः श्रितम् ॥ 39॥
1.92.m: At the discarding of the darbhas, one should recite this mantra, O best of kings: / "Art is spread out in heaven, resting on the sides of the earth;

1.92.s:
tena sahasrakāṇḍena dviṣantaṃ tāpayāmasi ..
dviṣantastapyatāṃ coktvā kṣipeddarbhānhutāśane ..1.92.40..
1.92.d:
तेन सहस्रकाण्डेन द्विषन्तं तापयामसि ॥
द्विषन्तस्तप्यतां चोक्त्वा क्षिपेद्दर्भान्हुताशने ॥1.92.40॥
1.92.m: with that thousand-jointed [grass] we torment him who hates us." / Having said, "May those who hate us be tormented," he should throw the darbhas into the fire.

1.92.s:
idhmadvayaṃ tato deyaṃ yājñiyadrumasambhavam ..
palāśaḥ khadiro bilvaḥ śamyaśvatthavaṭāstathā ..41..
1.92.d:
इध्मद्वयं ततो देयं याज्ञियद्रुमसम्भवम् ॥
पलाशः खदिरो बिल्वः शम्यश्वत्थवटास्तथा ॥41॥
1.92.m: Then two fuel-sticks derived from sacrificial trees are to be offered: / palāśa, khadira, bilva, śamī, aśvattha, and vaṭa,

1.92.s:
udumbaramapāmārgaḥ phalguśca kramukastathā ..
candanaṃ devadāruśca drumā dvādaśa yājñiyāḥ ..42..
1.92.d:
उदुम्बरमपामार्गः फल्गुश्च क्रमुकस्तथा ॥
चन्दनं देवदारुश्च द्रुमा द्वादश याज्ञियाः ॥42॥
1.92.m: udumbara, apāmārga, phalgu, and kramuka, / sandalwood and devadāru: these twelve are sacrificial trees.

1.92.s:
caturgṛhītaṃ vinyasya sruci pūrvaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
idhmadvaye prajvalite saumyabhāge narādhipa ..43..
1.92.d:
चतुर्गृहीतं विन्यस्य स्रुचि पूर्वं विचक्षणः ॥
इध्मद्वये प्रज्वलिते सौम्यभागे नराधिप ॥43॥
1.92.m: Having first placed the fourfold oblation into the sruc, the wise man, / when the two fuel-sticks are ablaze, on the northern portion, O ruler of men,

1.92.s:
prajānāmpataye tvādāvāhutiṃ manasā nyaset ..
caturgṛhīte mūrddheti deyā dakṣiṇato bhavet.. ..44..
1.92.d:
प्रजानाम्पतये त्वादावाहुतिं मनसा न्यसेत् ॥
चतुर्गृहीते मूर्द्धेति देया दक्षिणतो भवेत्॥ ॥44॥
1.92.m: should first offer the oblation mentally to Prajāpati. / With the fourfold oblation, [an offering] is to be made on the south with "mūrdhā."

1.92.s:
yuktaḥ parastādityādi pañcakaṃ juhuyāttataḥ ..
santatīśca jayādyāstāstathā rāṣṭrabhṛto nṛpa ..45..
1.92.d:
युक्तः परस्तादित्यादि पञ्चकं जुहुयात्ततः ॥
सन्ततीश्च जयाद्यास्तास्तथा राष्ट्रभृतो नृप ॥45॥
1.92.m: Then one should offer the group of five beginning with "yuktaḥ parastāt," / and the santatis, those beginning with jaya, and likewise the rāṣṭrabhṛts, O king.

1.92.s:
vārtraghnau cājyabhāgau ca dātavyau pārthivottama ..
athaudumbarapatrāṇāṃ vedau dakṣiṇato nṛpa .. 46 ..
1.92.d:
वार्त्रघ्नौ चाज्यभागौ च दातव्यौ पार्थिवोत्तम ॥
अथौदुम्बरपत्राणां वेदौ दक्षिणतो नृप ॥ 46 ॥
1.92.m: And the two vārtraghna portions of ghee are to be offered, O best of kings. / Then to the south of the altar, O king, on a collection of udumbara leaves

1.92.s:
sañcaye padmapatrāṇāmathavāpi mahīpate ..
āvāhanaṃ tu kartavyaṃ devasya parameṣṭhinaḥ .. 47 ..
1.92.d:
सञ्चये पद्मपत्राणामथवापि महीपते ॥
आवाहनं तु कर्तव्यं देवस्य परमेष्ठिनः ॥ 47 ॥
1.92.m: or indeed on lotus leaves, O lord of the earth, / the invocation of the god Parameṣṭhin is to be performed:

1.92.s:
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam ..
jagato'sya samutpattisthitisaṃhārakārakam ..48..
1.92.d:
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं ब्रह्माणं परमेष्ठिनम् ॥
जगतोऽस्य समुत्पत्तिस्थितिसंहारकारकम् ॥48॥
1.92.m: "I invoke the god Brahmā, the Parameṣṭhin, / the maker of the creation, preservation, and dissolution of this universe,

1.92.s:
caturvedaṃ caturvaktraṃ cāturvaṇyaprabhuṃ prabhum ..
caturāśramagoptāraṃ varadaṃ bhūtabhāvanam .. 49
1.92.d:
चतुर्वेदं चतुर्वक्त्रं चातुर्वण्यप्रभुं प्रभुम् ॥
चतुराश्रमगोप्तारं वरदं भूतभावनम् ॥ 49
1.92.m: who possesses the four Vedas, who has four faces, the master who is master of the four classes, / the protector of the four stages of life, the granter of boons, the source of beings,

1.92.s:
padmayoniṃ jagadyoniṃ yajñayoniṃ jagatpatim ..
ātmayonimanādhṛṣyaṃ yajñavāhaṃ jagatpatim .. 1.92.50 ..
1.92.d:
पद्मयोनिं जगद्योनिं यज्ञयोनिं जगत्पतिम् ॥
आत्मयोनिमनाधृष्यं यज्ञवाहं जगत्पतिम् ॥ 1.92.50 ॥
1.92.m: whose origin is the lotus, the origin of the universe, the origin of sacrifice, the lord of the universe, / whose origin is himself, unassailable, who conveys the sacrifice, the lord of the universe,

1.92.s:
yajñeśaṃ yajñamūrtiṃ ca trailokyasyaikakāraṇam ..
sarvagaṃ varadaṃ saumyaṃ paramaṃ parameśvaram .. 51 ..
1.92.d:
यज्ञेशं यज्ञमूर्तिं च त्रैलोक्यस्यैककारणम् ॥
सर्वगं वरदं सौम्यं परमं परमेश्वरम् ॥ 51 ॥
1.92.m: the lord of sacrifice, the embodiment of sacrifice, the sole cause of the three worlds, / omnipresent, boon-granting, gentle, the supreme, the supreme lord,

1.92.s:
bhūtabhavyabhavaṃ nāthaṃ yogajñeyaṃ sanātanam ..
āgaccha bhagavanbrahmanyajamānasya vṛddhaye .. 52 ..
1.92.d:
भूतभव्यभवं नाथं योगज्ञेयं सनातनम् ॥
आगच्छ भगवन्ब्रह्मन्यजमानस्य वृद्धये ॥ 52 ॥
1.92.m: the lord of the past, future, and present, who is known through yoga, eternal: / come, O venerable Brahmā, for the prosperity of the sacrificer!

1.92.s:
idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ dhūpaṃ cedaṃ pragṛhyatām ..
brahmaliṅgāṃstato mantrāñjapedbhaktyā samāhitaḥ .. 53 ..
1.92.d:
इदमर्घ्यमिदं पाद्यं धूपं चेदं प्रगृह्यताम् ॥
ब्रह्मलिङ्गांस्ततो मन्त्राञ्जपेद्भक्त्या समाहितः ॥ 53 ॥
1.92.m: This is water for hospitality, this is water for the feet, and this incense is to be accepted." / Then, concentrated, he should recite with devotion the mantras indicating Brahmā.

1.92.s:
āpohiṣṭheti mantreṇa brahmaṇo'rghyaṃ nivedayet ..
śannodevīti pādyaṃ ca prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ .. 54 ..
1.92.d:
आपोहिष्ठेति मन्त्रेण ब्रह्मणोऽर्घ्यं निवेदयेत् ॥
शन्नोदेवीति पाद्यं च प्रयतः सुसमाहितः ॥ 54 ॥
1.92.m: With the mantra "āpo hi ṣṭha" he should present water for hospitality to Brahmā, / and water for the feet with "śaṃ no devīḥ," pure and deeply concentrated.

1.92.s:
hiraṇyagarbheti tathā dadyādācamanaṃ budhaḥ ..
dhruvā dyauriti mantreṇa hyāsanaṃ vinivedayet .. 55 ..
1.92.d:
हिरण्यगर्भेति तथा दद्यादाचमनं बुधः ॥
ध्रुवा द्यौरिति मन्त्रेण ह्यासनं विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 55 ॥
1.92.m: Likewise, the wise man should offer water for sipping with "hiraṇyagarbhaḥ," / and he should present the seat with the mantra "dhruvā dyauḥ."

1.92.s:
gandhaṃ puṣpamalaṅkāraṃ vastraṃ dhūpaṃ sadīpakam ..
naivedyaṃ ca tathā deyaṃ sāvitreṇa narādhipa .. 56 ..
1.92.d:
गन्धं पुष्पमलङ्कारं वस्त्रं धूपं सदीपकम् ॥
नैवेद्यं च तथा देयं सावित्रेण नराधिप ॥ 56 ॥
1.92.m: Sandal paste, flowers, ornaments, clothing, incense with a lamp, / and food offerings are likewise to be given with the Sāvitra mantra, O ruler of men.

1.92.s:
prāktantrametaduktaṃ te mayā sarvāgnikarmasu ..
prāktantre tu kṛte kāryaṃ homamantramayāsakam .. 57 ..
1.92.d:
प्राक्तन्त्रमेतदुक्तं ते मया सर्वाग्निकर्मसु ॥
प्राक्तन्त्रे तु कृते कार्यं होममन्त्रमयासकम् ॥ 57 ॥
1.92.m: This preliminary ritual procedure has been declared to you by me for all fire rituals; / but when the preliminary procedure is done, the homa consisting of mantras is to be performed effortlessly.

1.92.s: evaṃ kāryaṃ mahīnātha sarveṣvevāgnikarmasu .. 58 ..
1.92.d: एवं कार्यं महीनाथ सर्वेष्वेवाग्निकर्मसु ॥ 58 ॥
1.92.m: In this way it is to be done, O lord of the earth, in all fire rituals.

1.92.s:
homasya vihitasyānte tantraṃ kāryamathottaram ..
mahākalpasya kalpasya tathā manvantarasya ca .. 59 ..
1.92.d:
होमस्य विहितस्यान्ते तन्त्रं कार्यमथोत्तरम् ॥
महाकल्पस्य कल्पस्य तथा मन्वन्तरस्य च ॥ 59 ॥
1.92.m: At the conclusion of the prescribed homa, the concluding ritual procedure is then to be performed: / for the great kalpa, for the kalpa, and likewise for the manvantara,

1.92.s:
yugasyātha samāyāścāyanasya hi tathaiva ca ..
ṛtormāsasya pakṣasya grahanakṣatrayostathā .. 1.92.60 ..
1.92.d:
युगस्याथ समायाश्चायनस्य हि तथैव च ॥
ऋतोर्मासस्य पक्षस्य ग्रहनक्षत्रयोस्तथा ॥ 1.92.60 ॥
1.92.m: and for the yuga, for the year, and likewise for the solstice, / for the season, the month, the fortnight, and likewise for the planet and the lunar mansion,

1.92.s:
titheśca karaṇasyātha muhūrtasya ca pārthiva ..
varttamānasya sarvasya deyasyādhipatirbhavet .. 61 ..
1.92.d:
तिथेश्च करणस्याथ मुहूर्तस्य च पार्थिव ॥
वर्त्तमानस्य सर्वस्य देयस्याधिपतिर्भवेत् ॥ 61 ॥
1.92.m: and for the lunar day, the karaṇa, and the muhūrta, O king; / he should become the overlord of everything that is present and to be given.

1.92.s:
iha gāva ayaṃ yajña ānaḥ prajāstathaiva ca ..
dhṛtiṃ caivopadhṛtiṃ ca ihābhāgaṃ tathaiva ca .. 62 ..
1.92.d:
इह गाव अयं यज्ञ आनः प्रजास्तथैव च ॥
धृतिं चैवोपधृतिं च इहाभागं तथैव च ॥ 62 ॥
1.92.m: [With the mantras] "iha gāvaḥ," "ayaṃ yajñaḥ," and likewise "ā naḥ prajāḥ," / and the dhṛti and upadhṛti, and likewise "ihābhāgaḥ,"

1.92.s:
deyaṃ caturgṛhītena homadravyeṇa pārthiva ..
tvanno agne varuṇasya sa tvaṃno agna eva ca .. 63 ..
1.92.d:
देयं चतुर्गृहीतेन होमद्रव्येण पार्थिव ॥
त्वन्नो अग्ने वरुणस्य स त्वंनो अग्न एव च ॥ 63 ॥
1.92.m: the offering is to be made with a fourfold gathering of the oblation substance, O king. / With "tvaṃ no agne varuṇasya" and "sa tvaṃ no agne",

1.92.s:
ayāścāgnestathaiveti tathā vyāhṛtayo nṛpa ..
tvanno agneti ca tato hotavyamṛktrayaṃ punaḥ .. 64 ..
1.92.d:
अयाश्चाग्नेस्तथैवेति तथा व्याहृतयो नृप ॥
त्वन्नो अग्नेति च ततो होतव्यमृक्त्रयं पुनः ॥ 64 ॥
1.92.m: and likewise "ayāś cāgneḥ," and likewise the vyāhṛtis, O king, / and then the triplet of verses beginning with "tvaṃ no agne" is to be offered again.

1.92.s:
nyūnaṃ tateti rikteti nyūne caivātiriktakam ..
samaṃ same tathā hutvā hotavyamṛktrayaṃ tataḥ .. 65 ..
1.92.d:
न्यूनं ततेति रिक्तेति न्यूने चैवातिरिक्तकम् ॥
समं समे तथा हुत्वा होतव्यमृक्त्रयं ततः ॥ 65 ॥
1.92.m: With "nyūnaṃ tata," with "riktā," the deficient and the redundant, / and the balanced with what is balanced; having offered thus, the triplet of verses is then to be offered:

1.92.s:
anājñātaṃ yadājñātaṃ sviṣṭiścāpyatha pārthiva ..
manorjyotistathaivātra trayastriṃśattathaiva ca .. 66 ..
1.92.d:
अनाज्ञातं यदाज्ञातं स्विष्टिश्चाप्यथ पार्थिव ॥
मनोर्ज्योतिस्तथैवात्र त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तथैव च ॥ 66 ॥
1.92.m: "anājñātaṃ yad ājñātam" and the sviṣṭi oblation, O king, / and likewise "mano jyotiḥ" here, and likewise "trayastriṃśat,"

1.92.s:
yanme ca manasā cchidraṃ viśvakarmā tathaiva ca ..
ayāścāgnestathā rājantvanno agne tathaiva ca ..
satvanno agne ityevaṃ hutvā pārthivasattama .. 67 ..
1.92.d:
यन्मे च मनसा च्छिद्रं विश्वकर्मा तथैव च ॥
अयाश्चाग्नेस्तथा राजन्त्वन्नो अग्ने तथैव च ॥
सत्वन्नो अग्ने इत्येवं हुत्वा पार्थिवसत्तम ॥ 67 ॥
1.92.m: and "yan me manasaś chidram," and likewise "viśvakarmā," / and "ayāś cāgneḥ," O king, and likewise "tvaṃ no agne" / and "sa tvaṃ no agne"—having offered thus, O best of kings,

1.92.s: āśrāviteti mantreṇa deyā pūrṇāhutirbhavet .. 68 ..
1.92.d: आश्रावितेति मन्त्रेण देया पूर्णाहुतिर्भवेत् ॥ 68 ॥
1.92.m: the final full oblation is to be made with the mantra beginning with "āśrāvita."

1.92.s:
iṣṭo hi yajño bhṛgubhirmaṃtreṇānena pārthiva ..
ājyasthālīṃ sruksruvau ca darbhaistu parimārjayet .. 69 ..
1.92.d:
इष्टो हि यज्ञो भृगुभिर्मंत्रेणानेन पार्थिव ॥
आज्यस्थालीं स्रुक्स्रुवौ च दर्भैस्तु परिमार्जयेत् ॥ 69 ॥
1.92.m: With this mantra, "The sacrifice has indeed been offered by the Bhṛgus," O king, / he should wipe around the ghee-pot and the sruc and sruva with darbhas.

1.92.s:
tām̐śca darbhānkṣipedvahnau prayataḥ susamāhitaḥ ..
pūrṇamityeva ca sruvā kāryaṃ saṃvīkṣaṇaṃ tataḥ .. 1.92.70..
1.92.d:
ताम्̐श्च दर्भान्क्षिपेद्वह्नौ प्रयतः सुसमाहितः ॥
पूर्णमित्येव च स्रुवा कार्यं संवीक्षणं ततः ॥ 1.92.70॥
1.92.m: And he should cast those darbhas into the fire, pure and deeply concentrated. / Then an inspection should be performed by the sruva with "pūrṇam."

1.92.s:
yathādiśaṃ mahīpāla tathā kuryādvimocanam ..
tato visarjanaṃ kāryaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ .. 71 ..
1.92.d:
यथादिशं महीपाल तथा कुर्याद्विमोचनम् ॥
ततो विसर्जनं कार्यं ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः ॥ 71 ॥
1.92.m: He should perform the untying according to each direction, O protector of the earth. / Then the dismissal of Brahmā the Parameṣṭhin is to be performed:

1.92.s:
bhagavandevadeveśa jagatāmārtināśana ..
vrajasva pūjāmādāya punarāgamanāya ca ..72..
1.92.d:
भगवन्देवदेवेश जगतामार्तिनाशन ॥
व्रजस्व पूजामादाय पुनरागमनाय च ॥72॥
1.92.m: "O venerable one, O lord of the gods of gods, O destroyer of the affliction of the worlds, / having accepted the worship, depart in order to return again."

1.92.s:
yajamānasya śāntyarthaṃ sarvasya jagatastathā ..
ārogyadhanadhānyena yajamānaṃ ca vardhaya ..73..
1.92.d:
यजमानस्य शान्त्यर्थं सर्वस्य जगतस्तथा ॥
आरोग्यधनधान्येन यजमानं च वर्धय ॥73॥
1.92.m: for the pacification of the sacrificer and of the entire world, / and make the sacrificer flourish with health, wealth, and grain!

1.92.s:
hutāśanasya karttavyaṃ tato rājanvisarjanam ..
dravyabhuktvaṃ vareṇyastvaṃ praṇatārtivināśanaḥ ..74 ..
1.92.d:
हुताशनस्य कर्त्तव्यं ततो राजन्विसर्जनम् ॥
द्रव्यभुक्त्वं वरेण्यस्त्वं प्रणतार्तिविनाशनः ॥74 ॥
1.92.m: Then, O king, the dismissal of the fire should be performed: / "You consume the oblations, you are most choice, the destroyer of the distress of those who bow down;

1.92.s:
vrajasva pūjāmādāya punarāgamanāya ca..
śāntyarthaṃ yajamānasya rāṣṭrasya ca vivṛddhaye ..75...
1.92.d:
व्रजस्व पूजामादाय पुनरागमनाय च॥
शान्त्यर्थं यजमानस्य राष्ट्रस्य च विवृद्धये ॥75॥।
1.92.m: go, having accepted the worship, and for the sake of coming again, / for the pacification of the sacrificer and for the prosperity of the realm,

1.92.s:
gobrāhmaṇahitārthāya jayāya ca mahīpateḥ ..
pūrṇapātramathādāya vācyaṃ svastyayanaṃ tataḥ ..76..
1.92.d:
गोब्राह्मणहितार्थाय जयाय च महीपतेः ॥
पूर्णपात्रमथादाय वाच्यं स्वस्त्ययनं ततः ॥76॥
1.92.m: for the benefit of cows and brahmins, and for the victory of the ruler of the earth!" / Then, taking up the full vessel, the recitation for well-being should be pronounced.

1.92.s:
tatastu dakṣiṇā deyā yathā proktā mayā purā ..
etaduttaratantraṃ tu proktaṃ sarvāgnikarmaṇām..77..
1.92.d:
ततस्तु दक्षिणा देया यथा प्रोक्ता मया पुरा ॥
एतदुत्तरतन्त्रं तु प्रोक्तं सर्वाग्निकर्मणाम्॥77॥
1.92.m: Then the sacrificial fee should be given, as was stated by me before. / This is declared to be the concluding ritual of all rites in the fire.

1.92.s:
vidhānametatkathitaṃ tavādya sarvāgnikarmasvanaghopayogi..
ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmi rājaṃstanme vadasvāyatalohitākṣa ..78..
1.92.d:
विधानमेतत्कथितं तवाद्य सर्वाग्निकर्मस्वनघोपयोगि॥
अतः परं किं कथयामि राजंस्तन्मे वदस्वायतलोहिताक्ष ॥78॥
1.92.m: This rule, useful in all rites in the fire, has today been related to you, O sinless one. / Beyond this, what shall I speak of, O king? Tell that to me, O you with wide red eyes!

1.93.s:
vajra uvāca ..
vistarācchrotumicchāmi grahanakṣatrapūjanam ..
tvatto'haṃ bhārgavaśreṣṭha tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ .. 1 ..
1.93.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
विस्तराच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि ग्रहनक्षत्रपूजनम् ॥
त्वत्तोऽहं भार्गवश्रेष्ठ तन्ममाचक्ष्व पृच्छतः ॥ 1 ॥
1.93.m: Vajra said: / I desire to hear in full about the worship of planets and asterisms / from you, O foremost of the Bhṛgus; tell that to me as I ask.

1.93.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
kalpite maṇḍale snātaḥ prāktantre ca tathā kṛte ..
maṇḍalasya tu śaucārthaṃ pañcagavyaṃ prakalpayet .. 2 ..
1.93.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
कल्पिते मण्डले स्नातः प्राक्तन्त्रे च तथा कृते ॥
मण्डलस्य तु शौचार्थं पञ्चगव्यं प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 2 ॥
1.93.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / When the sacred diagram has been prepared and one has bathed, and when the preliminary ritual has been performed in the same way, / one should prepare the five products of the cow for the purification of the sacred diagram.

1.93.s:
payaḥ kāñcanavarṇāyā nīlāyāśca tathā ghṛtam ..
dadhi vai kṛṣṇavarṇāyāḥ śvetāyāścaiva gomayam ..3..
1.93.d:
पयः काञ्चनवर्णाया नीलायाश्च तथा घृतम् ॥
दधि वै कृष्णवर्णायाः श्वेतायाश्चैव गोमयम् ॥3॥
1.93.m: Milk from a gold-coloured [cow], ghee from a dark-blue one, / curd from a black-coloured one, and cow dung from a white one,

1.93.s:
gomūtraṃ tāmravarṇāyāḥ pañcagavyaṃ prakalpayet ..
athaitāni samastāni kapilāyāssamāharet .. 4 ..
1.93.d:
गोमूत्रं ताम्रवर्णायाः पञ्चगव्यं प्रकल्पयेत् ॥
अथैतानि समस्तानि कपिलायास्समाहरेत् ॥ 4 ॥
1.93.m: cow urine from a copper-coloured one—thus one should prepare the five products of the cow. / Or, one may obtain all these from a tawny cow.

1.93.s:
gāyatryā gṛhya gomūtraṃ rathe akṣeti gomayam ..
āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhi .. 5 ..
1.93.d:
गायत्र्या गृह्य गोमूत्रं रथे अक्षेति गोमयम् ॥
आप्यायस्वेति च क्षीरं दधिक्राव्णेति वै दधि ॥ 5 ॥
1.93.m: Taking the cow urine with the Gāyatrī, the cow dung with "Rathe akṣa…", / the milk with "Āpyāyasva…", and the curd with "Dadhikrāvṇaḥ…",

1.93.s:
tejosi śukramityājyaṃ sāvitreṇa kuśodakam ..
aghamarṣaṇamantreṇa saṃyojya praṇavena tu .. 6 ..
1.93.d:
तेजोसि शुक्रमित्याज्यं सावित्रेण कुशोदकम् ॥
अघमर्षणमन्त्रेण संयोज्य प्रणवेन तु ॥ 6 ॥
1.93.m: the ghee with "Tejo 'si śukram…", kuśa-water with the Sāvitra [mantra], / combining them with the Aghamarṣaṇa mantra and the praṇava,

1.93.s:
maṇḍalābhyukṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ sāvitryā tadanantaram ..
pūrṇaṃ kṣīrākṣatopetaṃ sarṣapātaṇḍulairyutam .. 7 ..
1.93.d:
मण्डलाभ्युक्षणं कार्यं सावित्र्या तदनन्तरम् ॥
पूर्णं क्षीराक्षतोपेतं सर्षपातण्डुलैर्युतम् ॥ 7 ॥
1.93.m: the sprinkling of the sacred diagram should immediately thereafter be performed with the Sāvitrī. / Filled, accompanied by milk and unbroken grains, and provided with mustard seeds and raw rice grains,

1.93.s:
śaṅkhe rajate tāmre vā kuryādarghyaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ..
rathe akṣeti mantreṇa draviṇena tathaiva ca .. 8 ..
1.93.d:
शङ्खे रजते ताम्रे वा कुर्यादर्घ्यं विचक्षणः ॥
रथे अक्षेति मन्त्रेण द्रविणेन तथैव च ॥ 8 ॥
1.93.m: the wise man should prepare the respectful offering in a conch shell, in silver, or in copper, / with the mantra "Rathe akṣa…" and likewise with "Draviṇam…".

1.93.s:
pādyasya kalpanā kāryā drupadāyāstathaiva ca ..
hiraṇyavarṇetyārabhya ṛktrayeṇa tathaiva ca .. 9 ..
1.93.d:
पाद्यस्य कल्पना कार्या द्रुपदायास्तथैव च ॥
हिरण्यवर्णेत्यारभ्य ऋक्त्रयेण तथैव च ॥ 9 ॥
1.93.m: The preparation of water for washing the feet should be made, and likewise with the Drupadā, / and with the triad of verses beginning with "Hiraṇyavarṇāḥ…",

1.93.s:
āpo hiṣṭheti tisṛbhiḥ śannodevīti pārthiva ..
jīvadānaṃ tato deyaṃ maṇḍale nṛpapuṅgava .. 1.93.10 ..
1.93.d:
आपो हिष्ठेति तिसृभिः शन्नोदेवीति पार्थिव ॥
जीवदानं ततो देयं मण्डले नृपपुङ्गव ॥ 1.93.10 ॥
1.93.m: and with the three verses "Āpo hi ṣṭhā…", and with "Śaṃ no devīḥ…", O ruler of the earth. / Then the bestowal of life should be offered in the sacred diagram, O bull among kings.

1.93.s:
arghyodakaṃ pavitreṇa tatra mantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
agnerāyurasītyevamanuvākaṃ narādhipa .. 11 ..
1.93.d:
अर्घ्योदकं पवित्रेण तत्र मन्त्रः प्रकीर्तितः ॥
अग्नेरायुरसीत्येवमनुवाकं नराधिप ॥ 11 ॥
1.93.m: The respectful offering water is with a purifying strainer; the mantra pronounced therein, / O king of men, is the section beginning with "Agner āyur asi…".

1.93.s:
jīvasyāvāhanaṃ kāryaṃ taṃ ca vakṣyāmyataḥ param ..
om-āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ jīvaṃ sarvagataṃ vibhum .. 12 ..
1.93.d:
जीवस्यावाहनं कार्यं तं च वक्ष्याम्यतः परम् ॥
ओम्-आवाहयाम्यहं देवं जीवं सर्वगतं विभुम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.93.m: The invocation of the life-principle must be performed, and I shall describe it hereafter: / "Oṃ, I invoke the god, the life-principle, all-pervading, the lord,

1.93.s:
pañcadhāvasthitaṃ dehaṃ pañcadhāvasthitaṃ punaḥ ..
pañcādhāvasthitaṃ bhūyaḥ pañcadhāvasthitaṃ tataḥ .. 13 ..
1.93.d:
पञ्चधावस्थितं देहं पञ्चधावस्थितं पुनः ॥
पञ्चाधावस्थितं भूयः पञ्चधावस्थितं ततः ॥ 13 ॥
1.93.m: abiding in fivefold manner in the body, again abiding in fivefold manner, / once more abiding in fivefold manner, and then abiding in fivefold manner:

1.93.s:
vāyavyena tu bhāvena pañcadhāvasthitassadā ..
āgneyena tu bhāvena pañcadhāvasthitastathā .. 14 ..
1.93.d:
वायव्येन तु भावेन पञ्चधावस्थितस्सदा ॥
आग्नेयेन तु भावेन पञ्चधावस्थितस्तथा ॥ 14 ॥
1.93.m: always abiding in fivefold manner through the wind-like nature, / and likewise abiding in fivefold manner through the fire-like nature,

1.93.s:
bhūtātmakena tu tathā pañcadhāvasthitaṃ prabhum ..
vāruṇena ca bhāvena pañcadhāvasthitaṃ sadā .. .. 15 ..
1.93.d:
भूतात्मकेन तु तथा पञ्चधावस्थितं प्रभुम् ॥
वारुणेन च भावेन पञ्चधावस्थितं सदा ॥ ॥ 15 ॥
1.93.m: the lord abiding in fivefold manner through that which consists of the gross elements, / and always abiding in fivefold manner through the water-like nature.

1.93.s:
maṇḍale'sminnadṛśyastvaṃ praviśādya namostu te ..
jīvasyāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā yathāvatpārthivottama .. 16 ..
1.93.d:
मण्डलेऽस्मिन्नदृश्यस्त्वं प्रविशाद्य नमोस्तु ते ॥
जीवस्यावाहनं कृत्वा यथावत्पार्थिवोत्तम ॥ 16 ॥
1.93.m: You who are invisible, enter into this sacred diagram today; homage to you!" / Having properly performed the invocation of the life-principle, O best of rulers of the earth,

1.93.s:
vakṣyāmyāvāhanādhyāyānpūjyasyāvāhanaṃ bhavet ..
tadviṣṇoḥ paramityevamarghyaṃ deyaṃ narādhipa .. 17 ..
1.93.d:
वक्ष्याम्यावाहनाध्यायान्पूज्यस्यावाहनं भवेत् ॥
तद्विष्णोः परमित्येवमर्घ्यं देयं नराधिप ॥ 17 ॥
1.93.m: I shall describe the chapters of invocation [by which] the invocation of the worshipful one occurs. / The respectful offering should be given with "Tad viṣṇoḥ paramam…", O king of men.

1.93.s:
dhuvā dyauriti mantreṇa hyāsanaṃ vinivedayet ..
āpohiṣṭheti tisṛbhiḥ pādyaṃ ca vinivedayet .. 18 ..
1.93.d:
धुवा द्यौरिति मन्त्रेण ह्यासनं विनिवेदयेत् ॥
आपोहिष्ठेति तिसृभिः पाद्यं च विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 18 ॥
1.93.m: One should offer the seat with the mantra "Dhruvā dyauḥ…", / and one should offer water for washing the feet with the three verses "Āpo hi ṣṭhā…".

1.93.s:
arghyodakādācamanaṃ gāyatryā vinivedayet ..
dadhi kṣaudraṃ ghṛtaṃ caiva madhuparkaṃ nivedayet .. 19 ..
1.93.d:
अर्घ्योदकादाचमनं गायत्र्या विनिवेदयेत् ॥
दधि क्षौद्रं घृतं चैव मधुपर्कं निवेदयेत् ॥ 19 ॥
1.93.m: From the respectful offering water, one should present water for sipping with the Gāyatrī. / Curd, honey, and ghee—one should offer the honey-mixture.

1.93.s:
tatra maṃtratrayaṃ jñeyaṃ dadhi krāvṇeti pārthiva ..
tejosi śukramityeva madhuvātā ṛtāyate .. 1.93.20 ..
1.93.d:
तत्र मंत्रत्रयं ज्ञेयं दधि क्राव्णेति पार्थिव ॥
तेजोसि शुक्रमित्येव मधुवाता ऋतायते ॥ 1.93.20 ॥
1.93.m: The triad of mantras therein should be known, O ruler of the earth: "Dadhikrāvṇaḥ…", / "Tejo 'si śukram…", and "Madhu vātā ṛtāyate…".

1.93.s:
madhuparkikamaśvatthaṃ tato mātrāṃ nivedayet ..
sahiraṇyaṃ bījapātraṃ draviṇena sadaiva tu .. 21 ..
1.93.d:
मधुपर्किकमश्वत्थं ततो मात्रां निवेदयेत् ॥
सहिरण्यं बीजपात्रं द्रविणेन सदैव तु ॥ 21 ॥
1.93.m: Then one should offer a measuring vessel of aśvattha wood for the honey-mixture, / and a seed vessel containing gold, always with "Draviṇena…".

1.93.s:
paśuḥ kalau na kartavya ityāha bhagavānbhṛguḥ ..
rathe akṣeti mantreṇa dātavyamanulepanam .. 22 ..
1.93.d:
पशुः कलौ न कर्तव्य इत्याह भगवान्भृगुः ॥
रथे अक्षेति मन्त्रेण दातव्यमनुलेपनम् ॥ 22 ॥
1.93.m: An animal [sacrifice] is not to be performed in the Kali age, so said the venerable Bhṛgu. / The anointing paste should be given with the mantra "Rathe akṣa…",

1.93.s:
vibhūṣaṇaṃ ca tenaiva tataḥ parataraṃ nṛpa ..
yajñopavītaṃ tu navaṃ tathā pratisaraṃ śubham .. 23 ..
1.93.d:
विभूषणं च तेनैव ततः परतरं नृप ॥
यज्ञोपवीतं तु नवं तथा प्रतिसरं शुभम् ॥ 23 ॥
1.93.m: and the ornament with the very same, and after that, O king: / a fresh sacred thread, and likewise an auspicious protective thread;

1.93.s:
vastraṃ patākāṃ ca tathā sāvitreṇa nivedayet ..
puṣpaṃ puṣpavatītyeva dhūpaṃ dhūrasi cāpyatha .. 24 ..
1.93.d:
वस्त्रं पताकां च तथा सावित्रेण निवेदयेत् ॥
पुष्पं पुष्पवतीत्येव धूपं धूरसि चाप्यथ ॥ 24 ॥
1.93.m: one should present the cloth and the banner with the Sāvitra [mantra]; / the flower with "Puṣpavatīḥ…", and the incense with "Dhūr asi…".

1.93.s:
dhūpamantramidaṃ cānyaṃ nibodha gadato mama ..
vanaspatiraso divyo gandhāḍhyo gandha uttamaḥ .. 25 ..
1.93.d:
धूपमन्त्रमिदं चान्यं निबोध गदतो मम ॥
वनस्पतिरसो दिव्यो गन्धाढ्यो गन्ध उत्तमः ॥ 25 ॥
1.93.m: Learn also this other incense-mantra as I speak: / "Divine sap of the lords of the forest, rich in fragrance, the supreme perfume,

1.93.s:
āhvānaṃ sarvadevānāṃ dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām ..
tejosi śukramityeva dīpaṃ dadyānmahīpate .. 26 ..
1.93.d:
आह्वानं सर्वदेवानां धूपोऽयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥
तेजोसि शुक्रमित्येव दीपं दद्यान्महीपते ॥ 26 ॥
1.93.m: an invitation to all the gods: may this incense be accepted!" / With "Tejo 'si śukram…", one should give the lamp, O ruler of the earth.

1.93.s:
hiraṇyagarbhetyaṣṭarcaṃ deyaṃ sarvaṃ nivedayet ..
nibodha gadato mantramannapānanivedane .. 27 ..
1.93.d:
हिरण्यगर्भेत्यष्टर्चं देयं सर्वं निवेदयेत् ॥
निबोध गदतो मन्त्रमन्नपाननिवेदने ॥ 27 ॥
1.93.m: Everything should be presented and offered with the eight verses "Hiraṇyagarbhaḥ…". / Learn the mantra as I speak it for the presentation of food and drink:

1.93.s:
tuṣṭipuṣṭikaraṃ hṛdyamāhāraṃ sarvadehinām ..
gṛhāṇa varadācintya pānaṃ bhaktyā mayoditam .. 28 ..
1.93.d:
तुष्टिपुष्टिकरं हृद्यमाहारं सर्वदेहिनाम् ॥
गृहाण वरदाचिन्त्य पानं भक्त्या मयोदितम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.93.m: ["You who cause contentment and nourishment, the delightful food of all embodied beings, / accept with devotion, O giver of boons, O inconceivable one, the drink proclaimed by me!

1.93.s:
pānenānena paramā tṛptirastu tavānagha ..
tṛptastarpaya kāmaistu yajamānaṃ namo'stu te .. 29 ..
1.93.d:
पानेनानेन परमा तृप्तिरस्तु तवानघ ॥
तृप्तस्तर्पय कामैस्तु यजमानं नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 29 ॥
1.93.m: May there be supreme satisfaction for you through this drink, O sinless one! / Being satisfied, satisfy the sacrificer with desired objects; homage be to you!"

1.93.s:
anuktamaṃtraṃ śrutvā'tha grahebhyo yaḥ prayacchati ..
sāvitraṃ tasya nirdiṣṭaṃ mantraṃ pārthivasattama .. 1.93.30 ..
1.93.d:
अनुक्तमंत्रं श्रुत्वाऽथ ग्रहेभ्यो यः प्रयच्छति ॥
सावित्रं तस्य निर्दिष्टं मन्त्रं पार्थिवसत्तम ॥ 1.93.30 ॥
1.93.m: When one gives [oblations] to the planets having heard of an unstated mantra, / the Sāvitra mantra is prescribed for it, O best of rulers of the earth.

1.93.s:
tato'gnihavanaṃ kṛtvā dattvā rājendra dakṣiṇām ..
sāvitreṇa tu mantreṇa tataḥ kāryaṃ visarjanam .. 31 ..
1.93.d:
ततोऽग्निहवनं कृत्वा दत्त्वा राजेन्द्र दक्षिणाम् ॥
सावित्रेण तु मन्त्रेण ततः कार्यं विसर्जनम् ॥ 31 ॥
1.93.m: Then, having performed the fire-oblation and given the sacrificial fee, O king of kings, / the dismissal should then be performed with the Sāvitra mantra:

1.93.s:
imāṃ pūjāṃ samādāya mayā bhaktyā niveditām ..
punarāgamanāyeha vrajadhvaṃ nākamuttamam .. 35 ..
1.93.d:
इमां पूजां समादाय मया भक्त्या निवेदिताम् ॥
पुनरागमनायेह व्रजध्वं नाकमुत्तमम् ॥ 35 ॥
1.93.m: "Taking this worship presented by me with devotion, / go to the supreme heaven, in order to come here again!

1.93.s:
ādhayo vyādhayaścaiva praśamaṃ yāntu sarvaśaḥ ..
rakṣā cā'stu śivaṃ cāstu yajamānasya sarvataḥ .. 33 ..
1.93.d:
आधयो व्याधयश्चैव प्रशमं यान्तु सर्वशः ॥
रक्षा चाऽस्तु शिवं चास्तु यजमानस्य सर्वतः ॥ 33 ॥
1.93.m: May mental afflictions and physical illnesses go completely to rest; / and may there be protection and auspiciousness on all sides for the sacrificer!

1.93.s:
gavāṃ śivaṃ cāstu tathā dvijānāṃ rājñāṃ śivaṃ cāstu tathā prajānām ..
ātaṅkahīnaṃ jagadastu sarvaṃ doṣāḥ praṇāśaṃ sakalāḥ prayāntu .. 34 ..
1.93.d:
गवां शिवं चास्तु तथा द्विजानां राज्ञां शिवं चास्तु तथा प्रजानाम् ॥
आतङ्कहीनं जगदस्तु सर्वं दोषाः प्रणाशं सकलाः प्रयान्तु ॥ 34 ॥
1.93.m: May there be auspiciousness for cows and likewise for the twice-born, and may there be auspiciousness for kings and likewise for the subjects! / May the entire world be free from distress, and may all faults go to destruction!"

1.94.s:
.. vajra uvāca .. ..
ekaikasyedamuktaṃ te vidhānaṃ dvijapūjane ..
sarvagrahāṇāṃ yajane vidhānaṃ mama kīrtaya .. 1 .. - ..
1.94.d:
॥ वज्र उवाच ॥ ॥
एकैकस्येदमुक्तं ते विधानं द्विजपूजने ॥
सर्वग्रहाणां यजने विधानं मम कीर्तय ॥ 1 ॥ - ॥
1.94.m: Vajra said: / This rule has been declared by you for the worship of each individual one among the twice-born; / declare to me the rule for the sacrifice to all the planets.

1.94.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
ekaikasyedamuktaṃ te vidhānaṃ rājasattama ..
sarvagrahāṇāṃ yajane maṇḍalasya vidhiṃ śṛṇu .. 2 ..
1.94.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
एकैकस्येदमुक्तं ते विधानं राजसत्तम ॥
सर्वग्रहाणां यजने मण्डलस्य विधिं शृणु ॥ 2 ॥
1.94.m:
Mārkaṇḍeya said:
This rule for the worship of each one [of the planets] has been told to you, O best of kings. / Hear the rule of the sacred diagram for the sacrifice to all the planets.

1.94.s:
ādāveva naravyāghra yāgaṃ vakṣyāmyataḥ param ..
prāgāyataṃ tu kartavyamādau lekhādvayaṃ nṛpa .. 3 ..
1.94.d:
आदावेव नरव्याघ्र यागं वक्ष्याम्यतः परम् ॥
प्रागायतं तु कर्तव्यमादौ लेखाद्वयं नृप ॥ 3 ॥
1.94.m: First of all, O tiger among men, I shall declare the sacrifice hereafter. / At the outset, O king, two lines extending to the east are to be made.

1.94.s:
tasyopari tathā kāryamaparaṃ tūttarāyatam ..
evaṃ kṛte yadutpannaṃ madhye tu caturasrakam .. 4 ..
1.94.d:
तस्योपरि तथा कार्यमपरं तूत्तरायतम् ॥
एवं कृते यदुत्पन्नं मध्ये तु चतुरस्रकम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.94.m: Above that, another [pair] extending to the north should likewise be made. / When this is done, a square is produced in the middle.

1.94.s:
tato grahebhyaḥ kartavyaṃ tathā lekhācatuṣṭayam ..
tacchaktibhyaḥ prakartavyaṃ tathā rekhyā catuṣṭayam ..)
evaṃ kṛte sambhavati bhagaṇaṃ dvādaśakṣayam ..5..
1.94.d:
ततो ग्रहेभ्यः कर्तव्यं तथा लेखाचतुष्टयम् ॥
तच्छक्तिभ्यः प्रकर्तव्यं तथा रेख्या चतुष्टयम् ॥)
एवं कृते सम्भवति भगणं द्वादशक्षयम् ॥5॥
1.94.m: Then four lines are to be drawn for the planets, / and likewise four lines should be drawn for their powers. / When this is done, the zodiac of twelve compartments comes into being.

1.94.s: trayodaśaṃ tathā tasya dhruvasthānaṃ tu madhyamam .. 6 ..
1.94.d: त्रयोदशं तथा तस्य ध्रुवस्थानं तु मध्यमम् ॥ 6 ॥
1.94.m: And the thirteenth is its central place of the Pole Star.

1.94.s:
prācyāṃ diśi mahīnātha meṣaṃ tu parikalpayet ..
tadādyā gaṇanā kāryā pariśeṣeṣu rāśiṣu ..7..
1.94.d:
प्राच्यां दिशि महीनाथ मेषं तु परिकल्पयेत् ॥
तदाद्या गणना कार्या परिशेषेषु राशिषु ॥7॥
1.94.m: In the eastern direction, O lord of the earth, one should arrange Aries; / counting is to be done beginning with that through the remaining signs.

1.94.s:
rekhāvidhānaṃ dviguṇaṃ śobhārthaṃ parikalpayet ..
rāśisthānāni sarvāṇi rāśivarṇena rañjayet..8..
1.94.d:
रेखाविधानं द्विगुणं शोभार्थं परिकल्पयेत् ॥
राशिस्थानानि सर्वाणि राशिवर्णेन रञ्जयेत्॥8॥
1.94.m: One should fashion a double arrangement of lines for the sake of beauty; / one should colour all the places of the signs with the colour of [each] sign.

1.94.s:
rāśi varṇānyatho vakṣye yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ ..
aruṇaśca sitaścaiva haritaḥ pāṭalastathā ..9..
1.94.d:
राशि वर्णान्यथो वक्ष्ये यथावदनुपूर्वशः ॥
अरुणश्च सितश्चैव हरितः पाटलस्तथा ॥9॥
1.94.m: Next I shall declare the colours of the signs duly in proper order: / reddish-brown, white, green, and pale red;

1.94.s:
āpāṇḍuśca vicitraśca kṛṣṇaśca kapilastathā ..
piṃgalaḥ karburo babhrurmalinaśca yathākramam ..1.94.10..
1.94.d:
आपाण्डुश्च विचित्रश्च कृष्णश्च कपिलस्तथा ॥
पिंगलः कर्बुरो बभ्रुर्मलिनश्च यथाक्रमम् ॥1.94.10॥
1.94.m: whitish, variegated, black, and tawny; / reddish-brown, speckled, brown, and dark, in successive order;

1.94.s:
meṣādīnāṃ vinirdiṣṭā varṇāḥ pārthivasattama..
ākāśavarṇaṃ karttavyaṃ dhruvasthānaṃ tathaiva ca ..11..
1.94.d:
मेषादीनां विनिर्दिष्टा वर्णाः पार्थिवसत्तम॥
आकाशवर्णं कर्त्तव्यं ध्रुवस्थानं तथैव च ॥11॥
1.94.m: these are declared as the colours of Aries and the rest, O best of kings. / And the place of the Pole Star is likewise to be made sky-coloured.

1.94.s:
dhruvasthāne mahīnātha devatāsaptakaṃ nyaset ..
maṇḍalaiśśuklavarṇaistu digvibhāgaṃ nibodha me..12..
1.94.d:
ध्रुवस्थाने महीनाथ देवतासप्तकं न्यसेत् ॥
मण्डलैश्शुक्लवर्णैस्तु दिग्विभागं निबोध मे॥12॥
1.94.m: In the place of the Pole Star, O lord of the earth, one should deposit the seven deities. / Learn from me the division of the directions by means of white-coloured circles.

1.94.s:
dhruvasya maṇḍalaṃ madhye prāgbhāge maṇḍalatrayam ..
maṇḍalaṃ gaganasyātra bhāge prāguttare bhavet ..13..
1.94.d:
ध्रुवस्य मण्डलं मध्ये प्राग्भागे मण्डलत्रयम् ॥
मण्डलं गगनस्यात्र भागे प्रागुत्तरे भवेत् ॥13॥
1.94.m: The circle of the Pole Star is in the centre; in the eastern part are three circles. / Here, the circle of the sky should be in the north-eastern part.

1.94.s:
prāgbhāge ca tathā rājanmaṇḍalaṃ brahmaṇaḥ smṛtam ..
prāgdakṣiṇe tathā bhāge diśaṃ pūrvāṃ prakalpayet ..14..
1.94.d:
प्राग्भागे च तथा राजन्मण्डलं ब्रह्मणः स्मृतम् ॥
प्राग्दक्षिणे तथा भागे दिशं पूर्वां प्रकल्पयेत् ॥14॥
1.94.m: And in the eastern part, O king, the circle of Brahmā is taught; / and in the south-eastern part one should arrange the eastern direction.

1.94.s:
bhāge vai nerṛte kāryaṃ bhuvo bhūpāla maṇḍalam ..
śeṣasya ca tathā kāryaṃ pratīcyāṃ diśi maṇḍalam .. 15 ..
1.94.d:
भागे वै नेरृते कार्यं भुवो भूपाल मण्डलम् ॥
शेषस्य च तथा कार्यं प्रतीच्यां दिशि मण्डलम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.94.m: In the south-western part, O king, the circle of the earth is to be made; / and in the western direction the circle of Śeṣa is to be made.

1.94.s:
digadhastāttathā tasya maṇḍalaṃ paścimottare ..
grahaścāravaśādrājanyasminrāśau vyavasthitaḥ .. 16 ..
1.94.d:
दिगधस्तात्तथा तस्य मण्डलं पश्चिमोत्तरे ॥
ग्रहश्चारवशाद्राजन्यस्मिन्राशौ व्यवस्थितः ॥ 16 ॥
1.94.m: Likewise, in the north-west is the circle of the downward direction. / According to the motion of the planets, O king, in whichever sign a planet is positioned,

1.94.s:
maṇḍalaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ tasminneva yathāvidhi ..
nyāsaṃ kāryaṃ grahendrāṇāṃ devatābhiḥ sahānagha ..17 ..
1.94.d:
मण्डलं तस्य कर्तव्यं तस्मिन्नेव यथाविधि ॥
न्यासं कार्यं ग्रहेन्द्राणां देवताभिः सहानघ ॥17 ॥
1.94.m: its circle is to be made in that very [sign] according to rule. / The ritual placement of the lords of the planets is to be performed together with the deities, O sinless one.

1.94.s:
ādityātsaptame rāśau ketoḥ kāryaṃ tu maṇḍalam ..
rāśau suvarṇe tadvarṇaṃ yasya syānmaṇḍalaṃ nṛpa ..18..
1.94.d:
आदित्यात्सप्तमे राशौ केतोः कार्यं तु मण्डलम् ॥
राशौ सुवर्णे तद्वर्णं यस्य स्यान्मण्डलं नृप ॥18॥
1.94.m: In the seventh sign from the Sun, the circle of Ketu is to be made. / In the sign of gold, its colour is whatever [is the colour of the planet] whose circle it is, O king.

1.94.s:
utpādyaḥ paridhistasya raṃgenānyena pārthiva ..
gandhacūrṇayutā raṅgāḥ karttavyā bhūtimicchatā ..19..
1.94.d:
उत्पाद्यः परिधिस्तस्य रंगेनान्येन पार्थिव ॥
गन्धचूर्णयुता रङ्गाः कर्त्तव्या भूतिमिच्छता ॥19॥
1.94.m: Its boundary circle is to be produced with another colour, O ruler of the earth. / Colours mixed with fragrant powders should be prepared by one desiring prosperity.

1.94.s:
rāśicakraṃ samagrantu rekhayā parivārayet ..
nakṣatrāṇāṃ tataḥ kāryo nyāsaḥ pārthivasattama..1.94.20..
1.94.d:
राशिचक्रं समग्रन्तु रेखया परिवारयेत् ॥
नक्षत्राणां ततः कार्यो न्यासः पार्थिवसत्तम॥1.94.20॥
1.94.m: One should surround the entire zodiac with a line. / Then the ritual placement of the lunar mansions is to be made, O best of kings,

1.94.s:
rāśau rāśau yathāsthānaṃ rekhayā parivāritam ..
rāśau rāśāvato vakṣye nakṣatrāṇāṃ samāśrayam ..21..
1.94.d:
राशौ राशौ यथास्थानं रेखया परिवारितम् ॥
राशौ राशावतो वक्ष्ये नक्षत्राणां समाश्रयम् ॥21॥
1.94.m: in each sign in its proper place, surrounded by a line. / Henceforth I shall declare the location of the lunar mansions in each sign.

1.94.s:
aśvinī bharaṇī caiva kṛttikāṃśaṃ caturthakam ..
meṣarāśau vinirdiṣṭaṃ nityaṃ pārthivasattama .. 22 ..
1.94.d:
अश्विनी भरणी चैव कृत्तिकांशं चतुर्थकम् ॥
मेषराशौ विनिर्दिष्टं नित्यं पार्थिवसत्तम ॥ 22 ॥
1.94.m: Aśvinī, Bharaṇī, and the fourth quarter of Kṛttikā / are constantly assigned to the sign of Aries, O best of kings.

1.94.s:
pādatrayaṃ kṛttikānāṃ rohiṇī sakalā tathā ..
ilvalānāṃ tathaivārdhaṃ jñeyaṃ vṛṣasamāśrayam .. 23 .. ilvalā=mṛgaśirā
1.94.d:
पादत्रयं कृत्तिकानां रोहिणी सकला तथा ॥
इल्वलानां तथैवार्धं ज्ञेयं वृषसमाश्रयम् ॥ 23 ॥ इल्वला=मृगशिरा
1.94.m: Three quarters of Kṛttikā, all of Rohiṇī, / and half of the Ilvalās are to be known as located in Taurus.

1.94.s:
ilvalārddhaṃ tathaivārdrā hyadityāścaraṇatrayam ..
nityameva samuddiṣṭaṃ mithunasya samāśrayam .. 24 ..
1.94.d:
इल्वलार्द्धं तथैवार्द्रा ह्यदित्याश्चरणत्रयम् ॥
नित्यमेव समुद्दिष्टं मिथुनस्य समाश्रयम् ॥ 24 ॥
1.94.m: Half of the Ilvalās, Ārdrā, and three quarters of Aditi's [mansion] / are taught as constantly located in Gemini.

1.94.s:
pādaṃ punarvasoḥ puṣyaṃ sārpaṃ karkaṭakāśrayam ..
pitryaṃ bhāgyaṃ tathāryamṇaṃ prathamaṃ caraṇaṃ tathā .. 25 ..
1.94.d:
पादं पुनर्वसोः पुष्यं सार्पं कर्कटकाश्रयम् ॥
पित्र्यं भाग्यं तथार्यम्णं प्रथमं चरणं तथा ॥ 25 ॥
1.94.m: One quarter of Punarvasu, Puṣya, and the serpent [mansion] are located in Cancer. / The ancestral [mansion], Bhāgya, and the first quarter of the mansion of Aryaman

1.94.s:
siṃharāśau vinirdiṣṭaṃ nityaṃ pārthivasattama ..
pādatrayamathāryamṇaṃ hastaścitrārdhameva ca .. 26 ..
1.94.d:
सिंहराशौ विनिर्दिष्टं नित्यं पार्थिवसत्तम ॥
पादत्रयमथार्यम्णं हस्तश्चित्रार्धमेव च ॥ 26 ॥
1.94.m: are constantly assigned to the sign of Leo, O best of kings. / Then three quarters of the mansion of Aryaman, Hasta, and half of Citrā

1.94.s:
kanyārāśau vinirdiṣṭaṃ nityaṃ pārthivasattama ..
citrārdhamatha vāyavyaṃ viśākhācaraṇatrayam .. 27 ..
1.94.d:
कन्याराशौ विनिर्दिष्टं नित्यं पार्थिवसत्तम ॥
चित्रार्धमथ वायव्यं विशाखाचरणत्रयम् ॥ 27 ॥
1.94.m: are constantly assigned to the sign of Virgo, O best of kings. / Half of Citrā, the mansion of Vāyu, and three quarters of Viśākhā

1.94.s:
tulārāśau vinirdiṣṭaṃ munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ ..
viśākhācaraṇaṃ maitraṃ śākraṃ vṛścikabhe smṛtam .. 28 ..
1.94.d:
तुलाराशौ विनिर्दिष्टं मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः ॥
विशाखाचरणं मैत्रं शाक्रं वृश्चिकभे स्मृतम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.94.m: are assigned to the sign of Libra by the sages who see reality. / One quarter of Viśākhā, the mansion of Mitra, and the mansion of Śakra are taught in the sign of Scorpio.

1.94.s:
mūlamāpyaṃ tathā pādaṃ vaiśvadevasya dhanvini ..
pādatrayaṃ vaiśvadevādrājanvaiṣṇavameva ca .. 29 ..
1.94.d:
मूलमाप्यं तथा पादं वैश्वदेवस्य धन्विनि ॥
पादत्रयं वैश्वदेवाद्राजन्वैष्णवमेव च ॥ 29 ॥
1.94.m: Mūla, the watery [mansion], and one quarter of the Vaiśvadeva [mansion] are in Sagittarius. / Three quarters of the Vaiśvadeva [mansion], O king, and the Vaiṣṇava [mansion],

1.94.s:
dhaniṣṭhārdhaṃ ca makare nityameva prakīrtitam ..
dhaniṣṭhārdhaṃ śatabhiṣagajapāccaraṇatrayam .. 1.94.30 ..
1.94.d:
धनिष्ठार्धं च मकरे नित्यमेव प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
धनिष्ठार्धं शतभिषगजपाच्चरणत्रयम् ॥ 1.94.30 ॥
1.94.m: and half of Dhaniṣṭhā are constantly proclaimed in Capricorn. / Half of Dhaniṣṭhā, Śatabhiṣaj, and three quarters of the Ajaikapād [mansion]

1.94.s:
kumbharāśau vinirdiṣṭaṃ satataṃ pārthivottama ..
pādamājasya sakalaṃ cāhirbudhnyaṃ narādhipa .. 31 ..
1.94.d:
कुम्भराशौ विनिर्दिष्टं सततं पार्थिवोत्तम ॥
पादमाजस्य सकलं चाहिर्बुध्न्यं नराधिप ॥ 31 ॥
1.94.m: are continually assigned to the sign of Aquarius, O best of kings. / One quarter of the Ajaikapād [mansion], the whole of Ahirbudhnya, O lord of men,

1.94.s:
pauṣṇantu kathitaṃ mīne munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ ..
bhacakrapūjane rājannakṣatrasya pṛthakpṛthak .. 32 ..
1.94.d:
पौष्णन्तु कथितं मीने मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः ॥
भचक्रपूजने राजन्नक्षत्रस्य पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 32 ॥
1.94.m: and the Pauṣṇa [mansion] are declared in Pisces by the sages who see reality. / In the worship of the circle of constellations, O king, for each separate lunar mansion,

1.94.s:
rāśicakrasya bāhye tu hyekaikatārakaṃ nyaset ..
prāguktavarṇairbhūpāla nyāsaḥ kāryo yathāvidhi .. 33 ..
1.94.d:
राशिचक्रस्य बाह्ये तु ह्येकैकतारकं न्यसेत् ॥
प्रागुक्तवर्णैर्भूपाल न्यासः कार्यो यथाविधि ॥ 33 ॥
1.94.m: outside the circle of the signs one should place each single star. / The ritual placement should be performed according to rule with the previously stated colours, O king.

1.94.s:
tārācakrasya vinyāsaṃ rekhayā parivārya tam ..
nakṣatradaivatanyāsaṃ bahiḥ kāryaṃ samantataḥ .. 34 ..
1.94.d:
ताराचक्रस्य विन्यासं रेखया परिवार्य तम् ॥
नक्षत्रदैवतन्यासं बहिः कार्यं समन्ततः ॥ 34 ॥
1.94.m: Having surrounded that arrangement of the circle of stars with a line, / the ritual placement of the deities of the lunar mansions should be performed all around on the outside,

1.94.s:
yathā nakṣatrasvāmī syādṛkṣavarṇaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak ..
tasyāpi rekhā karttavyā vṛttā cāpyanu maṇḍalam .. 35 ..
1.94.d:
यथा नक्षत्रस्वामी स्यादृक्षवर्णैः पृथक्पृथक् ॥
तस्यापि रेखा कर्त्तव्या वृत्ता चाप्यनु मण्डलम् ॥ 35 ॥
1.94.m: according to the presiding deity of the lunar mansion, individually with the colours of the mansions. / A circular line should also be made for it around the sacred diagram.

1.94.s:
rekhābāhyena vinyāsaṃ digīśānāṃ tu kārayet ..
diśaśca pārthivaśreṣṭha yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ .. 36 ..
1.94.d:
रेखाबाह्येन विन्यासं दिगीशानां तु कारयेत् ॥
दिशश्च पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ यथावदनुपूर्वशः ॥ 36 ॥
1.94.m: Outside the line one should cause the arrangement of the lords of the directions / and of the directions themselves to be made, O best of kings, duly in proper order.

1.94.s:
svāśrayarkṣasamaṃ varṇaṃ digīśānāṃ tu kārayet ..
uttarāyāṃ ca karttavyaṃ dhanadasya ca maṇḍalam ..37..
1.94.d:
स्वाश्रयर्क्षसमं वर्णं दिगीशानां तु कारयेत् ॥
उत्तरायां च कर्त्तव्यं धनदस्य च मण्डलम् ॥37॥
1.94.m: One should make the colour of the lords of the directions equal to their corresponding asterism. / And in the north, the circle of the giver of wealth should be made

1.94.s:
rukmavarṇaṃ prayatnena diśo varṇamataḥ śuṇu ..
uttarā tu bhavecchuklā raktā prācī prakīrtitā .. 38 ..
1.94.d:
रुक्मवर्णं प्रयत्नेन दिशो वर्णमतः शुणु ॥
उत्तरा तु भवेच्छुक्ला रक्ता प्राची प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 38 ॥
1.94.m: gold-coloured with care. Now hear the colour of the directions: / the north should be white, and the east is proclaimed red;

1.94.s:
dakṣiṇā pītavarṇā syātkṛṣṇā jñeyā ca paścimā ..
padmavarṇā tathā jñeyā tāmrā syātpūrvadakṣiṇā .. 39 ..
1.94.d:
दक्षिणा पीतवर्णा स्यात्कृष्णा ज्ञेया च पश्चिमा ॥
पद्मवर्णा तथा ज्ञेया ताम्रा स्यात्पूर्वदक्षिणा ॥ 39 ॥
1.94.m: the south should be yellow in colour, and the west is to be known as black; / the south-east is to be known as copper-coloured and lotus-coloured;

1.94.s:
pālāśā ca vinirdiṣṭā tathā dakṣiṇapaścimā ..
nīlotpalasavarṇā tu vāyavyā parikīrtitā..1.94.40..
1.94.d:
पालाशा च विनिर्दिष्टा तथा दक्षिणपश्चिमा ॥
नीलोत्पलसवर्णा तु वायव्या परिकीर्तिता॥1.94.40॥
1.94.m: and the south-west is declared to be [green like] the palāśa leaf; / the north-west is proclaimed to have the colour of a blue water-lily;

1.94.s:
śuklavarṇā tathā jñeyā caiśānītattvadarśibhiḥ..
diṅmaṇḍalaṃ tu tadvidvām̐llekhayā parivārayet .. 41 ..
1.94.d:
शुक्लवर्णा तथा ज्ञेया चैशानीतत्त्वदर्शिभिः॥
दिङ्मण्डलं तु तद्विद्वाम्̐ल्लेखया परिवारयेत् ॥ 41 ॥
1.94.m: and the north-east is to be known as white-coloured by those who see reality. / The learned man should surround the circle of the directions with a line.

1.94.s:
vṛttayā veṣṭayedvṛttāṃ lekhayā caturasrayā ..
tanmadhye śaṅkhapadmādyairmaṅgalairupaśobhayet .. 42 ..
1.94.d:
वृत्तया वेष्टयेद्वृत्तां लेखया चतुरस्रया ॥
तन्मध्ये शङ्खपद्माद्यैर्मङ्गलैरुपशोभयेत् ॥ 42 ॥
1.94.m: He should enclose the circular [diagram] with a circular line, [or] with a square line; / in its middle he should adorn it with auspicious symbols such as the conch and lotus.

1.94.s:
lekhāvidhānaṃ dviguṇaṃ sarvatraiva prakalpayet ..
maṇḍalasya tu koṇeṣu hyudakkumbhānnavāndṛḍhān .. 43 ..
1.94.d:
लेखाविधानं द्विगुणं सर्वत्रैव प्रकल्पयेत् ॥
मण्डलस्य तु कोणेषु ह्युदक्कुम्भान्नवान्दृढान् ॥ 43 ॥
1.94.m: Everywhere one should provide a double arrangement of lines. / At the corners of the sacred diagram, new, sturdy water-jars

1.94.s:
phalapallavasaṃchannāngandhapuṣpādisaṃyutān ..
caturo vinyasedvidvānnityameva vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 44 ..
1.94.d:
फलपल्लवसंछन्नान्गन्धपुष्पादिसंयुतान् ॥
चतुरो विन्यसेद्विद्वान्नित्यमेव विचक्षणः ॥ 44 ॥
1.94.m: covered with fruits and sprouts, and provided with perfumes, flowers, and the like— / four [such jars] the wise, discerning man should constantly set down.

1.94.s:
lekhāsu vinyasedrājanpatākāśca dhvajām̐stathā ..
chatrāṇi ca savarṇāni grahendrāṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthak .. 45 ..
1.94.d:
लेखासु विन्यसेद्राजन्पताकाश्च ध्वजाम्̐स्तथा ॥
छत्राणि च सवर्णानि ग्रहेन्द्राणां पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 45 ॥
1.94.m: O king, one should place streamers and flags upon the lines, / as well as parasols of matching colours, separately for each of the chief planets.

1.94.s:
sthānantu vijñāya yathāvadatra kāryaṃ yathā maṇḍalakapramāṇam ..
yathā mahattā nṛpa maṇḍalasya tathātathā vṛddhimupaiti kartā .. 46 ..
1.94.d:
स्थानन्तु विज्ञाय यथावदत्र कार्यं यथा मण्डलकप्रमाणम् ॥
यथा महत्ता नृप मण्डलस्य तथातथा वृद्धिमुपैति कर्ता ॥ 46 ॥
1.94.m: Having duly recognised the proper position here, one should proceed according to the measure of the sacred diagram. / To whatever extent the sacred diagram is large, O king, to that same extent does its maker attain prosperity.

1.95.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
āvāhanānyato vakṣye sarveṣāṃ pārthivottama ..
sarvasyāvāhanasyānte śloko'yaṃ parikīrtyate .. 1 ..
1.95.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
आवाहनान्यतो वक्ष्ये सर्वेषां पार्थिवोत्तम ॥
सर्वस्यावाहनस्यान्ते श्लोकोऽयं परिकीर्त्यते ॥ 1 ॥
1.95.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / Next I shall proclaim the invocations of all [the deities], O best of kings. / At the end of every invocation, this verse is recited:

1.95.s:
maṇḍale sampraviśyāsminmayā bhaktyā niveditam ..
idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām .. 2 ..
1.95.d:
मण्डले सम्प्रविश्यास्मिन्मया भक्त्या निवेदितम् ॥
इदमर्घ्यमिदं पाद्यं धूपोऽयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥ 2 ॥
1.95.m: "Having entered into this sacred diagram, [what is] offered by me with devotion— / this water for guest-offering, this water for washing the feet, this incense—let it be accepted!"

1.95.s:
dhruvamāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvagrahagaṇeśvaram ..
niruddhaṃ bhrāmyate yena bhacakraṃ vātarajjubhiḥ .. 3 ..
1.95.d:
ध्रुवमावाहयिष्यामि सर्वग्रहगणेश्वरम् ॥
निरुद्धं भ्राम्यते येन भचक्रं वातरज्जुभिः ॥ 3 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke Dhruva, the lord of all the hosts of planets, / by whom the stellar sphere is held in check and revolved by cords of wind.

1.95.s:
ehi me dhruva deveśa keśavācintyavikrama ..
sarvagrahagaṇādhyakṣa sarvalokanamaskṛta .. 4 ..
1.95.d:
एहि मे ध्रुव देवेश केशवाचिन्त्यविक्रम ॥
सर्वग्रहगणाध्यक्ष सर्वलोकनमस्कृत ॥ 4 ॥
1.95.m: Come to me, O Dhruva, lord of gods, O Keśava of unfathomable prowess, / overseer of all the hosts of planets, saluted by all the worlds!

1.95.s:
āvāhayiṣyāmyākāśaṃ vimānaśatamaṇḍitam ..
tṛtīyaṃ devadevasya padaṃ viṣṇormahātmanaḥ .. 5 ..
1.95.d:
आवाहयिष्याम्याकाशं विमानशतमण्डितम् ॥
तृतीयं देवदेवस्य पदं विष्णोर्महात्मनः ॥ 5 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke space, adorned with hundreds of celestial chariots, / the third step of the great-souled Viṣṇu, god of gods.

1.95.s:
ehi me bhagavansaumya nirālamba nabhastala ..
aprameyātigambhīra nakṣatragrahamaṇḍita .. 6 ..
1.95.d:
एहि मे भगवन्सौम्य निरालम्ब नभस्तल ॥
अप्रमेयातिगम्भीर नक्षत्रग्रहमण्डित ॥ 6 ॥
1.95.m: Come to me, O Lord, gentle, unsupported vault of the sky, / immeasurable, profoundly deep, adorned with constellations and planets!

1.95.s:
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ jagatāṃ patim ..
jagato'sya samutpattisthitisaṃhārakārakam .. 7 ..
1.95.d:
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं ब्रह्माणं जगतां पतिम् ॥
जगतोऽस्य समुत्पत्तिस्थितिसंहारकारकम् ॥ 7 ॥
1.95.m: I invoke the god Brahmā, the lord of the worlds, / the bringer of the origination, maintenance, and dissolution of this universe.

1.95.s:
ehi sarvaprajādhyakṣa padmayone caturmukha ..
vedamūrte tadādhāra kālanirmāṇa tatpara .. 8 ..
1.95.d:
एहि सर्वप्रजाध्यक्ष पद्मयोने चतुर्मुख ॥
वेदमूर्ते तदाधार कालनिर्माण तत्पर ॥ 8 ॥
1.95.m: Come, overseer of all creatures, lotus-born, four-faced one, / embodiment of the Vedas, their foundation, devoted to the fashioning of time!

1.95.s:
ūrddhvamāvāhayiṣyāmi hyanantāṃ mahatīṃ diśam ..
aprameyāṃ nirālambāṃ candrasūryāṃśuvarjitām .. 9 ..
1.95.d:
ऊर्द्ध्वमावाहयिष्यामि ह्यनन्तां महतीं दिशम् ॥
अप्रमेयां निरालम्बां चन्द्रसूर्यांशुवर्जिताम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke the upward direction, endless and immense, / immeasurable, unsupported, devoid of the rays of the moon and the sun.

1.95.s:
āgaccheha mahābhāge satataṃ siddhasevite ..
anante vipule devi nirmale hitakāriṇi .. 1.95.10 ..
1.95.d:
आगच्छेह महाभागे सततं सिद्धसेविते ॥
अनन्ते विपुले देवि निर्मले हितकारिणि ॥ 1.95.10 ॥
1.95.m: Come here, O fortunate one, constantly frequented by the Siddhas, / endless, vast goddess, spotless and beneficent!

1.95.s:
pṛthvīmāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvasattvahite ratām ..
dharāṃ bhūmiṃ kṣamāṃ kṣoṇīṃ varadāṃ bhūtadhāriṇīm .. 11 ..
1.95.d:
पृथ्वीमावाहयिष्यामि सर्वसत्त्वहिते रताम् ॥
धरां भूमिं क्षमां क्षोणीं वरदां भूतधारिणीम् ॥ 11 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke the Earth, devoted to the welfare of all beings, / the supporter, soil, patient one, terrestrial realm, giver of boons, bearer of creatures.

1.95.s:
ehi me vasudhe devi vārāheṇa samuddhṛte ..
sarvabījadhare bhadre sarvabhūtāpahāriṇi .. 12 ..
1.95.d:
एहि मे वसुधे देवि वाराहेण समुद्धृते ॥
सर्वबीजधरे भद्रे सर्वभूतापहारिणि ॥ 12 ॥
1.95.m: Come to me, O goddess who holds wealth, raised up by the Boar, / bearer of all seeds, auspicious one, sustainer of all beings!

1.95.s:
śeṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi mahīmaṇḍala dhāraṇam ..
phaṇāvalīratnajālamarīcivikasojjvalam .. 13 ..
1.95.d:
शेषमावाहयिष्यामि महीमण्डल धारणम् ॥
फणावलीरत्नजालमरीचिविकसोज्ज्वलम् ॥ 13 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke Śeṣa, who upholds the circle of the earth, / radiant with the expansion of rays from the mass of jewels upon the row of his hoods.

1.95.s:
ehi śeṣa mahābhāga ehyanantādikeśava ..
āheyī tvaṃ tanustasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ .. 14 ..
1.95.d:
एहि शेष महाभाग एह्यनन्तादिकेशव ॥
आहेयी त्वं तनुस्तस्य विष्णोरमिततेजसः ॥ 14 ॥
1.95.m: Come, O Śeṣa, highly fortunate one; come, O Keśava beginning with Ananta! / You are the serpentine body of that Viṣṇu of immeasurable splendour.

1.95.s:
āvāhayāmyadhastāttu diśaṃ śeṣeṇa pālitām ..
nāgadaityoragagaṇaissatataṃ ca niṣevitām .. 15 ..
1.95.d:
आवाहयाम्यधस्तात्तु दिशं शेषेण पालिताम् ॥
नागदैत्योरगगणैस्सततं च निषेविताम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.95.m: I invoke the nether direction protected by Śeṣa, / and constantly frequented by the hosts of nāgas, daityas, and serpents.

1.95.s:
ehi me ratnabāhulye nityaṃ śeṣeṇa pālite ..
gambhīre vipule bhīme bahusthānābhimaṇḍite .. 16 ..
1.95.d:
एहि मे रत्नबाहुल्ये नित्यं शेषेण पालिते ॥
गम्भीरे विपुले भीमे बहुस्थानाभिमण्डिते ॥ 16 ॥
1.95.m: Come to me, [O direction] abundant with jewels, perpetually protected by Śeṣa, / profound, vast, formidable, adorned with many realms!

1.95.s:
āvāhayiṣye varadaṃ deveśaṃ jātavedasam ..
vedamūrttiṃ tadādhāraṃ devadevaṃ hutāśanam .. 17 ..
1.95.d:
आवाहयिष्ये वरदं देवेशं जातवेदसम् ॥
वेदमूर्त्तिं तदाधारं देवदेवं हुताशनम् ॥ 17 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke Jātavedas, the boon-giving lord of gods, / the embodiment of the Veda and its foundation, the god of gods, the consumer of oblations.

1.95.s:
ehyagre sarvadeveśa sarvadevamukhācyuta ..
sarvatrastha mahābhāga sarvabhūtahite rata .. 18 ..
1.95.d:
एह्यग्रे सर्वदेवेश सर्वदेवमुखाच्युत ॥
सर्वत्रस्थ महाभाग सर्वभूतहिते रत ॥ 18 ॥
1.95.m: Come forward, O lord of all gods, mouth of all deities, unswerving one, / omnipresent, highly fortunate, devoted to the welfare of all creatures!

1.95.s:
āvāhayiṣye varadaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ divākaram ..
tejomūrttiṃ durādharṣaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam .. 12 ..
1.95.d:
आवाहयिष्ये वरदं सहस्राक्षं दिवाकरम् ॥
तेजोमूर्त्तिं दुराधर्षं भक्तानामभयप्रदम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke the boon-giving, thousand-eyed Maker of the Day, / the embodiment of brilliance, unassailable, the granter of fearlessness to his devotees.

1.95.s:
ehi deva jagannātha ṛksāmayajuṣāṃ pate ..
trailokyamaṇḍaladvīpa sarvavyādhivināśana .. 1.95.20 ..
1.95.d:
एहि देव जगन्नाथ ऋक्सामयजुषां पते ॥
त्रैलोक्यमण्डलद्वीप सर्वव्याधिविनाशन ॥ 1.95.20 ॥
1.95.m: Come, O god, lord of the world, master of the Ṛg, Sāman, and Yajus [hymns], / island of the circle of the three worlds, destroyer of all diseases!

1.95.s:
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devamādityamudakeśayam ..
snigdhavaiḍūryasaṅkāśaṃ varuṇaṃ sumahādyutim .. 21 ..
1.95.d:
आवाहयाम्यहं देवमादित्यमुदकेशयम् ॥
स्निग्धवैडूर्यसङ्काशं वरुणं सुमहाद्युतिम् ॥ 21 ॥
1.95.m: I invoke the god Varuṇa, the Āditya reclining in the waters, / resembling smooth lapis lazuli, endowed with very great radiance.

1.95.s:
ehi deva jalādhyakṣa yādogaṇamaheśvara ..
nāgadaityoragagaṇaissatataṃ sevitānyuta .. 22 ..
1.95.d:
एहि देव जलाध्यक्ष यादोगणमहेश्वर ॥
नागदैत्योरगगणैस्सततं सेवितान्युत ॥ 22 ॥
1.95.m: Come, O god, overseer of waters, great lord of the aquatic creatures, / constantly attended and served by the hosts of nāgas, daityas, and serpents!

1.95.s:
āvāhayāmyahaṃ candraṃ śītāṃśumamṛtaprabham ..
oṣadhīśaṃ dvijādhyakṣaṃ nayanānandakārakam .. 23 ..
1.95.d:
आवाहयाम्यहं चन्द्रं शीतांशुममृतप्रभम् ॥
ओषधीशं द्विजाध्यक्षं नयनानन्दकारकम् ॥ 23 ॥
1.95.m: I invoke the moon of cool rays and nectarous lustre, / lord of medicinal herbs, sovereign of the twice-born, delighting the eyes.

1.95.s:
ehi me bhagavam̐ścandra ehi me mṛgalācchana ..
bhaktānukampinsatataṃ sarvanakṣatrapūjita .. 24 ..
1.95.d:
एहि मे भगवम्̐श्चन्द्र एहि मे मृगलाच्छन ॥
भक्तानुकम्पिन्सततं सर्वनक्षत्रपूजित ॥ 24 ॥
1.95.m: Come to me, O Lord Moon; come to me, hare-marked one, / ever compassionate to your devotees, worshipped by all the constellations!

1.95.s:
skandamāvāhayiṣyāmi ṣaṇmukhaṃ varadaṃ śiśum ..
devārisenāmathanaṃ pārvatyānandavarddhanam .. 25 ..
1.95.d:
स्कन्दमावाहयिष्यामि षण्मुखं वरदं शिशुम् ॥
देवारिसेनामथनं पार्वत्यानन्दवर्द्धनम् ॥ 25 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke Skanda, the six-faced, boon-giving youth, / the crusher of the army of the gods' enemies, the increaser of Pārvatī's joy.

1.95.s:
ehi devatamārādhya mahiṣāsurataskara ..
kārtikeya jagannātha mayūravaravāhana .. 26 ..
1.95.d:
एहि देवतमाराध्य महिषासुरतस्कर ॥
कार्तिकेय जगन्नाथ मयूरवरवाहन ॥ 26 ॥
1.95.m: Come, you who are worthy of worship by the gods, destroyer of the demon Mahiṣa, / Kārtikeya, lord of the universe, whose excellent mount is the peacock!

1.95.s:
bhaumamāvāhayiṣyāmi tejomūrtiṃ durāsadam ..
rudramūrtimanirdeśyavaktraṃ rudhirasaprabham .. 27 ..
1.95.d:
भौममावाहयिष्यामि तेजोमूर्तिं दुरासदम् ॥
रुद्रमूर्तिमनिर्देश्यवक्त्रं रुधिरसप्रभम् ॥ 27 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke Mars, an embodiment of brilliance, difficult to approach, / a form of Rudra, whose face is indescribable, having the radiance of blood.

1.95.s:
ehi me bhagavanbhauma aṅgāraka mahāprabha ..
tvayi sarvaṃ samāyattaṃ bhūtalesmiñchubhāśubham .. 28 ..
1.95.d:
एहि मे भगवन्भौम अङ्गारक महाप्रभ ॥
त्वयि सर्वं समायत्तं भूतलेस्मिञ्छुभाशुभम् ॥ 28 ॥
1.95.m: Come to me, O Lord Bhauma, Aṅgāraka of great splendour! / In your power rests everything good and bad upon this earth.

1.95.s:
viṣṇumāvāhayiṣyāmi śaṅkhacakragadādharam ..
atasīkusumaśyāmaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam .. 29 ..
1.95.d:
विष्णुमावाहयिष्यामि शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् ॥
अतसीकुसुमश्यामं पीतवाससमच्युतम् ॥ 29 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke Viṣṇu, bearer of the conch, discus, and mace, / dark as an atasī flower, clad in yellow garments, the infallible one.

1.95.s:
ehi me devadeveśa prajānirmāṇakāraka ..
nārāyaṇa suduṣpāra mahāśārṅgadhanurdhara .. 1.95.30 ..
1.95.d:
एहि मे देवदेवेश प्रजानिर्माणकारक ॥
नारायण सुदुष्पार महाशार्ङ्गधनुर्धर ॥ 1.95.30 ॥
1.95.m: Come to me, O god of gods, creator of creatures, / Nārāyaṇa, difficult to cross, bearer of the great Śārṅga bow!

1.95.s:
budhamāvāhayiṣyāmi bodhakaṃ jagadīśvaram ..
cāndriṃ grahagaṇādhyakṣaṃ tejomūrtiṃ durāsadam .. 31 ..
1.95.d:
बुधमावाहयिष्यामि बोधकं जगदीश्वरम् ॥
चान्द्रिं ग्रहगणाध्यक्षं तेजोमूर्तिं दुरासदम् ॥ 31 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke Mercury, the awakener, lord of the world, / son of the moon, overseer of the hosts of planets, an embodiment of brilliance, difficult to approach.

1.95.s:
ehi śītāṃśujācintya jagajjiṣṇo janārdana ..
mahābala mahāsattva mahābāho mahādyute .. 32 ..
1.95.d:
एहि शीतांशुजाचिन्त्य जगज्जिष्णो जनार्दन ॥
महाबल महासत्त्व महाबाहो महाद्युते ॥ 32 ॥
1.95.m: Come, son of the moon, unfathomable one, conqueror of the world, Janārdana, / of great strength, great essence, mighty arms, and great lustre!

1.95.s:
śakramāvāhayiṣyāmi devaṃ suragaṇeśvaram ..
vajrapāṇiṃ mahābāhuṃ gobrāhmaṇahite ratam .. 33 ..
1.95.d:
शक्रमावाहयिष्यामि देवं सुरगणेश्वरम् ॥
वज्रपाणिं महाबाहुं गोब्राह्मणहिते रतम् ॥ 33 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke Śakra, the divine lord of the hosts of deities, / holding the thunderbolt in his hand, mighty-armed, devoted to the welfare of cows and brahmins.

1.95.s:
ehi deva sahasrākṣa devāribalasūdana ..
airāvatasthadharmajña śacīhṛdayanandana .. 34 ..
1.95.d:
एहि देव सहस्राक्ष देवारिबलसूदन ॥
ऐरावतस्थधर्मज्ञ शचीहृदयनन्दन ॥ 34 ॥
1.95.m: Come, O god, thousand-eyed one, slayer of the armies of the gods' enemies, / seated upon Airāvata, knower of dharma, delight of Śacī's heart!

1.95.s:
jīvamāvāhayiṣyāmi deveśvarapurohitam ..
bṛhaspatiṃ bṛhadvācaṃ vedavedāṅgapāragam .. 35 ..
1.95.d:
जीवमावाहयिष्यामि देवेश्वरपुरोहितम् ॥
बृहस्पतिं बृहद्वाचं वेदवेदाङ्गपारगम् ॥ 35 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke Jīva, the household priest of the lord of gods, / Bṛhaspati, of mighty speech, who has mastered the Vedas and their auxiliary sciences.

1.95.s:
ehi jīva mahābhāgajīvabhūta mahītale ..
sasyavṛddhistavāyattā satataṃ bhūmivardhana .. 36 ..
1.95.d:
एहि जीव महाभागजीवभूत महीतले ॥
सस्यवृद्धिस्तवायत्ता सततं भूमिवर्धन ॥ 36 ॥
1.95.m: Come, O Jīva, highly fortunate one, the very soul of life upon the earth! / The growth of crops is in your hands, O eternal replenisher of the earth!

1.95.s:
devīmāvāhayiṣyāmi pārvatīṃ varadāmumām ..
harasya dayitāṃ bhāryāṃ cārvaṅgīṃ bhūtivardhinīm .. 37 ..
1.95.d:
देवीमावाहयिष्यामि पार्वतीं वरदामुमाम् ॥
हरस्य दयितां भार्यां चार्वङ्गीं भूतिवर्धिनीम् ॥ 37 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke the goddess, the boon-giving Umā, Pārvatī, / Hara's beloved wife, possessing lovely limbs, increaser of prosperity.

1.95.s:
ehi devi jagannāthe menāhṛdayanandini ..
pavitre varade saumye nityaṃ bhaktajanapriye .. 38 ..
1.95.d:
एहि देवि जगन्नाथे मेनाहृदयनन्दिनि ॥
पवित्रे वरदे सौम्ये नित्यं भक्तजनप्रिये ॥ 38 ॥
1.95.m: Come, O goddess, mistress of the universe, delight of Menā's heart, / pure, boon-giving, gentle, ever beloved of your devotees!

1.95.s:
śukramāvāhayiṣyāmi bhārgavaṃ jagadīśvaram ..
nityaṃ sarvajanādhyakṣaṃ tapasā dyotitaprabham ..39..
1.95.d:
शुक्रमावाहयिष्यामि भार्गवं जगदीश्वरम् ॥
नित्यं सर्वजनाध्यक्षं तपसा द्योतितप्रभम् ॥39॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke Venus, the Bhārgava, lord of the world, / the eternal overseer of all people, whose splendour is kindled by ascetic heat.

1.95.s:
ehi śukra mahābhāga ṣoḍaśārcirvaraprada ..
prabhustvaṃ varadācintya varṣāvarṣasya nigrahe .. 1.95.40 ..
1.95.d:
एहि शुक्र महाभाग षोडशार्चिर्वरप्रद ॥
प्रभुस्त्वं वरदाचिन्त्य वर्षावर्षस्य निग्रहे ॥ 1.95.40 ॥
1.95.m: Come, O Venus, highly fortunate one, of sixteen rays, giver of boons! / You are the master, boon-giving and unfathomable, in causing and withholding rain.

1.95.s:
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ prajādhyakṣamakalmaṣam ..
bhaktānukampinaṃ devaṃ prajānirmāṇakārakam .. 41 ..
1.95.d:
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं प्रजाध्यक्षमकल्मषम् ॥
भक्तानुकम्पिनं देवं प्रजानिर्माणकारकम् ॥ 41 ॥
1.95.m: I invoke the spotless god who is the overseer of creatures, / the god compassionate to his devotees, the fashioner of creatures.

1.95.s:
ehi deva prajādhyakṣa pūjānirmāṇakāraka ..
tvayi deva samāyuktaṃ prajānāmabhavodbhavam .. 42 ..
1.95.d:
एहि देव प्रजाध्यक्ष पूजानिर्माणकारक ॥
त्वयि देव समायुक्तं प्रजानामभवोद्भवम् ॥ 42 ॥
1.95.m: Come, O god, overseer of creatures, inspirer of worship! / In you, O god, is joined the origination and dissolution of creatures.

1.95.s:
ehi me bhagavanbrahmanprajāpatimahādyute ..
saurimāvāhayiṣyāmi śanaiścāriṇamacyutam .. 43 ..
1.95.d:
एहि मे भगवन्ब्रह्मन्प्रजापतिमहाद्युते ॥
सौरिमावाहयिष्यामि शनैश्चारिणमच्युतम् ॥ 43 ॥
1.95.m: Come to me, O Lord Brahmā, Prajāpati of great splendour! / I shall invoke the son of the Sun, the slow-moving, infallible one.

1.95.s:
tapasvinamanādhṛṣyaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam ..
ehi tīkṣṇāṃśujācintya bhāvābhāvapradarśaka .. 44 ..
1.95.d:
तपस्विनमनाधृष्यं भक्तानामभयप्रदम् ॥
एहि तीक्ष्णांशुजाचिन्त्य भावाभावप्रदर्शक ॥ 44 ॥
1.95.m: practising austerities, unassailable, granter of fearlessness to devotees; / come, O son of the hot-rayed [Sun], inconceivable one, revealer of existence and non-existence.

1.95.s:
tvayi sarvaṃ samāyattaṃ rājñāṃ bhūmau śubhāśubham ..
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ gajavaktraṃ gaṇeśvaram .. 45 ..
1.95.d:
त्वयि सर्वं समायत्तं राज्ञां भूमौ शुभाशुभम् ॥
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं गजवक्त्रं गणेश्वरम् ॥ 45 ॥
1.95.m: Upon you all the good and evil of kings on earth depends. / I invoke the god with an elephant's face, the lord of the gaṇas,

1.95.s:
vipreśaṃ viprahartāraṃ pārvatīhṛdayapriyam ..
ehi deva gaṇādhyakṣa lambodara mahābhuja .. 46 ..
1.95.d:
विप्रेशं विप्रहर्तारं पार्वतीहृदयप्रियम् ॥
एहि देव गणाध्यक्ष लम्बोदर महाभुज ॥ 46 ॥
1.95.m: the lord of brahmins, the dispeller of obstacles, dear to Pārvatī's heart; / come, O god, leader of the gaṇas, pot-bellied, mighty-armed one.

1.95.s:
kāryasiddhiḥ samāyattā tvayi sarveśa dehinām ..
rāhumāvāhayiṣyāmi daityeśaṃ grahatāṅgatam .. 47 ..
1.95.d:
कार्यसिद्धिः समायत्ता त्वयि सर्वेश देहिनाम् ॥
राहुमावाहयिष्यामि दैत्येशं ग्रहताङ्गतम् ॥ 47 ॥
1.95.m: The success of undertakings of embodied beings depends on you, O lord of all. / I shall invoke Rāhu, the lord of the Daityas who attained the status of a planet,

1.95.s:
keśavāptavaraṃ vīraṃ tapasā dagdhakilbiṣam ..
ehyehi daityapravara varadācintyavikrama .. 48 ..
1.95.d:
केशवाप्तवरं वीरं तपसा दग्धकिल्बिषम् ॥
एह्येहि दैत्यप्रवर वरदाचिन्त्यविक्रम ॥ 48 ॥
1.95.m: who obtained a boon from Keśava, the hero whose sins were burnt away by austerity; / come, come, foremost of the Daityas, boon-giver of inconceivable prowess,

1.95.s:
tapomūrte durādharṣa viparītacarāmbare ..
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ viśvakarmāṇamacyutam .. 49 ..
1.95.d:
तपोमूर्ते दुराधर्ष विपरीतचराम्बरे ॥
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं विश्वकर्माणमच्युतम् ॥ 49 ॥
1.95.m: embodiment of austerity, difficult to overcome, who moves in opposite direction through the sky. / I invoke the imperishable god Viśvakarman,

1.95.s:
sarvāsāṃ devatānāṃ tu sadā śilpapravartakam ..
ehi devavarācintya sarvaśilpapravartaka .. 1.95.50 ..
1.95.d:
सर्वासां देवतानां तु सदा शिल्पप्रवर्तकम् ॥
एहि देववराचिन्त्य सर्वशिल्पप्रवर्तक ॥ 1.95.50 ॥
1.95.m: who perpetually initiates the arts and crafts of all the gods; / come, O best of gods, inconceivable one, promoter of all crafts.

1.95.s:
tvayi sarvaiva sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāmāśritā gatiḥ ..
ketumāvāhayiṣyāmi ketuṃ sarvadivaukasām .. 51 ..
1.95.d:
त्वयि सर्वैव सर्वेषां कर्मणामाश्रिता गतिः ॥
केतुमावाहयिष्यामि केतुं सर्वदिवौकसाम् ॥ 51 ॥
1.95.m: In you alone is rooted the course of all actions of all beings. / I shall invoke Ketu, the banner of all the heaven-dwellers,

1.95.s:
brahmaṇyaṃ sarvadharmajñaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam ..
dhūmaketo ihābhyehi hutāśanasamaprabha .. 52 ..
1.95.d:
ब्रह्मण्यं सर्वधर्मज्ञं भक्तानामभयप्रदम् ॥
धूमकेतो इहाभ्येहि हुताशनसमप्रभ ॥ 52 ॥
1.95.m: beneficent to brahmins, knower of all dharma, granter of fearlessness to devotees; / O Dhūmaketu, come hither, you who equal the fire in brilliance,

1.95.s:
śikhākarālavikaca pūjitāghavināśana ..
vahnerāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ pūrvameva mayānagha .. 53 ..
1.95.d:
शिखाकरालविकच पूजिताघविनाशन ॥
वह्नेरावाहनं प्रोक्तं पूर्वमेव मयानघ ॥ 53 ॥
1.95.m: whose crest is dread and radiant, who, when worshipped, destroys sins. / The invocation of Fire has already been spoken by me, O sinless one.

1.95.s:
āvāhayiṣyāmi śubhāṃ kṛttikāṃ devapūjitām ..
ehi sādhāraṇe devi jyeṣṭhadakṣasute śubhe .. 54 ..
1.95.d:
आवाहयिष्यामि शुभां कृत्तिकां देवपूजिताम् ॥
एहि साधारणे देवि ज्येष्ठदक्षसुते शुभे ॥ 54 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke the auspicious Kṛttikā, worshipped by the gods; / come, O generic goddess, auspicious eldest daughter of Dakṣa.

1.95.s:
prajāpatestathā proktaṃ rohiṇyāḥ śṛṇu pārthiva ..
āvāhayāmi varadāṃ rohiṇīṃ candravallabhām .. 55 ..
1.95.d:
प्रजापतेस्तथा प्रोक्तं रोहिण्याः शृणु पार्थिव ॥
आवाहयामि वरदां रोहिणीं चन्द्रवल्लभाम् ॥ 55 ॥
1.95.m: That of Prajāpati has likewise been spoken; hear now of Rohiṇī, O king: / I invoke the boon-granting Rohiṇī, the beloved of the Moon;

1.95.s:
ehi rohiṇi dharmajñe dhruvakarmasu śobhane ..
candrasyāvāhanaṃ proktamilvalāyā nibodha me .. 56 ..
1.95.d:
एहि रोहिणि धर्मज्ञे ध्रुवकर्मसु शोभने ॥
चन्द्रस्यावाहनं प्रोक्तमिल्वलाया निबोध मे ॥ 56 ॥
1.95.m: come, O Rohiṇī, knower of dharma, beautiful in steadfast rites. / The invocation of the Moon has been spoken; learn from me that of Ilvalā:

1.95.s:
āvāhayāmi varadāmilvalāṃ śaśivallabhām ..
ehi me ilvale devi mṛdukarmasu śobhane .. 57 ..
1.95.d:
आवाहयामि वरदामिल्वलां शशिवल्लभाम् ॥
एहि मे इल्वले देवि मृदुकर्मसु शोभने ॥ 57 ॥
1.95.m: I invoke the boon-granting Ilvalā, beloved of the Moon; / come to me, O goddess Ilvalā, beautiful in gentle rites.

1.95.s:
rudramāvāhayiṣyāmi trinetraṃ śūlapāṇinam ..
ehi śaṅkara sarvātmanmahādeva gaṇeśvara .. 58 ..
1.95.d:
रुद्रमावाहयिष्यामि त्रिनेत्रं शूलपाणिनम् ॥
एहि शङ्कर सर्वात्मन्महादेव गणेश्वर ॥ 58 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke Rudra, three-eyed, trident in hand; / come, O Śaṅkara, Self of all, Mahādeva, lord of the gaṇas.

1.95.s:
ārdrāmāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ bāhusaṃjñikam ..
ehyārdre cārusarvāṅgi dāruṇe rudrasammate .. 59 ..
1.95.d:
आर्द्रामावाहयिष्यामि नक्षत्रं बाहुसंज्ञिकम् ॥
एह्यार्द्रे चारुसर्वाङ्गि दारुणे रुद्रसम्मते ॥ 59 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke Ārdrā, the asterism known as the Arm; / come, O Ārdrā, lovely in all limbs, fierce, esteemed by Rudra.

1.95.s:
āvāhayiṣyāmyaditiṃ tapasā dagdhakilviṣām ..
ādityāraṇi dharmajñe ehi devi mahāprabhe .. .. 1.95.60 ..
1.95.d:
आवाहयिष्याम्यदितिं तपसा दग्धकिल्विषाम् ॥
आदित्यारणि धर्मज्ञे एहि देवि महाप्रभे ॥ ॥ 1.95.60 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke Aditi, whose sins were burnt away by austerity; / O fire-stick of the Ādityas, knower of dharma, come, O goddess of great splendour.

1.95.s:
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi dharmajñaṃ tu punarvasum ..
punarvaso ihāgaccha carakarmaprasādaka .. 61 ..
1.95.d:
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि धर्मज्ञं तु पुनर्वसुम् ॥
पुनर्वसो इहागच्छ चरकर्मप्रसादक ॥ 61 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke the asterism Punarvasu, knower of dharma; / come hither, O Punarvasu, favourer of movable rites.

1.95.s:
jīvasyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ puṣyasyātha pracakṣate ..
puṣyamāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ kṣiprasaṃjñikam .. 62 ..
1.95.d:
जीवस्यावाहनं प्रोक्तं पुष्यस्याथ प्रचक्षते ॥
पुष्यमावाहयिष्यामि नक्षत्रं क्षिप्रसंज्ञिकम् ॥ 62 ॥
1.95.m: The invocation of Jīva has been spoken; now they explain that of Puṣya: / I shall invoke Puṣya, the asterism known as swift;

1.95.s:
ehi puṣya mahābhāga poṣaṃ vardhaya sarvataḥ ..
sarpānāvāhayiṣyāmi trailokyāntaragocarān .. .. 63 ..
1.95.d:
एहि पुष्य महाभाग पोषं वर्धय सर्वतः ॥
सर्पानावाहयिष्यामि त्रैलोक्यान्तरगोचरान् ॥ ॥ 63 ॥
1.95.m: come, O illustrious Puṣya, increase nourishment everywhere. / I shall invoke the serpents who roam within the three worlds;

1.95.s:
āyāntu sarvataḥ sarpāḥ saumyarūpā bhavantu ca ..
āvāhayiṣyāmyāśleṣāṃ bhaktānāṃ śrīvivarddhanām .. 64 ..
1.95.d:
आयान्तु सर्वतः सर्पाः सौम्यरूपा भवन्तु च ॥
आवाहयिष्याम्याश्लेषां भक्तानां श्रीविवर्द्धनाम् ॥ 64 ॥
1.95.m: let the serpents come from every side, and let them assume gentle forms. / I shall invoke Āśleṣā, who increases the prosperity of her devotees;

1.95.s:
āśleṣe tvamihābhyehi dāruṇe vijayaprade ..
pitṝnāvāhayiṣyāmi mūrtyamūrtidharānaham .. 65 ..
1.95.d:
आश्लेषे त्वमिहाभ्येहि दारुणे विजयप्रदे ॥
पितॄनावाहयिष्यामि मूर्त्यमूर्तिधरानहम् ॥ 65 ॥
1.95.m: come hither, O Āśleṣā, fierce one who bestows victory. / I shall invoke the ancestors, both embodied and formless;

1.95.s:
āyāntu pitaraśśīghraṃ sudhākavyabhujo'vyayāḥ..
maghāmāvāhayiṣyāmi ugranakṣatramañjasā .. 66 ..
1.95.d:
आयान्तु पितरश्शीघ्रं सुधाकव्यभुजोऽव्ययाः॥
मघामावाहयिष्यामि उग्रनक्षत्रमञ्जसा ॥ 66 ॥
1.95.m: let the imperishable ancestors quickly arrive, who partake of nectar and ancestral offerings. / I shall straightway invoke Maghā, the fierce asterism;

1.95.s:
ehi me subhage devi maghe'ghaviniṣūdane ..
bhagamāvāhayiṣyāmi pūrvaphalgunasaṃjñitam .. 67 ...
1.95.d:
एहि मे सुभगे देवि मघेऽघविनिषूदने ॥
भगमावाहयिष्यामि पूर्वफल्गुनसंज्ञितम् ॥ 67 ॥।
1.95.m: come to me, O fortunate goddess, O Maghā, destroyer of sins. / I shall invoke Bhaga, known as Pūrvaphalgunī;

1.95.s:
ehi bhāgye mahābhāge ugrakarmaprasādike ..
āvāhayiṣyāmyaryamṇamādityaṃ tejasāṃ nidhim .. 68 ..
1.95.d:
एहि भाग्ये महाभागे उग्रकर्मप्रसादिके ॥
आवाहयिष्याम्यर्यम्णमादित्यं तेजसां निधिम् ॥ 68 ॥
1.95.m: come, O daughter of Bhaga, highly fortunate one who favours fierce rites. / I shall invoke Aryaman, the Āditya, a storehouse of splendours;

1.95.s:
aryamam̐stvaṃ samamyehi bhaktapātakanāśana ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi cottarāphalgunīṃ śubhām .. 69 ..
1.95.d:
अर्यमम्̐स्त्वं समम्येहि भक्तपातकनाशन ॥
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि चोत्तराफल्गुनीं शुभाम् ॥ 69 ॥
1.95.m: come forth together, O Aryaman, destroyer of devotees' sins. / And I shall invoke the auspicious asterism Uttaraphalgunī;

1.95.s:
ehi tvaṃ subhage devi dhruve sarvāṅgasundari ..
āvāhanaṃ mayā proktaṃ saviturdīptatejasaḥ .. 1.95.70 ..
1.95.d:
एहि त्वं सुभगे देवि ध्रुवे सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरि ॥
आवाहनं मया प्रोक्तं सवितुर्दीप्ततेजसः ॥ 1.95.70 ॥
1.95.m: come, O fortunate goddess, steadfast one, beautiful in all limbs. / The invocation of Savitṛ of blazing splendour has been spoken by me;

1.95.s:
hastamāvāhayiṣyāmi sāvitraṃ kṣipramañjasā ..
ehi sāvitra dharmajña bhaktānāṃ pāpanāśana .. 71 ..
1.95.d:
हस्तमावाहयिष्यामि सावित्रं क्षिप्रमञ्जसा ॥
एहि सावित्र धर्मज्ञ भक्तानां पापनाशन ॥ 71 ॥
1.95.m: I shall straightway invoke Hasta, dedicated to Savitṛ, the swift one; / come, O [asterism] of Savitṛ, knower of dharma, destroyer of devotees' sins.

1.95.s:
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ tvaṣṭāramamitadyutim ..
ehi me bhagavam̐stvaṣṭaḥ prajāpālanatatpara .. 72 ..
1.95.d:
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं त्वष्टारममितद्युतिम् ॥
एहि मे भगवम्̐स्त्वष्टः प्रजापालनतत्पर ॥ 72 ॥
1.95.m: I invoke the god Tvaṣṭṛ of boundless splendour; / come to me, O lord Tvaṣṭṛ, intent on protecting creatures.

1.95.s:
citrāmāvāhayiṣyāmi citrarūpāṃ manoharām ..
ehi me varade citre mṛdukarmaprasādhini .. 73 ..
1.95.d:
चित्रामावाहयिष्यामि चित्ररूपां मनोहराम् ॥
एहि मे वरदे चित्रे मृदुकर्मप्रसाधिनि ॥ 73 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke Citrā, of varied form, charming; / come to me, O boon-granting Citrā, accomplisher of gentle rites.

1.95.s:
vāyumāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvagaṃ dīptatejasam ..
deva vāyo tvamabhyehi sarvabhūtajagatpriya .. 74 ..
1.95.d:
वायुमावाहयिष्यामि सर्वगं दीप्ततेजसम् ॥
देव वायो त्वमभ्येहि सर्वभूतजगत्प्रिय ॥ 74 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke Vāyu, all-pervading, of blazing splendour; / come hither, O god Vāyu, dear to all beings and the universe.

1.95.s:
svātimāvāhayiṣyāmi nityamuttaramārgagām ..
devi svāte tvamabhyehi carakarmasu śobhane .. 75 ..
1.95.d:
स्वातिमावाहयिष्यामि नित्यमुत्तरमार्गगाम् ॥
देवि स्वाते त्वमभ्येहि चरकर्मसु शोभने ॥ 75 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke Svāti, who constantly moves along the northern path; / come hither, O goddess Svāti, beautiful in movable rites.

1.95.s:
āvāhayiṣyāmīndrāgnī sahitau dīptatejasau ..
indrābhyehi jagannātha ehyagne vijayaprada .. 76 ..
1.95.d:
आवाहयिष्यामीन्द्राग्नी सहितौ दीप्ततेजसौ ॥
इन्द्राभ्येहि जगन्नाथ एह्यग्ने विजयप्रद ॥ 76 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke Indra and Agni together, both of blazing splendour; / come, O Indra, lord of the world; come, O Agni, granter of victory.

1.95.s:
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi viśākhāṃ dīptatejasam ..
viśākhe tvamihābhyehi devi sādhāraṇe śubhe .. 77 ..
1.95.d:
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि विशाखां दीप्ततेजसम् ॥
विशाखे त्वमिहाभ्येहि देवि साधारणे शुभे ॥ 77 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke the asterism Viśākhā of blazing splendour; / come hither, O Viśākhā, O generic, auspicious goddess.

1.95.s:
mitramāvāhayiṣyāmi devaṃ dīptāṃśumūrjitam ..
ehi mitra mahābhāga bhaktāghapralayaṅkara .. 78 ..
1.95.d:
मित्रमावाहयिष्यामि देवं दीप्तांशुमूर्जितम् ॥
एहि मित्र महाभाग भक्ताघप्रलयङ्कर ॥ 78 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke Mitra, the mighty god of blazing rays; / come, O highly fortunate Mitra, destroyer of devotees' sins.

1.95.s:
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi hyanurādhāṃ varapradām ..
anūrādhe tvamabhyehi mṛdukarmasu śobhane ..79 ..
1.95.d:
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि ह्यनुराधां वरप्रदाम् ॥
अनूराधे त्वमभ्येहि मृदुकर्मसु शोभने ॥79 ॥
1.95.m: And I shall invoke the asterism Anurādhā, bestower of boons; / come hither, O Anurādhā, beautiful in gentle rites.

1.95.s:
śakrasyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ jyeṣṭhāyāḥ śṛṇu pārthiva ..
jyeṣṭhāmāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ śakradaivatam .. 1.95.80 ..
1.95.d:
शक्रस्यावाहनं प्रोक्तं ज्येष्ठायाः शृणु पार्थिव ॥
ज्येष्ठामावाहयिष्यामि नक्षत्रं शक्रदैवतम् ॥ 1.95.80 ॥
1.95.m: The invocation of Śakra has been spoken; hear of Jyeṣṭhā, O king: / I shall invoke Jyeṣṭhā, the asterism presiding over by Śakra;

1.95.s:
jyeṣṭhe devi tvamabhyehi dāruṇe cārulocane ..
devamāvāhayiṣyāmi devaṃ nirṛtijaṃ prabhum .. 81 ..
1.95.d:
ज्येष्ठे देवि त्वमभ्येहि दारुणे चारुलोचने ॥
देवमावाहयिष्यामि देवं निरृतिजं प्रभुम् ॥ 81 ॥
1.95.m: come hither, O goddess Jyeṣṭhā, fierce one with lovely eyes. / I shall invoke the god, the sovereign born of Nirṛti;

1.95.s:
ehi deva virūpākṣa mahābalaparākrama ..
mūlamāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ dāruṇaṃ mahat .. 82 ..
1.95.d:
एहि देव विरूपाक्ष महाबलपराक्रम ॥
मूलमावाहयिष्यामि नक्षत्रं दारुणं महत् ॥ 82 ॥
1.95.m: come, O god of uneven eyes, of great strength and valour. / I shall invoke Mūla, the great and fierce asterism;

1.95.s:
ehi mūla mahābhāga bhaktānāmabhayaprada ..
apastvāvāhayiṣyāmi sarvagā varadāḥ śivāḥ .. .. 83 ..
1.95.d:
एहि मूल महाभाग भक्तानामभयप्रद ॥
अपस्त्वावाहयिष्यामि सर्वगा वरदाः शिवाः ॥ ॥ 83 ॥
1.95.m: come, O highly fortunate Mūla, granter of fearlessness to devotees. / And I shall invoke the Waters, all-pervading, boon-giving, auspicious;

1.95.s:
āpastvāyāntu varadāḥ pavitrā maṅgalāvahāḥ ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi pūrvāṣāḍhetisaṃjñitam .. 84 ..
1.95.d:
आपस्त्वायान्तु वरदाः पवित्रा मङ्गलावहाः ॥
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि पूर्वाषाढेतिसंज्ञितम् ॥ 84 ॥
1.95.m: let the Waters come, boon-giving, pure, and bringing auspiciousness. / I shall invoke the asterism known as Pūrvāṣāḍhā;

1.95.s:
ehi tvamugre varade cāṣāḍhe pūrva pūrvake ..
viśvānāvāhayiṣyāmi devānadbhutatejasaḥ .. 85 ..
1.95.d:
एहि त्वमुग्रे वरदे चाषाढे पूर्व पूर्वके ॥
विश्वानावाहयिष्यामि देवानद्भुततेजसः ॥ 85 ॥
1.95.m: come, O fierce, boon-giving Aṣāḍhā, the earlier one. / I shall invoke the Viśvedevas of wondrous splendour;

1.95.s:
āyāntu varadāḥ sarve viśvedevā mahābalāḥ ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi uttarāṣāḍhasaṃjñitam .. 86 ..
1.95.d:
आयान्तु वरदाः सर्वे विश्वेदेवा महाबलाः ॥
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि उत्तराषाढसंज्ञितम् ॥ 86 ॥
1.95.m: let all the boon-giving Viśvedevas of great power come. / I shall invoke the asterism known as Uttarāṣāḍhā;

1.95.s:
ehi tvamuttarāṣāḍhe sarvakarmasu śobhane ..
brahmaṇa āvāhanaṃ proktamabhijiti śṛṇu he prabho .. 87 ..
1.95.d:
एहि त्वमुत्तराषाढे सर्वकर्मसु शोभने ॥
ब्रह्मण आवाहनं प्रोक्तमभिजिति शृणु हे प्रभो ॥ 87 ॥
1.95.m: come, O Uttarāṣāḍhā, beautiful in all rites. / The invocation of Brahmā has been spoken; hear now concerning Abhijit, O lord:

1.95.s:
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi yattadabhijiducyate ..
ehi dhiṣṇyavariṣṭhāya kṣiprakarmaprasādhaka .. 88 ..
1.95.d:
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि यत्तदभिजिदुच्यते ॥
एहि धिष्ण्यवरिष्ठाय क्षिप्रकर्मप्रसाधक ॥ 88 ॥
1.95.m: I shall invoke that asterism which is called Abhijit; / come to the foremost of celestial seats, O accomplisher of swift rites.

1.95.s:
viṣṇorāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ śravaṇasya nibodha me ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi śravaṇaṃ sarvakāmadam .. 89 .. ..
1.95.d:
विष्णोरावाहनं प्रोक्तं श्रवणस्य निबोध मे ॥
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि श्रवणं सर्वकामदम् ॥ 89 ॥ ॥
1.95.m: The invocation of Viṣṇu has been spoken; learn from me that of Śravaṇa: / I shall invoke the asterism Śravaṇa, granter of all desires.

1.95.s:
aśvattha tvaṃ samabhyehi carakarmaprasādhaka ..
vasūnāvāhayiṣyāmi devānaṣṭau varapradān .. 1.95.90 ..
1.95.d:
अश्वत्थ त्वं समभ्येहि चरकर्मप्रसाधक ॥
वसूनावाहयिष्यामि देवानष्टौ वरप्रदान् ॥ 1.95.90 ॥
1.95.m: Come forth, O sacred fig tree, accomplish mobile acts! / I will summon the Vasus, the eight boon-granting gods.

1.95.s:
āyāntu varadā devā vasavaḥ pāpanāśanāḥ ..
dhaniṣṭhāmāvāhayiṣyāmi nakṣatraṃ rāśivallabham .. 91 ..
1.95.d:
आयान्तु वरदा देवा वसवः पापनाशनाः ॥
धनिष्ठामावाहयिष्यामि नक्षत्रं राशिवल्लभम् ॥ 91 ॥
1.95.m: May the boon-granting gods, the Vasus, destroyers of sin, arrive. / I will summon Dhaniṣṭhā, the asterism dear to the zodiacal sign.

1.95.s:
dhaniṣṭhe tvamihāgaccha carakarmaprasādhake ..
āvāhanaṃ mayā proktaṃ varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ .. 92 ..
1.95.d:
धनिष्ठे त्वमिहागच्छ चरकर्मप्रसाधके ॥
आवाहनं मया प्रोक्तं वरुणस्य महात्मनः ॥ 92 ॥
1.95.m: Come here, O Dhaniṣṭhā, accomplisher of mobile acts! / The invocation of the great-souled Varuṇa has been spoken by me.

1.95.s:
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi nāmnā śatabhiṣaṃ śubham ..
āgaccha tvaṃ śatabhiṣe carakarmasu śobhane .. 93 ..
1.95.d:
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि नाम्ना शतभिषं शुभम् ॥
आगच्छ त्वं शतभिषे चरकर्मसु शोभने ॥ 93 ॥
1.95.m: I will summon the auspicious asterism named Śatabhiṣaj. / Come, O Śatabhiṣaj, fair one in mobile acts!

1.95.s:
ajaikapādaṃ varadaṃ rudramāvāhayāmyaham ..
ahirbudhnya samabhyehi jaṭājūṭopaśobhita .. 94 ..
1.95.d:
अजैकपादं वरदं रुद्रमावाहयाम्यहम् ॥
अहिर्बुध्न्य समभ्येहि जटाजूटोपशोभित ॥ 94 ॥
1.95.m: I summon the boon-granting Rudra Aja Ekapād. / Come forth, O Ahirbudhnya, adorned with matted locks!

1.95.s:
dhruvamāvāhayiṣyāmi deśe bhādrapadottare ..
ehi tvaṃ sumahābhāge mama bhādrapadottare..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi revatīṃ cārudarśanām .. 95 ..
1.95.d:
ध्रुवमावाहयिष्यामि देशे भाद्रपदोत्तरे ॥
एहि त्वं सुमहाभागे मम भाद्रपदोत्तरे॥
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि रेवतीं चारुदर्शनाम् ॥ 95 ॥
1.95.m: I will summon the fixed [asterism] in the region of Uttarabhādrapadā. / Come, O most fortunate one, my Uttarabhādrapadā! / I will summon the asterism Revatī of lovely appearance.

1.95.s:
ehi revati dharmajñe mṛdukarmaprasādhake ..
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ pāpanāśanam .. 96 ..
1.95.d:
एहि रेवति धर्मज्ञे मृदुकर्मप्रसाधके ॥
आवाहयाम्यहं देवं पूषणं पापनाशनम् ॥ 96 ॥
1.95.m: Come, O Revatī, knower of dharma, accomplisher of gentle acts! / I summon the god Pūṣan, the destroyer of sin.

1.95.s:
pūṣansamyagihābhyehi sarvakarmaprasādika ..
āvāhayāmyahaṃ devau nāsatyau sūryanandanau .. 97 ..
1.95.d:
पूषन्सम्यगिहाभ्येहि सर्वकर्मप्रसादिक ॥
आवाहयाम्यहं देवौ नासत्यौ सूर्यनन्दनौ ॥ 97 ॥
1.95.m: O Pūṣan, come here duly, accomplisher of all acts! / I summon the two gods, the Nāsatyas, sons of the Sun.

1.95.s:
āgacchetāṃ mahābhāgau varadāvaśvināvubhau ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi cāśvinī sarvakāmadam .. 98 ..
1.95.d:
आगच्छेतां महाभागौ वरदावश्विनावुभौ ॥
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि चाश्विनी सर्वकामदम् ॥ 98 ॥
1.95.m: May both the most fortunate, boon-granting Aśvins arrive. / I will summon the asterism Aśvinī, which grants all desires.

1.95.s:
yamasyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ bharaṇīmatha vai śṛṇu ..
ṛkṣamāvāhayiṣyāmi cograṃ bharaṇisaṃjñakam .. 99 ..
1.95.d:
यमस्यावाहनं प्रोक्तं भरणीमथ वै शृणु ॥
ऋक्षमावाहयिष्यामि चोग्रं भरणिसंज्ञकम् ॥ 99 ॥
1.95.m: The invocation of Yama has been spoken; now hear about Bharaṇī. / I will summon the fierce asterism called Bharaṇī.

1.95.s:
ehi tvaṃ devi bharaṇi subhage cārudarśini ..
śakrasyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ pūrvameva mayā nṛpa .. 1.95.100..
1.95.d:
एहि त्वं देवि भरणि सुभगे चारुदर्शिनि ॥
शक्रस्यावाहनं प्रोक्तं पूर्वमेव मया नृप ॥ 1.95.100॥
1.95.m: Come, O goddess Bharaṇī, auspicious and of lovely appearance! / The invocation of Śakra was already spoken earlier by me, O king.

1.95.s:
prācīmāvāhayiṣyāmi sūryodayavibhūṣitām ..
ehi tvaṃ varade pūrve śubhakarmaprasādhike .. 101 ..
1.95.d:
प्राचीमावाहयिष्यामि सूर्योदयविभूषिताम् ॥
एहि त्वं वरदे पूर्वे शुभकर्मप्रसाधिके ॥ 101 ॥
1.95.m: I will summon the eastern direction, adorned with the rising of the sun. / Come, O boon-granting eastern [direction], accomplisher of auspicious acts!

1.95.s:
vahnerāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ pūrvameva mayā tava ..
diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi varadāṃ pūrvadakṣiṇām .. 102 ..
1.95.d:
वह्नेरावाहनं प्रोक्तं पूर्वमेव मया तव ॥
दिशमावाहयिष्यामि वरदां पूर्वदक्षिणाम् ॥ 102 ॥
1.95.m: The invocation of Vahni was already spoken earlier by me to you. / I will summon the boon-granting south-eastern direction.

1.95.s:
vahnipriye samabhyehi varade pūrvadakṣiṇe ..
yamasyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ yāmyāyāśca diśaḥ śṛṇu .. 103 ..
1.95.d:
वह्निप्रिये समभ्येहि वरदे पूर्वदक्षिणे ॥
