यमस्यावाहनं प्रोक्तं याम्यायाश्च दिशः शृणु ॥ 103 ॥
1.95.m: Beloved of Vahni, come forth, O boon-granting south-eastern [direction]! / The invocation of Yama has been spoken; now hear about the southern direction.

1.95.s:
ahamāvāhayiṣyāmi dakṣiṇāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ..
dakṣiṇe tvaṃ samabhyehi sarvakarmasu śobhane .. 104 ..
1.95.d:
अहमावाहयिष्यामि दक्षिणां दक्षिणां दिशम् ॥
दक्षिणे त्वं समभ्येहि सर्वकर्मसु शोभने ॥ 104 ॥
1.95.m: I will summon the bountiful southern direction. / Come forth, O southern [direction], fair in all acts!

1.95.s:
pūrvamāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ virūpākṣasya dhīmataḥ ..
diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi śubhāṃ dakṣiṇapaścimām .. 105 ...
1.95.d:
पूर्वमावाहनं प्रोक्तं विरूपाक्षस्य धीमतः ॥
दिशमावाहयिष्यामि शुभां दक्षिणपश्चिमाम् ॥ 105 ॥।
1.95.m: The invocation of the wise Virūpākṣa was spoken earlier. / I will summon the auspicious south-western direction.

1.95.s:
ehi me nairṛtī devi satataṃ bhūtivardhini ..
āvāhanaṃ mayā proktaṃ varuṇasya mahātmanaḥ .. 106 ..
1.95.d:
एहि मे नैरृती देवि सततं भूतिवर्धिनि ॥
आवाहनं मया प्रोक्तं वरुणस्य महात्मनः ॥ 106 ॥
1.95.m: Come to me, O goddess Nairṛtī, constant promoter of prosperity! / The invocation of the great-souled Varuṇa has been spoken by me.

1.95.s:
diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi vāruṇīṃ varuṇīṃ śubhām ..
āgaccha paścime devi varade varuṇapriye .. 107 ..
1.95.d:
दिशमावाहयिष्यामि वारुणीं वरुणीं शुभाम् ॥
आगच्छ पश्चिमे देवि वरदे वरुणप्रिये ॥ 107 ॥
1.95.m: I will summon the auspicious western direction, belonging to Varuṇa. / Come, O western goddess, boon-granting one beloved of Varuṇa!

1.95.s:
āvāhanaṃ mayā proktaṃ vāyoścaiva mahātmanaḥ ..
āvāhayāmi vidiśaṃ vāyavyāṃ paścimottarām .. .. 108 ..
1.95.d:
आवाहनं मया प्रोक्तं वायोश्चैव महात्मनः ॥
आवाहयामि विदिशं वायव्यां पश्चिमोत्तराम् ॥ ॥ 108 ॥
1.95.m: The invocation of the great-souled Vāyu too has been spoken by me. / I summon the intermediate direction, the north-western, sacred to Vāyu.

1.95.s:
varade tvaṃ samabhyehi vāyavye paścimottare ..
āvāhayāmi dhanadaṃ devaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ prabhum .. 109 ..
1.95.d:
वरदे त्वं समभ्येहि वायव्ये पश्चिमोत्तरे ॥
आवाहयामि धनदं देवं वैश्रवणं प्रभुम् ॥ 109 ॥
1.95.m: O boon-granting one, come forth, north-western [direction] sacred to Vāyu! / I summon the god who gives wealth, Lord Vaiśravaṇa.

1.95.s:
rājarāja samabhyehi sarvayajñadhanādhipa ..
diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi saumyāṃ dhanadapālitām .. 1.95.110 ..
1.95.d:
राजराज समभ्येहि सर्वयज्ञधनाधिप ॥
दिशमावाहयिष्यामि सौम्यां धनदपालिताम् ॥ 1.95.110 ॥
1.95.m: Come forth, O king of kings, master of all sacrificial wealth! / I will summon the gentle northern direction, protected by the giver of wealth.

1.95.s:
uttare tvaṃ samabhyehi sarvakarmasu śobhane ..
devasyāvāhanaṃ proktaṃ tryambakasya mahātmanaḥ .. .. 111 ..
1.95.d:
उत्तरे त्वं समभ्येहि सर्वकर्मसु शोभने ॥
देवस्यावाहनं प्रोक्तं त्र्यम्बकस्य महात्मनः ॥ ॥ 111 ॥
1.95.m: Come forth, O northern [direction], fair in all acts! / The invocation of the great-souled god Tryambaka has been spoken.

1.95.s:
diśamāvāhayiṣyāmi śubhāṃ prāguttarāmaham ..
ehi tvaṃ subhage devi satataṃ śivapālite .. 112 ..
1.95.d:
दिशमावाहयिष्यामि शुभां प्रागुत्तरामहम् ॥
एहि त्वं सुभगे देवि सततं शिवपालिते ॥ 112 ॥
1.95.m: I will summon the auspicious north-eastern direction. / Come, O auspicious goddess, constantly protected by Śiva!

1.95.s:
sarvānāvāhayiṣyāmi pūrvakumbheṣu sāgarān ..
ratnādhyakṣāḥ samāyāntu catvāra iha sāgarāḥ .. 113 ..
1.95.d:
सर्वानावाहयिष्यामि पूर्वकुम्भेषु सागरान् ॥
रत्नाध्यक्षाः समायान्तु चत्वार इह सागराः ॥ 113 ॥
1.95.m: I will summon all the oceans into the eastern water-jars. / May the four oceans, guardians of jewels, arrive here.

1.95.s:
īśānyāṃ diśi yaḥ kumbhaḥ pūrvastasya tu sāgaraḥ ..
āgneyyāntu samāyātu dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇaḥ śivaḥ .. 114 ..
1.95.d:
ईशान्यां दिशि यः कुम्भः पूर्वस्तस्य तु सागरः ॥
आग्नेय्यान्तु समायातु दक्षिणे दक्षिणः शिवः ॥ 114 ॥
1.95.m: Into the jar that is in the north-eastern direction, [let] the eastern ocean [arrive]; / and into the south-eastern, let the southern ocean arrive, auspicious in the south.

1.95.s:
paścimastu samāyātu kumbhe dakṣiṇapaścime ..
uttaraśca tathā'bhyetu kumbhe vai paścimottare .. 115 ..
1.95.d:
पश्चिमस्तु समायातु कुम्भे दक्षिणपश्चिमे ॥
उत्तरश्च तथाऽभ्येतु कुम्भे वै पश्चिमोत्तरे ॥ 115 ॥
1.95.m: Let the western [ocean] arrive into the jar in the south-west; / and likewise let the northern [ocean] arrive into the jar in the north-west.

1.95.s:
āvāhitānāṃ kartavyaṃ bhūmau kṛtvā tataḥ śiraḥ ..
praṇāmamabhivādyaṃ ca tato mantramudīrayet .. 116 ..
1.95.d:
आवाहितानां कर्तव्यं भूमौ कृत्वा ततः शिरः ॥
प्रणाममभिवाद्यं च ततो मन्त्रमुदीरयेत् ॥ 116 ॥
1.95.m: Placing one's head on the ground before those who have been summoned, / a respectful greeting and obeisance should be made; then one should recite the mantra:

1.95.s:
bhavatāṃ hi prasādena bhavatāṃ pratipūjanaiḥ ..
prayatiṣye yathāśaktyā tanme'nujñātumarhatha .. 117 ..
1.95.d:
भवतां हि प्रसादेन भवतां प्रतिपूजनैः ॥
प्रयतिष्ये यथाशक्त्या तन्मेऽनुज्ञातुमर्हथ ॥ 117 ॥
1.95.m: "Indeed, through your grace and through worship offered in return to you, / I shall strive according to my ability; therefore, you ought to grant me permission.

1.95.s:
yuṣmākaṃ pūjanaṃ kartuṃ kena śakyaṃ yathāvidhi..
yuṣmatpūjāvihīnena kuto labhyaṃ mahatpadam .. 118 ..
1.95.d:
युष्माकं पूजनं कर्तुं केन शक्यं यथाविधि॥
युष्मत्पूजाविहीनेन कुतो लभ्यं महत्पदम् ॥ 118 ॥
1.95.m: Who is able to perform your worship according to rule? / For one devoid of your worship, whence can the great state be attained?

1.95.s:
tataḥ kartuṃ yathāśaktyā bhavatāṃ pratipūjane ..
varadāḥ prayatiṣyāmi tanmenujñātumarhatha .. 119 ..
1.95.d:
ततः कर्तुं यथाशक्त्या भवतां प्रतिपूजने ॥
वरदाः प्रयतिष्यामि तन्मेनुज्ञातुमर्हथ ॥ 119 ॥
1.95.m: Therefore, O givers of boons, I shall strive according to my ability / to worship you in return; therefore, you ought to grant me permission.

1.95.s:
bhavatpūjāvidhāvasminbahuvijñaṃ sadaiva tu ..
svāṃsvāṃ diśamadhiṣṭhāya dikpālā dīptatejasaḥ ..1.95.120 ..
1.95.d:
भवत्पूजाविधावस्मिन्बहुविज्ञं सदैव तु ॥
स्वांस्वां दिशमधिष्ठाय दिक्पाला दीप्ततेजसः ॥1.95.120 ॥
1.95.m: In this rite of your worship there are always many obstacles; / standing each in his own direction, may the guardians of the directions, of blazing splendour,

1.95.s:
utsādayantu sakalānvighnānme samupasthitān ..
asmāddeśātpraṇaśyantu yajñaghnā brahmarākṣasāḥ .. 121 ..
1.95.d:
उत्सादयन्तु सकलान्विघ्नान्मे समुपस्थितान् ॥
अस्माद्देशात्प्रणश्यन्तु यज्ञघ्ना ब्रह्मराक्षसाः ॥ 121 ॥
1.95.m: destroy all obstacles that have arisen for me! / May the brahmarākṣasas, destroyers of sacrifices, perish from this place!

1.95.s:
vināyakā vighnakarā mamogrā yajñadviṣo ye piśitāśanāśca ..
siddhārthakairvajrasamānakalpairmayā nirastāḥ svagṛhaṃ prayāntu .. 122..
1.95.d:
विनायका विघ्नकरा ममोग्रा यज्ञद्विषो ये पिशिताशनाश्च ॥
सिद्धार्थकैर्वज्रसमानकल्पैर्मया निरस्ताः स्वगृहं प्रयान्तु ॥ 122॥
1.95.m: May the obstacle-making, fierce Vināyakas, enemies of sacrifice, and meat-eaters, / repelled by me with white mustard seeds equal to thunderbolts, depart to their own home!"

1.95.s:
etāvaduktvā vikireta vidvānsiddhārthakāndikṣu tathā vidikṣu ..
rakṣohaṇaṃ cātra tathaiva maṃtraṃ vaktavyamuccairdvijapuṅgavena .. 123 ..
1.95.d:
एतावदुक्त्वा विकिरेत विद्वान्सिद्धार्थकान्दिक्षु तथा विदिक्षु ॥
रक्षोहणं चात्र तथैव मंत्रं वक्तव्यमुच्चैर्द्विजपुङ्गवेन ॥ 123 ॥
1.95.m: Having said this much, the learned man should scatter white mustard seeds in the cardinal and intermediate directions; / and the foremost of the twice-born should likewise recite loudly here the mantra that slays rākṣasas.

1.95.s:
sarvagrahāṇāṃ yajane pradiṣṭaṃ sarvauṣadhaiḥ snānamadīnasattva ..
bījaiḥ samagraiśca tathaiva gandhairmṛdbhiśca ratnaiśca tathā jalaiśca .. 124 ..
1.95.d:
सर्वग्रहाणां यजने प्रदिष्टं सर्वौषधैः स्नानमदीनसत्त्व ॥
बीजैः समग्रैश्च तथैव गन्धैर्मृद्भिश्च रत्नैश्च तथा जलैश्च ॥ 124 ॥
1.95.m: In the sacrifice to all the planets, a bath with all medicinal herbs has been prescribed, O you of steadfast mind, / and likewise with all seeds, perfumes, clays, jewels, and waters.

1.96.s:
vajra uvāca ..
sarveṣāṃ tu samācakṣva gandhamālyaṃ tathaiva ca ..
dhūpaṃ brahmansanaivedyaṃ pānaṃ caiva pṛthakpṛthak .. 1 ..
1.96.d:
वज्र उवाच ॥
सर्वेषां तु समाचक्ष्व गन्धमाल्यं तथैव च ॥
धूपं ब्रह्मन्सनैवेद्यं पानं चैव पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 1 ॥
1.96.m: Vajra said: / Declare, O brahmin, the perfume and garland, as well as / the incense, the food-offering, and the drink for all [of them] separately,

1.96.s:
homadravyaṃ tathā mantraṃ dakṣiṇāśca bhṛgūttama ..
ekastvaṃ sarvavidbrahmanbrahmā vā jagatāṃ patiḥ .. 2 ..
1.96.d:
होमद्रव्यं तथा मन्त्रं दक्षिणाश्च भृगूत्तम ॥
एकस्त्वं सर्वविद्ब्रह्मन्ब्रह्मा वा जगतां पतिः ॥ 2 ॥
1.96.m: as well as the oblation-substance, the mantra, and the sacrificial fees, O foremost of the Bhṛgus. / You alone are all-knowing, O brahmin, or Brahmā, the lord of the worlds.

1.96.s:
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ..
dhruvasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ devānāṃ ca mahīpate ..
sarvāsāṃ candanaṃ deyaṃ nityameva pṛthakpṛthak.. 3..
1.96.d:
मार्कण्डेय उवाच ॥
ध्रुवस्थाननिविष्टानां देवानां च महीपते ॥
सर्वासां चन्दनं देयं नित्यमेव पृथक्पृथक्॥ 3॥
1.96.m: Mārkaṇḍeya said: / To the gods who dwell in the northern polar region, O protector of the earth, / sandalwood is to be given always to all of them separately.

1.96.s:
sūryāya kuṅkumaṃ deyaṃ karpūraṃ śaśine tathā ..
bhaumāya candanaṃ raktaṃ cāguruṃ śaśijāya ca .. 4 ..
1.96.d:
सूर्याय कुङ्कुमं देयं कर्पूरं शशिने तथा ॥
भौमाय चन्दनं रक्तं चागुरुं शशिजाय च ॥ 4 ॥
1.96.m: Saffron is to be given to the Sun, and camphor likewise to the Moon; / red sandalwood to Mars, and aloe-wood to the son of the Moon [Mercury];

1.96.s:
jīvāya candanaṃ deyaṃ kuṅkumena vimiśritam ..
śukrāya candanaṃ śvetaṃ saurāya ca mṛgodbhavam .. 5 ..
1.96.d:
जीवाय चन्दनं देयं कुङ्कुमेन विमिश्रितम् ॥
शुक्राय चन्दनं श्वेतं सौराय च मृगोद्भवम् ॥ 5 ॥
1.96.m: sandalwood mixed with saffron is to be given to Jupiter; / white sandalwood to Venus; and musk to Saturn;

1.96.s:
kuṅkumena yutaṃ dadyāddānavāya mṛgodbhavam ..
aguruṃ kuṅkumaṃ cobhau sudeyau dhūmaketave .. 6 ..
1.96.d:
कुङ्कुमेन युतं दद्याद्दानवाय मृगोद्भवम् ॥
अगुरुं कुङ्कुमं चोभौ सुदेयौ धूमकेतवे ॥ 6 ॥
1.96.m: one should give musk combined with saffron to Rāhu; / and aloe-wood and saffron are both well-given to Ketu;

1.96.s:
kuṅkumaṃ kṛttikānāṃ tu rohiṇīnāṃ mṛgodbhavam ..
ilvalānāṃ ca karpūraṃ raudre nāgamadaṃ tathā .. 7 ..
1.96.d:
कुङ्कुमं कृत्तिकानां तु रोहिणीनां मृगोद्भवम् ॥
इल्वलानां च कर्पूरं रौद्रे नागमदं तथा ॥ 7 ॥
1.96.m: saffron to the Kṛttikās, and musk to the Rohiṇīs; / camphor to the Ilvalās [Mṛgaśiras], and snake-ichor [or musk] to the constellation of Rudra [Ārdrā].

1.96.s:
ādityasya pradātavyāvubhau kuṅkumacandanau ..
uśīracandanau deyāvāśleṣāpaitryayostathā .. 8 ..
1.96.d:
आदित्यस्य प्रदातव्यावुभौ कुङ्कुमचन्दनौ ॥
उशीरचन्दनौ देयावाश्लेषापैत्र्ययोस्तथा ॥ 8 ॥
1.96.m: To the Sun should be given both saffron and sandalwood; / and to Āśleṣā and the Ancestors' [lunar mansion] should be offered vetiver and sandalwood.

1.96.s:
priyaṅgucandanau deyau tathā bhāgyasya pārthiva ..
aryamṇaśca pradātavyau candanau śvetaraktakau .. 9 ..
1.96.d:
प्रियङ्गुचन्दनौ देयौ तथा भाग्यस्य पार्थिव ॥
अर्यम्णश्च प्रदातव्यौ चन्दनौ श्वेतरक्तकौ ॥ 9 ॥
1.96.m: Priyaṅgu and sandalwood should be given likewise to [the mansion of] Bhaga, O king; / and to [the mansion of] Aryaman should be given white and red sandalwood.

1.96.s:
sāvitrasya pradātavyaṃ kuṅkumaṃ pṛthivīpate ..
tvāṣṭrasya candanaṃ deyaṃ kuṅkumaṃ samṛgodbhavam .. 1.96.10 ..
1.96.d:
सावित्रस्य प्रदातव्यं कुङ्कुमं पृथिवीपते ॥
त्वाष्ट्रस्य चन्दनं देयं कुङ्कुमं समृगोद्भवम् ॥ 1.96.10 ॥
1.96.m: To [the mansion of] Savitṛ saffron should be given, O lord of the earth; / to [the mansion of] Tvaṣṭṛ sandalwood should be given along with saffron and musk.

1.96.s:
jātīphalayutaṃ deyaṃ vāyavyasya ca candanam ..
viśākhāyāḥ pradātavyaṃ kuṅkumaṃ candanaṃ tathā .. 11 ..
1.96.d:
जातीफलयुतं देयं वायव्यस्य च चन्दनम् ॥
विशाखायाः प्रदातव्यं कुङ्कुमं चन्दनं तथा ॥ 11 ॥
1.96.m: Sandalwood mixed with nutmeg should be given to [the mansion of] Vāyu; / and saffron and sandalwood should be given to Viśākhā.

1.96.s:
turuṣkasahitaṃ deyaṃ tathā maitrāya candanam ..
jyeṣṭhāyāśca pradātavyaṃ candanaṃ kuṅkumaṃ tathā .. 12 ..
1.96.d:
तुरुष्कसहितं देयं तथा मैत्राय चन्दनम् ॥
ज्येष्ठायाश्च प्रदातव्यं चन्दनं कुङ्कुमं तथा ॥ 12 ॥
1.96.m: Sandalwood accompanied by olibanum should likewise be given to [the mansion of] Mitra; / and sandalwood and saffron should be given to Jyeṣṭhā.

1.96.s:
mūlāya śiṃśapāsāraṃ tathā deyaṃ mṛgodbhavam ..
āpyāya kuṣṭhasaṃyuktaṃ dātavyaṃ candanaṃ bhavet .. 13 ..
1.96.d:
मूलाय शिंशपासारं तथा देयं मृगोद्भवम् ॥
आप्याय कुष्ठसंयुक्तं दातव्यं चन्दनं भवेत् ॥ 13 ॥
1.96.m: To Mūla [should be given] heartwood of śiṃśapā, and musk should likewise be offered; / to [the mansion of] the Waters sandalwood combined with costus should be given.

1.96.s:
vaiśvadevāya mṛgajaṃ candanāguruṇī tathā ..
brāhmāya candanaṃ deyaṃ vaiṣṇavāyāguruṃ tathā ..14..
1.96.d:
वैश्वदेवाय मृगजं चन्दनागुरुणी तथा ॥
ब्राह्माय चन्दनं देयं वैष्णवायागुरुं तथा ॥14॥
1.96.m: To [the mansion of] the All-gods [should be given] musk, as well as sandalwood and agallochum; / to [the mansion of] Brahmā sandalwood should be given, and to [that of] Viṣṇu agallochum.

1.96.s:
jātīlavaṅgau dātavyau supiṣṭau vāsavāya tau ..
vāruṇāya ca karpūramājāhirbudhnyayostathā .. 15 ..
1.96.d:
जातीलवङ्गौ दातव्यौ सुपिष्टौ वासवाय तौ ॥
वारुणाय च कर्पूरमाजाहिर्बुध्न्ययोस्तथा ॥ 15 ॥
1.96.m: Well-ground nutmeg and clove should be given to [the mansion of] the Vasus; / and camphor to [that of] Varuṇa, as well as to [the two mansions of] Aja and Ahirbudhnya.

1.96.s:
pauṣṇāya candanaṃ raktamāśvināya tathā sitam ..
yāmyāyāgurusaṃyuktaṃ tathā deyaṃ mṛgodbhavam .. 16 ..
1.96.d:
पौष्णाय चन्दनं रक्तमाश्विनाय तथा सितम् ॥
याम्यायागुरुसंयुक्तं तथा देयं मृगोद्भवम् ॥ 16 ॥
1.96.m: To [the mansion of] Pūṣan [should be given] red sandalwood, and white to [that of] the Aśvins; / to [that of] Yama musk mixed with agallochum should likewise be offered.

1.96.s:
samānadevanakṣatraṃ kathitaṃ ca tathā diśam ..
uttarāyāstathā deye candanāguruṇī śubhe .. 17 ..
1.96.d:
समानदेवनक्षत्रं कथितं च तथा दिशम् ॥
उत्तरायास्तथा देये चन्दनागुरुणी शुभे ॥ 17 ॥
1.96.m: The directions are declared to share the same deities as the lunar mansions; / and to the northern [direction] should be given auspicious sandalwood and agallochum.

1.96.s:
sāgarāṇāṃ pradātavyaṃ sarveṣāmeva candanam ..
alābhe tu tathā deyaṃ sarveṣāmeva candanam.. 18 ..
1.96.d:
सागराणां प्रदातव्यं सर्वेषामेव चन्दनम् ॥
अलाभे तु तथा देयं सर्वेषामेव चन्दनम्॥ 18 ॥
1.96.m: To all the oceans without exception sandalwood should be given; / in the absence of [the specified unguent], sandalwood indeed should be given to all.

1.96.s:
maṅgalyaṃ tatpavitraṃ ca devānāṃ dayitaṃ ca tat ..
dhāryaṃ ca deyaṃ tadrājam̐statra lakṣmīḥ pratiṣṭhitā .. 19 ..
1.96.d:
मङ्गल्यं तत्पवित्रं च देवानां दयितं च तत् ॥
धार्यं च देयं तद्राजम्̐स्तत्र लक्ष्मीः प्रतिष्ठिता ॥ 19 ॥
1.96.m: It is auspicious, purifying, and beloved of the gods; / it should be worn and it should be given, O king, for Fortune is established in it.

1.96.s:
yadyadgrahasyābhihitaṃ mayaitadṛkṣasya vā bhūmipatipradhāna ..
taddevatāyāśca tadeva deyaṃ diśastathā nātra vicāraṇāsti .. 1.96.20 ..
1.96.d:
यद्यद्ग्रहस्याभिहितं मयैतदृक्षस्य वा भूमिपतिप्रधान ॥
तद्देवतायाश्च तदेव देयं दिशस्तथा नात्र विचारणास्ति ॥ 1.96.20 ॥
1.96.m: Whatever has been prescribed by me for a planet or a lunar mansion, O foremost of kings, / precisely that should be given to its presiding deity, and likewise to the direction; herein there is no doubt.
